scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你是来找我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
他们出访外国时，赫尔穆特·罗根伯格受到了沉重打击，从那以后就一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我给你带句话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没想骗你们。不过你们倒是很坦率地说出了想要什么。一开始我还因为你们是孩子而小看了你们。
好吧，我给你们报酬。至于资格证明，听个传闻还需要资格吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，他确实一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这要看你想听什么传闻。价值越高，风险也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想是因为王室集会吧。这就是现在正在流传的那个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
那个传闻有这么危险吗？我听的时候完全没感觉到。金，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
^0000cd据说^000000赫尔穆特一旦成为国王，就会入侵杀害他父母的国家，发动统一大陆的战争。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾伦说的。他的话只能信三成。要是他每次都说对，世界早就毁灭二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
罗根伯格家的次子正在经商筹集战争资金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
迈尔是谁？^0000cd你的名字是迈尔吗^000000？乔纳森·迈尔？迈尔·乔纳森？你不是让我叫你乔纳森吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我该怎么做？告诉我，你想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得还挺详细？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你以前见过这些孩子，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
大家都知道了，这个传闻在这里传得沸沸扬扬。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
终于要谈生意了！太好了！我喜欢！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他们很可爱，不过也挺难应付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你是乔纳森·迈尔，还是迈尔·乔纳森？告诉我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很担心。他们害怕赫尔穆特会成为国王并发动战争。
其实大家都很不安，没人喜欢战争。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
漂亮的东西我都喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
孩子们，我要和他谈一件非常重要的事。你们能捂住耳朵，或者先离开一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战场上的鲜血在呼唤我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
验证资格！就这么简单！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听不懂你在说什么。能不能慢慢详细地告诉我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想听。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
很简单，证明你的实力。我想你应该知道^0000cd玛约罗瑟斯^000000吧。
那是个肌肉发达的恶魔。打倒它来证明你的强大吧。实力标准是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
好了！他们要谈重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起来。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也讨厌战争。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。这样够了吗？我很快就回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
乖孩子。谈完以后我给你们甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢你们告诉我这些故事，这正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我已经把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
以后还有问题的话，随时来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不听我们说话了吗？你说过会给报酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你们聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你把书带回来！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你不能只听艾伦说完就走。我们是一个团队！看到我们三个一起玩，你还不明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你们说的做吗……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们既可爱又聪明，真想知道他们长大后会是什么样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我不会丢下朋友不管。照他们说的做吧，不然你会失去资格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
没错，所以我才来这里照看、教导并带领他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来如此。那你们想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不错。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想要漂亮的丝绸布料！听说宫殿里会举办宴会，公主们都穿着漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
嗯，这只是我力所能及的事。对了，家里托了什么话？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的丝绸布料^000000！我要让妈妈给我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告诉迈尔，赫尔穆特已经让出了继承权，他的两个兄弟也放弃了战争。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
太好了。他们是我引以为傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃尔夫改变了主意^000000。和他争论实在令人头疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二块^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
沃尔夫总要亲眼确认一切才肯罢休，不过从某种角度来说也不算坏事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这很简单。小家伙，你需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你可能不信，但他是家里我最喜欢的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本记载卢恩·米德加尔特王国全部历史的书。它在王立图书馆里，我从没读过。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
啊，总之，很抱歉让你听到了我们家这些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身边没有人能进宫殿，书店也不卖这本书。请帮我拿一本来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之间争吵很常见。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷吗？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
总之，我想我该回家看看了。虽然家里的事一直很烦人，不过这次应该会很有意思。请转告家人，我会一边工作一边在这里帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你疯了吗？你把我当成什么人了？帮我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
再告诉他们，我会在宴会后去看望他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只玛约罗瑟斯、收集12块柔软的丝绸布料，并从王立图书馆借来卢恩·米德加尔特王国史^000000。我很快回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
请再帮我向阿格妮丝道歉，就说我不能陪她去宴会。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我会转告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
男子汉不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我会等你回来！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
需要我帮忙就来找我，我一定尽全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
He has come with empty hands.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
他是空着手来的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Anyone without credentials cannot hear good stories. Go back.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
没有凭据，就别想听到有价值的消息。回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
How can you say that! You must have forgotten what you should bring.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你怎么能这么说！你一定忘了该带什么。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
首先要^0000cd12块柔软的丝绸布料^000000，^0000cd一本卢恩·米德加兹王国史^000000，

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
还有...^0000cd替艾伦猎杀33只狂暴米诺斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
里面混了件奇怪的事，不过有什么关系...他想要嘛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
孩子们，你们好？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我回来了。这些是你们要的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你们两个都住口！听你们说话我头都晕了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又来了。还需要更多吗？不管怎样，你能来真好。我得把书还回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
让我看看。没错，就是这些。好漂亮，好柔软！我真的可以收下吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我想问你一件事。你知道什么有趣的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想打听罗根伯格家的传闻。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然是因为你们想要，我才把东西带来的。那你之前说的话只是随口说说吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这是任务吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
家族没有新故事？没有故事就等于死亡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
不是的！我真的很想要这些！谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是来打听新传闻的。我是来找那个告诉你们这个故事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是你的书。又大又重。我只借到这一册，其他几册都已经被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我知道一个。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我接受委托。你想问什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是谁散布了这个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你，我终于能读到它了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
为什么？你要去抓那个人吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
你身上有浓重的血腥味。没错，你打倒了玛约罗瑟斯。你是个强大的战士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是说战争故事、王室传闻之类的。
王室集会或宴会应该有不少传闻吧。我现在身处首都，为了了解这里的气氛，想听听这些故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，是他的祖父请我转告他一件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，我全都打倒了。现在让我听听那个故事吧——那个价值不菲的故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那个故事！我们都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
明明是一家人，为什么不能见面呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战争，王室，赫尔穆特·罗根伯格。如果他成为国王，大陆就会被卷入战争漩涡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
让我来说！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，也不完全是那样……唔……对，差不多就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
黑暗将席卷大陆，痛苦的哀嚎将响彻整片大陆！！！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我也知道这个故事，但不确定该不该告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个传闻正在流传吗？可我不明白它是什么意思。有人能帮我解释一下吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为什么？你想要报酬的话，我可以给你。糖果怎么样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。不过有时即使是家人也很难见面，只好请人互相传话。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很简单。赫尔穆特·罗根伯格一旦成为国王，就会爆发战争。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你拿糖果当报酬？太傻了吧，我们又不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这次你需要更有力的资格证明……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……这也太简单了。请再解释详细些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你最好别提报酬。我妈妈说过不能收陌生人的东西。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啊，他来了！乔纳森！有客人来了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
呃啊！你们两个在说什么呀？我来解释吧。传闻是这样的：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我们不是正在聊天吗？那你想要什么？不要糖果的话。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
如果赫尔穆特·罗根伯格成为国王……啊，对了，你听过罗根伯格家的传闻吗？特别是^0000cd四个孩子死亡的传闻^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
报酬对我来说不重要，重要的是你有没有资格听这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
冒险者，欢迎光临。你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道，我以前从没听说过。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
资格证明？他在说什么啊？有时候他说话真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想找到最初散布传闻的人，就得先找到传闻的来源。不过我没想到你会在这里。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
这也只是传闻，不过我觉得是真的。总之，我听说他们遭到了谋杀，

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要报酬。只要给我合适的报酬，什么都可以告诉你。先说说你能给什么吧。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你是来找我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
他们出访外国时，赫尔穆特·罗根伯格受到了沉重打击，从那以后就一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我给你带句话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没想骗你们。不过你们倒是很坦率地说出了想要什么。一开始我还因为你们是孩子而小看了你们。
好吧，我给你们报酬。至于资格证明，听个传闻还需要资格吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，他确实一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这要看你想听什么传闻。价值越高，风险也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想是因为王室集会吧。这就是现在正在流传的那个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
那个传闻有这么危险吗？我听的时候完全没感觉到。金，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
^0000cd据说^000000赫尔穆特一旦成为国王，就会入侵杀害他父母的国家，发动统一大陆的战争。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾伦说的。他的话只能信三成。要是他每次都说对，世界早就毁灭二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
罗根伯格家的次子正在经商筹集战争资金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
迈尔是谁？^0000cd你的名字是迈尔吗^000000？乔纳森·迈尔？迈尔·乔纳森？你不是让我叫你乔纳森吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我该怎么做？告诉我，你想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得还挺详细？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你以前见过这些孩子，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
大家都知道了，这个传闻在这里传得沸沸扬扬。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
终于要谈生意了！太好了！我喜欢！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他们很可爱，不过也挺难应付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你是乔纳森·迈尔，还是迈尔·乔纳森？告诉我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很担心。他们害怕赫尔穆特会成为国王并发动战争。
其实大家都很不安，没人喜欢战争。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
漂亮的东西我都喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
孩子们，我要和他谈一件非常重要的事。你们能捂住耳朵，或者先离开一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战场上的鲜血在呼唤我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
验证资格！就这么简单！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听不懂你在说什么。能不能慢慢详细地告诉我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想听。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
很简单，证明你的实力。我想你应该知道^0000cd玛约罗瑟斯^000000吧。
那是个肌肉发达的恶魔。打倒它来证明你的强大吧。实力标准是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
好了！他们要谈重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起来。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也讨厌战争。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。这样够了吗？我很快就回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
乖孩子。谈完以后我给你们甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢你们告诉我这些故事，这正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我已经把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
以后还有问题的话，随时来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不听我们说话了吗？你说过会给报酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你们聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你把书带回来！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你不能只听艾伦说完就走。我们是一个团队！看到我们三个一起玩，你还不明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你们说的做吗……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们既可爱又聪明，真想知道他们长大后会是什么样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我不会丢下朋友不管。照他们说的做吧，不然你会失去资格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
没错，所以我才来这里照看、教导并带领他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来如此。那你们想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不错。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想要漂亮的丝绸布料！听说宫殿里会举办宴会，公主们都穿着漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
嗯，这只是我力所能及的事。对了，家里托了什么话？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的丝绸布料^000000！我要让妈妈给我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告诉迈尔，赫尔穆特已经让出了继承权，他的两个兄弟也放弃了战争。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
太好了。他们是我引以为傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃尔夫改变了主意^000000。和他争论实在令人头疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二块^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
沃尔夫总要亲眼确认一切才肯罢休，不过从某种角度来说也不算坏事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这很简单。小家伙，你需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你可能不信，但他是家里我最喜欢的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本记载卢恩·米德加尔特王国全部历史的书。它在王立图书馆里，我从没读过。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
啊，总之，很抱歉让你听到了我们家这些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身边没有人能进宫殿，书店也不卖这本书。请帮我拿一本来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之间争吵很常见。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷吗？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
总之，我想我该回家看看了。虽然家里的事一直很烦人，不过这次应该会很有意思。请转告家人，我会一边工作一边在这里帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你疯了吗？你把我当成什么人了？帮我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
再告诉他们，我会在宴会后去看望他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只玛约罗瑟斯、收集12块柔软的丝绸布料，并从王立图书馆借来卢恩·米德加尔特王国史^000000。我很快回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
请再帮我向阿格妮丝道歉，就说我不能陪她去宴会。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我会转告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
男子汉不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我会等你回来！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
需要我帮忙就来找我，我一定尽全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Do you hear more? If so, you need to prove you have stronger credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
想听更多？那就得拿出更有力的凭据。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This is a ritual that calls blood! A ritual of destruction and darkness!!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这是召唤鲜血的仪式！是毁灭与黑暗的仪式！！！！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
He started again.
scripts.translation:
[金]
他又开始了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Please go. We'll handle him.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
请离开。我们会处理他的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
孩子们，你们好？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我回来了。这些是你们要的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你们两个都住口！听你们说话我头都晕了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又来了。还需要更多吗？不管怎样，你能来真好。我得把书还回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
让我看看。没错，就是这些。好漂亮，好柔软！我真的可以收下吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我想问你一件事。你知道什么有趣的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想打听罗根伯格家的传闻。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然是因为你们想要，我才把东西带来的。那你之前说的话只是随口说说吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这是任务吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
家族没有新故事？没有故事就等于死亡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
不是的！我真的很想要这些！谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是来打听新传闻的。我是来找那个告诉你们这个故事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是你的书。又大又重。我只借到这一册，其他几册都已经被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我知道一个。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我接受委托。你想问什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是谁散布了这个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你，我终于能读到它了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
为什么？你要去抓那个人吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
你身上有浓重的血腥味。没错，你打倒了玛约罗瑟斯。你是个强大的战士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是说战争故事、王室传闻之类的。
王室集会或宴会应该有不少传闻吧。我现在身处首都，为了了解这里的气氛，想听听这些故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，是他的祖父请我转告他一件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，我全都打倒了。现在让我听听那个故事吧——那个价值不菲的故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那个故事！我们都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
明明是一家人，为什么不能见面呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战争，王室，赫尔穆特·罗根伯格。如果他成为国王，大陆就会被卷入战争漩涡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
让我来说！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，也不完全是那样……唔……对，差不多就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
黑暗将席卷大陆，痛苦的哀嚎将响彻整片大陆！！！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我也知道这个故事，但不确定该不该告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个传闻正在流传吗？可我不明白它是什么意思。有人能帮我解释一下吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为什么？你想要报酬的话，我可以给你。糖果怎么样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。不过有时即使是家人也很难见面，只好请人互相传话。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很简单。赫尔穆特·罗根伯格一旦成为国王，就会爆发战争。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你拿糖果当报酬？太傻了吧，我们又不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这次你需要更有力的资格证明……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……这也太简单了。请再解释详细些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你最好别提报酬。我妈妈说过不能收陌生人的东西。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啊，他来了！乔纳森！有客人来了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
呃啊！你们两个在说什么呀？我来解释吧。传闻是这样的：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我们不是正在聊天吗？那你想要什么？不要糖果的话。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
如果赫尔穆特·罗根伯格成为国王……啊，对了，你听过罗根伯格家的传闻吗？特别是^0000cd四个孩子死亡的传闻^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
报酬对我来说不重要，重要的是你有没有资格听这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
冒险者，欢迎光临。你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道，我以前从没听说过。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
资格证明？他在说什么啊？有时候他说话真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想找到最初散布传闻的人，就得先找到传闻的来源。不过我没想到你会在这里。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
这也只是传闻，不过我觉得是真的。总之，我听说他们遭到了谋杀，

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要报酬。只要给我合适的报酬，什么都可以告诉你。先说说你能给什么吧。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你是来找我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
他们出访外国时，赫尔穆特·罗根伯格受到了沉重打击，从那以后就一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我给你带句话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没想骗你们。不过你们倒是很坦率地说出了想要什么。一开始我还因为你们是孩子而小看了你们。
好吧，我给你们报酬。至于资格证明，听个传闻还需要资格吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，他确实一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这要看你想听什么传闻。价值越高，风险也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想是因为王室集会吧。这就是现在正在流传的那个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
那个传闻有这么危险吗？我听的时候完全没感觉到。金，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
^0000cd据说^000000赫尔穆特一旦成为国王，就会入侵杀害他父母的国家，发动统一大陆的战争。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾伦说的。他的话只能信三成。要是他每次都说对，世界早就毁灭二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
罗根伯格家的次子正在经商筹集战争资金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
迈尔是谁？^0000cd你的名字是迈尔吗^000000？乔纳森·迈尔？迈尔·乔纳森？你不是让我叫你乔纳森吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我该怎么做？告诉我，你想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得还挺详细？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你以前见过这些孩子，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
大家都知道了，这个传闻在这里传得沸沸扬扬。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
终于要谈生意了！太好了！我喜欢！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他们很可爱，不过也挺难应付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你是乔纳森·迈尔，还是迈尔·乔纳森？告诉我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很担心。他们害怕赫尔穆特会成为国王并发动战争。
其实大家都很不安，没人喜欢战争。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
漂亮的东西我都喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
孩子们，我要和他谈一件非常重要的事。你们能捂住耳朵，或者先离开一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战场上的鲜血在呼唤我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
验证资格！就这么简单！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听不懂你在说什么。能不能慢慢详细地告诉我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想听。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
很简单，证明你的实力。我想你应该知道^0000cd玛约罗瑟斯^000000吧。
那是个肌肉发达的恶魔。打倒它来证明你的强大吧。实力标准是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
好了！他们要谈重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起来。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也讨厌战争。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。这样够了吗？我很快就回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
乖孩子。谈完以后我给你们甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢你们告诉我这些故事，这正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我已经把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
以后还有问题的话，随时来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不听我们说话了吗？你说过会给报酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你们聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你把书带回来！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你不能只听艾伦说完就走。我们是一个团队！看到我们三个一起玩，你还不明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你们说的做吗……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们既可爱又聪明，真想知道他们长大后会是什么样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我不会丢下朋友不管。照他们说的做吧，不然你会失去资格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
没错，所以我才来这里照看、教导并带领他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来如此。那你们想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不错。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想要漂亮的丝绸布料！听说宫殿里会举办宴会，公主们都穿着漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
嗯，这只是我力所能及的事。对了，家里托了什么话？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的丝绸布料^000000！我要让妈妈给我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告诉迈尔，赫尔穆特已经让出了继承权，他的两个兄弟也放弃了战争。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
太好了。他们是我引以为傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃尔夫改变了主意^000000。和他争论实在令人头疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二块^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
沃尔夫总要亲眼确认一切才肯罢休，不过从某种角度来说也不算坏事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这很简单。小家伙，你需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你可能不信，但他是家里我最喜欢的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本记载卢恩·米德加尔特王国全部历史的书。它在王立图书馆里，我从没读过。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
啊，总之，很抱歉让你听到了我们家这些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身边没有人能进宫殿，书店也不卖这本书。请帮我拿一本来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之间争吵很常见。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷吗？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
总之，我想我该回家看看了。虽然家里的事一直很烦人，不过这次应该会很有意思。请转告家人，我会一边工作一边在这里帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你疯了吗？你把我当成什么人了？帮我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
再告诉他们，我会在宴会后去看望他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.

scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
以后还有问题的话，随时来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不听我们说话了吗？你说过会给报酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你们聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你把书带回来！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你不能只听艾伦说完就走。我们是一个团队！看到我们三个一起玩，你还不明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你们说的做吗……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们既可爱又聪明，真想知道他们长大后会是什么样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我不会丢下朋友不管。照他们说的做吧，不然你会失去资格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
没错，所以我才来这里照看、教导并带领他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来如此。那你们想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不错。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想要漂亮的丝绸布料！听说宫殿里会举办宴会，公主们都穿着漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
嗯，这只是我力所能及的事。对了，家里托了什么话？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的丝绸布料^000000！我要让妈妈给我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告诉迈尔，赫尔穆特已经让出了继承权，他的两个兄弟也放弃了战争。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
太好了。他们是我引以为傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃尔夫改变了主意^000000。和他争论实在令人头疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二块^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
沃尔夫总要亲眼确认一切才肯罢休，不过从某种角度来说也不算坏事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这很简单。小家伙，你需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你可能不信，但他是家里我最喜欢的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本记载卢恩·米德加尔特王国全部历史的书。它在王立图书馆里，我从没读过。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
啊，总之，很抱歉让你听到了我们家这些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身边没有人能进宫殿，书店也不卖这本书。请帮我拿一本来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之间争吵很常见。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷吗？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
总之，我想我该回家看看了。虽然家里的事一直很烦人，不过这次应该会很有意思。请转告家人，我会一边工作一边在这里帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你疯了吗？你把我当成什么人了？帮我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
再告诉他们，我会在宴会后去看望他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只玛约罗瑟斯、收集12块柔软的丝绸布料，并从王立图书馆借来卢恩·米德加尔特王国史^000000。我很快回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
请再帮我向阿格妮丝道歉，就说我不能陪她去宴会。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我会转告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
男子汉不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我会等你回来！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
需要我帮忙就来找我，我一定尽全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? why empty hands? I cannot see what we told you.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？怎么空着手？我没看到我们托你带来的东西。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you looking down on us, as we are children? I really hate such people.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你是因为我们是小孩才看不起我们吗？我最讨厌这种人了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Hey! You aren't, are you? You don't seem to be a such person. You forget what you should get, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
喂，你不是那种人吧？看起来不像啊。你只是忘了该带什么，对不对？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
首先要^0000cd12块柔软的丝绸布料^000000，^0000cd一本卢恩·米德加兹王国史^000000，

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
还有...^0000cd替艾伦猎杀33只狂暴米诺斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
里面还夹了件奇怪的要求，不过有什么关系...他想要嘛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
孩子们，你们好？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我回来了。这些是你们要的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你们两个都住口！听你们说话我头都晕了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又来了。还需要更多吗？不管怎样，你能来真好。我得把书还回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
让我看看。没错，就是这些。好漂亮，好柔软！我真的可以收下吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我想问你一件事。你知道什么有趣的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想打听罗根伯格家的传闻。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然是因为你们想要，我才把东西带来的。那你之前说的话只是随口说说吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这是任务吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
家族没有新故事？没有故事就等于死亡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
不是的！我真的很想要这些！谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是来打听新传闻的。我是来找那个告诉你们这个故事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是你的书。又大又重。我只借到这一册，其他几册都已经被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我知道一个。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我接受委托。你想问什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是谁散布了这个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你，我终于能读到它了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
为什么？你要去抓那个人吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
你身上有浓重的血腥味。没错，你打倒了玛约罗瑟斯。你是个强大的战士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是说战争故事、王室传闻之类的。
王室集会或宴会应该有不少传闻吧。我现在身处首都，为了了解这里的气氛，想听听这些故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，是他的祖父请我转告他一件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，我全都打倒了。现在让我听听那个故事吧——那个价值不菲的故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那个故事！我们都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
明明是一家人，为什么不能见面呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战争，王室，赫尔穆特·罗根伯格。如果他成为国王，大陆就会被卷入战争漩涡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
让我来说！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，也不完全是那样……唔……对，差不多就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
黑暗将席卷大陆，痛苦的哀嚎将响彻整片大陆！！！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我也知道这个故事，但不确定该不该告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个传闻正在流传吗？可我不明白它是什么意思。有人能帮我解释一下吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为什么？你想要报酬的话，我可以给你。糖果怎么样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。不过有时即使是家人也很难见面，只好请人互相传话。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很简单。赫尔穆特·罗根伯格一旦成为国王，就会爆发战争。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你拿糖果当报酬？太傻了吧，我们又不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这次你需要更有力的资格证明……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……这也太简单了。请再解释详细些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你最好别提报酬。我妈妈说过不能收陌生人的东西。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啊，他来了！乔纳森！有客人来了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
呃啊！你们两个在说什么呀？我来解释吧。传闻是这样的：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我们不是正在聊天吗？那你想要什么？不要糖果的话。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
如果赫尔穆特·罗根伯格成为国王……啊，对了，你听过罗根伯格家的传闻吗？特别是^0000cd四个孩子死亡的传闻^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
报酬对我来说不重要，重要的是你有没有资格听这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
冒险者，欢迎光临。你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道，我以前从没听说过。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
资格证明？他在说什么啊？有时候他说话真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想找到最初散布传闻的人，就得先找到传闻的来源。不过我没想到你会在这里。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
这也只是传闻，不过我觉得是真的。总之，我听说他们遭到了谋杀，

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要报酬。只要给我合适的报酬，什么都可以告诉你。先说说你能给什么吧。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你是来找我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
他们出访外国时，赫尔穆特·罗根伯格受到了沉重打击，从那以后就一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我给你带句话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没想骗你们。不过你们倒是很坦率地说出了想要什么。一开始我还因为你们是孩子而小看了你们。
好吧，我给你们报酬。至于资格证明，听个传闻还需要资格吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，他确实一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这要看你想听什么传闻。价值越高，风险也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想是因为王室集会吧。这就是现在正在流传的那个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
那个传闻有这么危险吗？我听的时候完全没感觉到。金，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
^0000cd据说^000000赫尔穆特一旦成为国王，就会入侵杀害他父母的国家，发动统一大陆的战争。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾伦说的。他的话只能信三成。要是他每次都说对，世界早就毁灭二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
罗根伯格家的次子正在经商筹集战争资金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
迈尔是谁？^0000cd你的名字是迈尔吗^000000？乔纳森·迈尔？迈尔·乔纳森？你不是让我叫你乔纳森吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我该怎么做？告诉我，你想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得还挺详细？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你以前见过这些孩子，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
大家都知道了，这个传闻在这里传得沸沸扬扬。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
终于要谈生意了！太好了！我喜欢！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他们很可爱，不过也挺难应付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你是乔纳森·迈尔，还是迈尔·乔纳森？告诉我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很担心。他们害怕赫尔穆特会成为国王并发动战争。
其实大家都很不安，没人喜欢战争。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
漂亮的东西我都喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
孩子们，我要和他谈一件非常重要的事。你们能捂住耳朵，或者先离开一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战场上的鲜血在呼唤我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
验证资格！就这么简单！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听不懂你在说什么。能不能慢慢详细地告诉我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想听。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
很简单，证明你的实力。我想你应该知道^0000cd玛约罗瑟斯^000000吧。
那是个肌肉发达的恶魔。打倒它来证明你的强大吧。实力标准是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
好了！他们要谈重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起来。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也讨厌战争。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。这样够了吗？我很快就回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
乖孩子。谈完以后我给你们甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢你们告诉我这些故事，这正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我已经把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
以后还有问题的话，随时来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不听我们说话了吗？你说过会给报酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你们聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你把书带回来！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你不能只听艾伦说完就走。我们是一个团队！看到我们三个一起玩，你还不明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你们说的做吗……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们既可爱又聪明，真想知道他们长大后会是什么样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我不会丢下朋友不管。照他们说的做吧，不然你会失去资格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
没错，所以我才来这里照看、教导并带领他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来如此。那你们想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不错。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想要漂亮的丝绸布料！听说宫殿里会举办宴会，公主们都穿着漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
嗯，这只是我力所能及的事。对了，家里托了什么话？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的丝绸布料^000000！我要让妈妈给我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告诉迈尔，赫尔穆特已经让出了继承权，他的两个兄弟也放弃了战争。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
太好了。他们是我引以为傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃尔夫改变了主意^000000。和他争论实在令人头疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二块^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
沃尔夫总要亲眼确认一切才肯罢休，不过从某种角度来说也不算坏事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这很简单。小家伙，你需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你可能不信，但他是家里我最喜欢的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本记载卢恩·米德加尔特王国全部历史的书。它在王立图书馆里，我从没读过。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
啊，总之，很抱歉让你听到了我们家这些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身边没有人能进宫殿，书店也不卖这本书。请帮我拿一本来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之间争吵很常见。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷吗？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
总之，我想我该回家看看了。虽然家里的事一直很烦人，不过这次应该会很有意思。请转告家人，我会一边工作一边在这里帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你疯了吗？你把我当成什么人了？帮我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
再告诉他们，我会在宴会后去看望他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只玛约罗瑟斯、收集12块柔软的丝绸布料，并从王立图书馆借来卢恩·米德加尔特王国史^000000。我很快回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
请再帮我向阿格妮丝道歉，就说我不能陪她去宴会。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我会转告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
男子汉不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我会等你回来！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
需要我帮忙就来找我，我一定尽全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I am enjoying reading the book you gave, though it is too large and heavy.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我正在读你给我的书，虽然它又大又重。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My dream is to become a historian. I would like travel around Midgards and discover old hidden stories.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我的梦想是成为历史学家。我想走遍米德加尔特，发掘那些被遗忘的古老故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
孩子们，你们好？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我回来了。这些是你们要的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你们两个都住口！听你们说话我头都晕了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又来了。还需要更多吗？不管怎样，你能来真好。我得把书还回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
让我看看。没错，就是这些。好漂亮，好柔软！我真的可以收下吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我想问你一件事。你知道什么有趣的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想打听罗根伯格家的传闻。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然是因为你们想要，我才把东西带来的。那你之前说的话只是随口说说吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这是任务吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
家族没有新故事？没有故事就等于死亡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
不是的！我真的很想要这些！谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是来打听新传闻的。我是来找那个告诉你们这个故事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是你的书。又大又重。我只借到这一册，其他几册都已经被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我知道一个。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我接受委托。你想问什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是谁散布了这个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你，我终于能读到它了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
为什么？你要去抓那个人吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
你身上有浓重的血腥味。没错，你打倒了玛约罗瑟斯。你是个强大的战士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是说战争故事、王室传闻之类的。
王室集会或宴会应该有不少传闻吧。我现在身处首都，为了了解这里的气氛，想听听这些故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，是他的祖父请我转告他一件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，我全都打倒了。现在让我听听那个故事吧——那个价值不菲的故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那个故事！我们都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
明明是一家人，为什么不能见面呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战争，王室，赫尔穆特·罗根伯格。如果他成为国王，大陆就会被卷入战争漩涡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
让我来说！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，也不完全是那样……唔……对，差不多就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
黑暗将席卷大陆，痛苦的哀嚎将响彻整片大陆！！！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我也知道这个故事，但不确定该不该告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个传闻正在流传吗？可我不明白它是什么意思。有人能帮我解释一下吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为什么？你想要报酬的话，我可以给你。糖果怎么样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。不过有时即使是家人也很难见面，只好请人互相传话。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很简单。赫尔穆特·罗根伯格一旦成为国王，就会爆发战争。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你拿糖果当报酬？太傻了吧，我们又不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这次你需要更有力的资格证明……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……这也太简单了。请再解释详细些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你最好别提报酬。我妈妈说过不能收陌生人的东西。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啊，他来了！乔纳森！有客人来了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
呃啊！你们两个在说什么呀？我来解释吧。传闻是这样的：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我们不是正在聊天吗？那你想要什么？不要糖果的话。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
如果赫尔穆特·罗根伯格成为国王……啊，对了，你听过罗根伯格家的传闻吗？特别是^0000cd四个孩子死亡的传闻^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
报酬对我来说不重要，重要的是你有没有资格听这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
冒险者，欢迎光临。你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道，我以前从没听说过。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
资格证明？他在说什么啊？有时候他说话真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想找到最初散布传闻的人，就得先找到传闻的来源。不过我没想到你会在这里。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
这也只是传闻，不过我觉得是真的。总之，我听说他们遭到了谋杀，

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要报酬。只要给我合适的报酬，什么都可以告诉你。先说说你能给什么吧。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你是来找我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
他们出访外国时，赫尔穆特·罗根伯格受到了沉重打击，从那以后就一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我给你带句话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没想骗你们。不过你们倒是很坦率地说出了想要什么。一开始我还因为你们是孩子而小看了你们。
好吧，我给你们报酬。至于资格证明，听个传闻还需要资格吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，他确实一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这要看你想听什么传闻。价值越高，风险也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想是因为王室集会吧。这就是现在正在流传的那个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
那个传闻有这么危险吗？我听的时候完全没感觉到。金，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
^0000cd据说^000000赫尔穆特一旦成为国王，就会入侵杀害他父母的国家，发动统一大陆的战争。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾伦说的。他的话只能信三成。要是他每次都说对，世界早就毁灭二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
罗根伯格家的次子正在经商筹集战争资金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
