迈尔是谁？^0000cd你的名字是迈尔吗^000000？乔纳森·迈尔？迈尔·乔纳森？你不是让我叫你乔纳森吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我该怎么做？告诉我，你想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得还挺详细？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你以前见过这些孩子，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
大家都知道了，这个传闻在这里传得沸沸扬扬。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
终于要谈生意了！太好了！我喜欢！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他们很可爱，不过也挺难应付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你是乔纳森·迈尔，还是迈尔·乔纳森？告诉我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很担心。他们害怕赫尔穆特会成为国王并发动战争。
其实大家都很不安，没人喜欢战争。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
漂亮的东西我都喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
孩子们，我要和他谈一件非常重要的事。你们能捂住耳朵，或者先离开一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战场上的鲜血在呼唤我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
验证资格！就这么简单！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听不懂你在说什么。能不能慢慢详细地告诉我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想听。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
很简单，证明你的实力。我想你应该知道^0000cd玛约罗瑟斯^000000吧。
那是个肌肉发达的恶魔。打倒它来证明你的强大吧。实力标准是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
好了！他们要谈重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起来。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也讨厌战争。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。这样够了吗？我很快就回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
乖孩子。谈完以后我给你们甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢你们告诉我这些故事，这正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我已经把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
以后还有问题的话，随时来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不听我们说话了吗？你说过会给报酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你们聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你把书带回来！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你不能只听艾伦说完就走。我们是一个团队！看到我们三个一起玩，你还不明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你们说的做吗……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们既可爱又聪明，真想知道他们长大后会是什么样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我不会丢下朋友不管。照他们说的做吧，不然你会失去资格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
没错，所以我才来这里照看、教导并带领他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来如此。那你们想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不错。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想要漂亮的丝绸布料！听说宫殿里会举办宴会，公主们都穿着漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
嗯，这只是我力所能及的事。对了，家里托了什么话？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的丝绸布料^000000！我要让妈妈给我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告诉迈尔，赫尔穆特已经让出了继承权，他的两个兄弟也放弃了战争。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
太好了。他们是我引以为傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃尔夫改变了主意^000000。和他争论实在令人头疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二块^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
沃尔夫总要亲眼确认一切才肯罢休，不过从某种角度来说也不算坏事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这很简单。小家伙，你需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你可能不信，但他是家里我最喜欢的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本记载卢恩·米德加尔特王国全部历史的书。它在王立图书馆里，我从没读过。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
啊，总之，很抱歉让你听到了我们家这些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身边没有人能进宫殿，书店也不卖这本书。请帮我拿一本来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之间争吵很常见。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷吗？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
总之，我想我该回家看看了。虽然家里的事一直很烦人，不过这次应该会很有意思。请转告家人，我会一边工作一边在这里帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你疯了吗？你把我当成什么人了？帮我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
再告诉他们，我会在宴会后去看望他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只玛约罗瑟斯、收集12块柔软的丝绸布料，并从王立图书馆借来卢恩·米德加尔特王国史^000000。我很快回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
请再帮我向阿格妮丝道歉，就说我不能陪她去宴会。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我会转告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
男子汉不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我会等你回来！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
需要我帮忙就来找我，我一定尽全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Jonathan returned the book you borrowed and he borrowed me other two volumes.
scripts.translation:
[金]
乔纳森已经把你借的书还回去了，还另外借给我两卷。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Jonathan is great! I will become a man like Jonathan in the future.
scripts.translation:
[金]
乔纳森真棒！将来我要成为像乔纳森那样的人。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
How beautiful and shining the dresses of princesses would be! I wish I could wear as many pretty dresses as possible.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
公主们的礼服一定又漂亮又闪亮！我真希望能穿上好多漂亮裙子。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Hello, singing birds and pretty flowers.
Are you having a beautiful day today too?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
你好啊，唱歌的小鸟和漂亮的花朵。
你们今天也过得愉快吗？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
He started again.
Why don't I have normal person around me?
scripts.translation:
[金]
他又开始了。
我身边怎么就没有一个正常人呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Are you talking to me?
If so, you are successful. I heard it very clearly.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
你是在跟我说话吗？
要是的话，你成功了，我听得一清二楚。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I refuse ordinariness.
I'm too big to be locked in it.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我拒绝平庸。
我可不是能被平庸束缚的人。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I refuse ordinariness.
I'm too big to be locked in it.
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我拒绝平庸。
我不该被平庸束缚。
[{0}]
孩子们，你们好？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I refuse ordinariness.
I'm too big to be locked in it.
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我拒绝平庸。
我不该被平庸束缚。
[{0}]
嗨，我回来了。这些是你们要的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I refuse ordinariness.
I'm too big to be locked in it.
[Jin]
Huh? why empty hands? I cannot see what we told you.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我拒绝平庸。
我不该被平庸束缚。
[金]
咦？怎么空手回来了？我们说的东西呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I refuse ordinariness.
I'm too big to be locked in it.
[Harriet]
Please ask my mother to use this cloth to make clothes
My mother makes pretty clothes!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我拒绝平庸。
我不该被平庸束缚。
[哈丽雅特]
请把这块布交给我妈妈，让她给我做衣服。
我妈妈做的衣服可漂亮了！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I refuse ordinariness.
I'm too big to be locked in it.
[Harriet]
Jonathan said that the threat of war is gone. What a relief that would be.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我拒绝平庸。
我不该被平庸束缚。
[哈丽雅特]
乔纳森说战争威胁已经消失了。那可真让人安心。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你们两个都住口！听你们说话我头都晕了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又来了。还需要更多吗？不管怎样，你能来真好。我得把书还回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
让我看看。没错，就是这些。好漂亮，好柔软！我真的可以收下吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我想问你一件事。你知道什么有趣的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想打听罗根伯格家的传闻。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然是因为你们想要，我才把东西带来的。那你之前说的话只是随口说说吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这是任务吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
家族没有新故事？没有故事就等于死亡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
不是的！我真的很想要这些！谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是来打听新传闻的。我是来找那个告诉你们这个故事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是你的书。又大又重。我只借到这一册，其他几册都已经被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我知道一个。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我接受委托。你想问什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是谁散布了这个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你，我终于能读到它了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
为什么？你要去抓那个人吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
你身上有浓重的血腥味。没错，你打倒了玛约罗瑟斯。你是个强大的战士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是说战争故事、王室传闻之类的。
王室集会或宴会应该有不少传闻吧。我现在身处首都，为了了解这里的气氛，想听听这些故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，是他的祖父请我转告他一件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，我全都打倒了。现在让我听听那个故事吧——那个价值不菲的故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那个故事！我们都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
明明是一家人，为什么不能见面呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战争，王室，赫尔穆特·罗根伯格。如果他成为国王，大陆就会被卷入战争漩涡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
让我来说！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，也不完全是那样……唔……对，差不多就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
黑暗将席卷大陆，痛苦的哀嚎将响彻整片大陆！！！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我也知道这个故事，但不确定该不该告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个传闻正在流传吗？可我不明白它是什么意思。有人能帮我解释一下吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为什么？你想要报酬的话，我可以给你。糖果怎么样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。不过有时即使是家人也很难见面，只好请人互相传话。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很简单。赫尔穆特·罗根伯格一旦成为国王，就会爆发战争。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你拿糖果当报酬？太傻了吧，我们又不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这次你需要更有力的资格证明……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……这也太简单了。请再解释详细些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你最好别提报酬。我妈妈说过不能收陌生人的东西。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啊，他来了！乔纳森！有客人来了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
呃啊！你们两个在说什么呀？我来解释吧。传闻是这样的：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我们不是正在聊天吗？那你想要什么？不要糖果的话。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
如果赫尔穆特·罗根伯格成为国王……啊，对了，你听过罗根伯格家的传闻吗？特别是^0000cd四个孩子死亡的传闻^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
报酬对我来说不重要，重要的是你有没有资格听这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
冒险者，欢迎光临。你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道，我以前从没听说过。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
资格证明？他在说什么啊？有时候他说话真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想找到最初散布传闻的人，就得先找到传闻的来源。不过我没想到你会在这里。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
这也只是传闻，不过我觉得是真的。总之，我听说他们遭到了谋杀，

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要报酬。只要给我合适的报酬，什么都可以告诉你。先说说你能给什么吧。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你是来找我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
他们出访外国时，赫尔穆特·罗根伯格受到了沉重打击，从那以后就一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我给你带句话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没想骗你们。不过你们倒是很坦率地说出了想要什么。一开始我还因为你们是孩子而小看了你们。
好吧，我给你们报酬。至于资格证明，听个传闻还需要资格吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，他确实一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这要看你想听什么传闻。价值越高，风险也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想是因为王室集会吧。这就是现在正在流传的那个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
那个传闻有这么危险吗？我听的时候完全没感觉到。金，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
^0000cd据说^000000赫尔穆特一旦成为国王，就会入侵杀害他父母的国家，发动统一大陆的战争。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾伦说的。他的话只能信三成。要是他每次都说对，世界早就毁灭二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
罗根伯格家的次子正在经商筹集战争资金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
迈尔是谁？^0000cd你的名字是迈尔吗^000000？乔纳森·迈尔？迈尔·乔纳森？你不是让我叫你乔纳森吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我该怎么做？告诉我，你想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得还挺详细？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你以前见过这些孩子，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
大家都知道了，这个传闻在这里传得沸沸扬扬。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
终于要谈生意了！太好了！我喜欢！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他们很可爱，不过也挺难应付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你是乔纳森·迈尔，还是迈尔·乔纳森？告诉我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很担心。他们害怕赫尔穆特会成为国王并发动战争。
其实大家都很不安，没人喜欢战争。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
漂亮的东西我都喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
孩子们，我要和他谈一件非常重要的事。你们能捂住耳朵，或者先离开一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战场上的鲜血在呼唤我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
验证资格！就这么简单！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听不懂你在说什么。能不能慢慢详细地告诉我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想听。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
很简单，证明你的实力。我想你应该知道^0000cd玛约罗瑟斯^000000吧。
那是个肌肉发达的恶魔。打倒它来证明你的强大吧。实力标准是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
好了！他们要谈重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起来。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也讨厌战争。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。这样够了吗？我很快就回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
乖孩子。谈完以后我给你们甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢你们告诉我这些故事，这正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我已经把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
以后还有问题的话，随时来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不听我们说话了吗？你说过会给报酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你们聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你把书带回来！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你不能只听艾伦说完就走。我们是一个团队！看到我们三个一起玩，你还不明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你们说的做吗……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们既可爱又聪明，真想知道他们长大后会是什么样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我不会丢下朋友不管。照他们说的做吧，不然你会失去资格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
没错，所以我才来这里照看、教导并带领他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来如此。那你们想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不错。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想要漂亮的丝绸布料！听说宫殿里会举办宴会，公主们都穿着漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
嗯，这只是我力所能及的事。对了，家里托了什么话？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的丝绸布料^000000！我要让妈妈给我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告诉迈尔，赫尔穆特已经让出了继承权，他的两个兄弟也放弃了战争。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
太好了。他们是我引以为傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃尔夫改变了主意^000000。和他争论实在令人头疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二块^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
沃尔夫总要亲眼确认一切才肯罢休，不过从某种角度来说也不算坏事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这很简单。小家伙，你需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你可能不信，但他是家里我最喜欢的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本记载卢恩·米德加尔特王国全部历史的书。它在王立图书馆里，我从没读过。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
啊，总之，很抱歉让你听到了我们家这些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身边没有人能进宫殿，书店也不卖这本书。请帮我拿一本来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之间争吵很常见。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷吗？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
总之，我想我该回家看看了。虽然家里的事一直很烦人，不过这次应该会很有意思。请转告家人，我会一边工作一边在这里帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你疯了吗？你把我当成什么人了？帮我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
再告诉他们，我会在宴会后去看望他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只玛约罗瑟斯、收集12块柔软的丝绸布料，并从王立图书馆借来卢恩·米德加尔特王国史^000000。我很快回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
请再帮我向阿格妮丝道歉，就说我不能陪她去宴会。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我会转告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
男子汉不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我会等你回来！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
需要我帮忙就来找我，我一定尽全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? why empty hands? I cannot see what we told you.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？怎么空着手？我没看到我们托你带来的东西。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you looking down on us, as we are children? I really hate such people.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你是因为我们是小孩才看不起我们吗？我最讨厌这种人了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Hey! You aren't, are you? You don't seem to be a such person. You forget what you should get, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
喂，你不是那种人吧？看起来不像啊。你只是忘了该带什么，对不对？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
First, ^0000cd12 pieces of soft cloth^000000, ^0000cdhistory book on Rune-Midgarts ^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
首先要^0000cd12块柔软的丝绸布料^000000，^0000cd一本卢恩·米德加兹王国史^000000，

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
and hmm... ^0000cdkilling of 33 Majoruroses^000000 for Allen.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
还有...^0000cd替艾伦猎杀33只狂暴米诺斯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
There is something strange included, but so what... He wants it.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
里面还夹了件奇怪的要求，不过有什么关系...他想要嘛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
孩子们，你们好？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我回来了。这些是你们要的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你们两个都住口！听你们说话我头都晕了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又来了。还需要更多吗？不管怎样，你能来真好。我得把书还回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
让我看看。没错，就是这些。好漂亮，好柔软！我真的可以收下吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我想问你一件事。你知道什么有趣的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想打听罗根伯格家的传闻。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然是因为你们想要，我才把东西带来的。那你之前说的话只是随口说说吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这是任务吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
家族没有新故事？没有故事就等于死亡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
不是的！我真的很想要这些！谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是来打听新传闻的。我是来找那个告诉你们这个故事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是你的书。又大又重。我只借到这一册，其他几册都已经被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我知道一个。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我接受委托。你想问什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是谁散布了这个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你，我终于能读到它了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
为什么？你要去抓那个人吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
你身上有浓重的血腥味。没错，你打倒了玛约罗瑟斯。你是个强大的战士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是说战争故事、王室传闻之类的。
王室集会或宴会应该有不少传闻吧。我现在身处首都，为了了解这里的气氛，想听听这些故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，是他的祖父请我转告他一件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，我全都打倒了。现在让我听听那个故事吧——那个价值不菲的故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那个故事！我们都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
明明是一家人，为什么不能见面呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战争，王室，赫尔穆特·罗根伯格。如果他成为国王，大陆就会被卷入战争漩涡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
让我来说！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，也不完全是那样……唔……对，差不多就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
黑暗将席卷大陆，痛苦的哀嚎将响彻整片大陆！！！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我也知道这个故事，但不确定该不该告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个传闻正在流传吗？可我不明白它是什么意思。有人能帮我解释一下吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为什么？你想要报酬的话，我可以给你。糖果怎么样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。不过有时即使是家人也很难见面，只好请人互相传话。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很简单。赫尔穆特·罗根伯格一旦成为国王，就会爆发战争。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你拿糖果当报酬？太傻了吧，我们又不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这次你需要更有力的资格证明……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……这也太简单了。请再解释详细些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你最好别提报酬。我妈妈说过不能收陌生人的东西。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啊，他来了！乔纳森！有客人来了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
呃啊！你们两个在说什么呀？我来解释吧。传闻是这样的：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我们不是正在聊天吗？那你想要什么？不要糖果的话。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
如果赫尔穆特·罗根伯格成为国王……啊，对了，你听过罗根伯格家的传闻吗？特别是^0000cd四个孩子死亡的传闻^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
报酬对我来说不重要，重要的是你有没有资格听这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
冒险者，欢迎光临。你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道，我以前从没听说过。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
资格证明？他在说什么啊？有时候他说话真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想找到最初散布传闻的人，就得先找到传闻的来源。不过我没想到你会在这里。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
这也只是传闻，不过我觉得是真的。总之，我听说他们遭到了谋杀，

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要报酬。只要给我合适的报酬，什么都可以告诉你。先说说你能给什么吧。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你是来找我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
他们出访外国时，赫尔穆特·罗根伯格受到了沉重打击，从那以后就一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我给你带句话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没想骗你们。不过你们倒是很坦率地说出了想要什么。一开始我还因为你们是孩子而小看了你们。
好吧，我给你们报酬。至于资格证明，听个传闻还需要资格吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，他确实一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这要看你想听什么传闻。价值越高，风险也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想是因为王室集会吧。这就是现在正在流传的那个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
那个传闻有这么危险吗？我听的时候完全没感觉到。金，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
^0000cd据说^000000赫尔穆特一旦成为国王，就会入侵杀害他父母的国家，发动统一大陆的战争。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾伦说的。他的话只能信三成。要是他每次都说对，世界早就毁灭二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
罗根伯格家的次子正在经商筹集战争资金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
迈尔是谁？^0000cd你的名字是迈尔吗^000000？乔纳森·迈尔？迈尔·乔纳森？你不是让我叫你乔纳森吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我该怎么做？告诉我，你想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得还挺详细？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你以前见过这些孩子，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
大家都知道了，这个传闻在这里传得沸沸扬扬。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
终于要谈生意了！太好了！我喜欢！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他们很可爱，不过也挺难应付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你是乔纳森·迈尔，还是迈尔·乔纳森？告诉我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很担心。他们害怕赫尔穆特会成为国王并发动战争。
其实大家都很不安，没人喜欢战争。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
漂亮的东西我都喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
孩子们，我要和他谈一件非常重要的事。你们能捂住耳朵，或者先离开一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战场上的鲜血在呼唤我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
验证资格！就这么简单！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听不懂你在说什么。能不能慢慢详细地告诉我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想听。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
很简单，证明你的实力。我想你应该知道^0000cd玛约罗瑟斯^000000吧。
那是个肌肉发达的恶魔。打倒它来证明你的强大吧。实力标准是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
好了！他们要谈重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起来。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也讨厌战争。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。这样够了吗？我很快就回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
乖孩子。谈完以后我给你们甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢你们告诉我这些故事，这正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我已经把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
以后还有问题的话，随时来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不听我们说话了吗？你说过会给报酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你们聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你把书带回来！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你不能只听艾伦说完就走。我们是一个团队！看到我们三个一起玩，你还不明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你们说的做吗……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们既可爱又聪明，真想知道他们长大后会是什么样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我不会丢下朋友不管。照他们说的做吧，不然你会失去资格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
没错，所以我才来这里照看、教导并带领他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来如此。那你们想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不错。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想要漂亮的丝绸布料！听说宫殿里会举办宴会，公主们都穿着漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
嗯，这只是我力所能及的事。对了，家里托了什么话？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的丝绸布料^000000！我要让妈妈给我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告诉迈尔，赫尔穆特已经让出了继承权，他的两个兄弟也放弃了战争。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
太好了。他们是我引以为傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃尔夫改变了主意^000000。和他争论实在令人头疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二块^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
沃尔夫总要亲眼确认一切才肯罢休，不过从某种角度来说也不算坏事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这很简单。小家伙，你需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你可能不信，但他是家里我最喜欢的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本记载卢恩·米德加尔特王国全部历史的书。它在王立图书馆里，我从没读过。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
啊，总之，很抱歉让你听到了我们家这些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身边没有人能进宫殿，书店也不卖这本书。请帮我拿一本来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之间争吵很常见。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷吗？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
总之，我想我该回家看看了。虽然家里的事一直很烦人，不过这次应该会很有意思。请转告家人，我会一边工作一边在这里帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你疯了吗？你把我当成什么人了？帮我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
再告诉他们，我会在宴会后去看望他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只玛约罗瑟斯、收集12块柔软的丝绸布料，并从王立图书馆借来卢恩·米德加尔特王国史^000000。我很快回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
请再帮我向阿格妮丝道歉，就说我不能陪她去宴会。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我会转告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
男子汉不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我会等你回来！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
需要我帮忙就来找我，我一定尽全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Please ask my mother to use this cloth to make clothes
My mother makes pretty clothes!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
请把这块布交给我妈妈，让她帮我做件衣服。
我妈妈做的衣服可漂亮了！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Now I guess that she is in the palace to repair the dresses of princesses.
Ah, I wish that she was here!
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
她现在应该在宫里帮公主们修改礼服吧。
唉，真希望她在这里！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, kids?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
孩子们，你们好？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I am back. Are these what you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗨，我回来了。这些是你们要的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Stop! both of you. I feel dizzy when I am listening to what you are talking.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你们两个都住口！听你们说话我头都晕了。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Huh? You came again. Do you need more? Anyway it is nice you came. I have to return the book.
scripts.translation:
[金]
咦？你又来了。还需要更多吗？不管怎样，你能来真好。我得把书还回去。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me see it. Yes! they are. They are so pretty. So soft! May I really have these?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
让我看看。没错，就是这些。好漂亮，好柔软！我真的可以收下吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hi, I have a question. Do you have any fun story?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我想问你一件事。你知道什么有趣的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a question about the rumor on the Roegenburg.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想打听罗根伯格家的传闻。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, I have brought them because you wanted them. Then is what you said before just empty words?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然是因为你们想要，我才把东西带来的。那你之前说的话只是随口说说吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Is this a quest?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这是任务吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
There is no new story about the family. No story means death.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
家族没有新故事？没有故事就等于死亡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
No! No! I really have wanted them! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
不是的！我真的很想要这些！谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Fun story?
scripts.translation:
[金]
有趣的故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't come here for any new rumor. I am looking for the person who told you the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是来打听新传闻的。我是来找那个告诉你们这个故事的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this your book. It is really heavy and large. I borrowed only one volume. The other volumes had already been borrowed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是你的书。又大又重。我只借到这一册，其他几册都已经被借走了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I have one.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我知道一个。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[金]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I will take the request. What's your question?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我接受委托。你想问什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to know who circulated the rumor.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想知道是谁散布了这个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you. At last I can read it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你，我终于能读到它了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Why? Are you going to catch the person?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
为什么？你要去抓那个人吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
You smell strongly of blood. Yes, you fell Majoruroses. You are a strong warrior.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
你身上有浓重的血腥味。没错，你打倒了玛约罗瑟斯。你是个强大的战士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean War stories, royal family rumors, or something like that.
I guess that there are many stories about Royal Assembly or banquet. I am now in the capital city. To read the mood here, I think I should hear those stories.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是说战争故事、王室传闻之类的。
王室集会或宴会应该有不少传闻吧。我现在身处首都，为了了解这里的气氛，想听听这些故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, the grandfather of him asked me to tell him a message.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，是他的祖父请我转告他一件事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I fell all of them. Now let me listen to the story, that expensive story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，我全都打倒了。现在让我听听那个故事吧——那个价值不菲的故事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah!, I know that story! All of us know it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊！我知道那个故事！我们都知道！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Can't they meet each other though they are family?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
明明是一家人，为什么不能见面呢？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
War, Royal family. Helmut Roegenburg. If he becomes a king, the continent will be drawn into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战争，王室，赫尔穆特·罗根伯格。如果他成为国王，大陆就会被卷入战争漩涡。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Let me tell it!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
让我来说！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's not like that.. Hmm.. Yes. similar to that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，也不完全是那样……唔……对，差不多就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Darkness will sweep the continent and painful groans will cover all the continent!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
黑暗将席卷大陆，痛苦的哀嚎将响彻整片大陆！！！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I know the story too. But I'm not sure that it is right or not to tell you the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我也知道这个故事，但不确定该不该告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
That is really strange.
scripts.translation:
[金]
真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that rumor circulating? But I don't understand what it means. Anybody who can interpret for me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个传闻正在流传吗？可我不明白它是什么意思。有人能帮我解释一下吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why? If you want compensation, I can give it to you. Candies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为什么？你想要报酬的话，我可以给你。糖果怎么样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is. but sometime even between family members it is difficult to see each other and they have to ask someone to send a message to one another.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊。不过有时即使是家人也很难见面，只好请人互相传话。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Simple. If Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king, a war will break out.
scripts.translation:
[金]
很简单。赫尔穆特·罗根伯格一旦成为国王，就会爆发战争。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
You are giving me candies as compensation? It's so stupid. We are not children.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你拿糖果当报酬？太傻了吧，我们又不是小孩子。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
This time, you need stronger credentials...
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这次你需要更有力的资格证明……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm.. It's too simple. Please explain more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯……这也太简单了。请再解释详细些。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You'd better not mention about compensation. My mother told me not to receive anything from stranger.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你最好别提报酬。我妈妈说过不能收陌生人的东西。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Ah, there he comes!, Jonathan! We have a guest.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啊，他来了！乔纳森！有客人来了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Errrrrr! What are you talking about? both of you. Let me explain. The rumor is as follows:
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
呃啊！你们两个在说什么呀？我来解释吧。传闻是这样的：

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stranger? We are now talking with each other. Then what do you want? instead of candies.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
陌生人？我们不是正在聊天吗？那你想要什么？不要糖果的话。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
if Helmut Roegenburg becomes a king...., Ah by the way, do you know a rumor about the Roegenburg, especially the rumor on the ^0000cddeath of the four children^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
如果赫尔穆特·罗根伯格成为国王……啊，对了，你听过罗根伯格家的传闻吗？特别是^0000cd四个孩子死亡的传闻^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Compensation is not important to me. What is important is whether you have credentials to hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
报酬对我来说不重要，重要的是你有没有资格听这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Dear adventurer. What has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
冒险者，欢迎光临。你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I don't know. Never heard before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不知道，我以前从没听说过。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Credentials? WTH are talking about? He speaks strangely sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
资格证明？他在说什么啊？有时候他说话真奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A way to find the first person who spreads a rumor is to find the source of rumor. but I didn't expect you are here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想找到最初散布传闻的人，就得先找到传闻的来源。不过我没想到你会在这里。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
This is also only a rumor. I am sure it is true. Anyway I heard that they were murdered,
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
这也只是传闻，不过我觉得是真的。总之，我听说他们遭到了谋杀，

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want compensation. If you give me adequate compensation, I can tell you anything. So show me your offer first.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要报酬。只要给我合适的报酬，什么都可以告诉你。先说说你能给什么吧。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Did you come here to see me?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你是来找我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
when they visit a foreign country. Helmut Roegenburg was shocked and since then he has been wandering around battle fields.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
他们出访外国时，赫尔穆特·罗根伯格受到了沉重打击，从那以后就一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. your family asked me to send a message to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你的家人托我给你带句话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't mean to cheat you. But you speak frankly of what you want. First I looked down on you as you are children.
OK, I'll give you compensation. And what credentials? Do I need credentials to hear a rumor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没想骗你们。不过你们倒是很坦率地说出了想要什么。一开始我还因为你们是孩子而小看了你们。
好吧，我给你们报酬。至于资格证明，听个传闻还需要资格吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is true he has been wandering around battle field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错，他确实一直在战场上徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
It depends on what rumor you want to hear. The higher the value is, the higher the risk is.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
这要看你想听什么传闻。价值越高，风险也越大。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I think it is because of royal assembly. That is the rumor that is circulating now.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想是因为王室集会吧。这就是现在正在流传的那个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Is the rumor that risky? I didn't know at all while I was listening. Jin, did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
那个传闻有这么危险吗？我听的时候完全没感觉到。金，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Myer?
scripts.translation:
[金]
迈尔？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
^0000cdThey say that ^000000if Helmut becomes a king, he will invade the country where his parents are killed and start a war to unify the continent.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
^0000cd据说^000000赫尔穆特一旦成为国王，就会入侵杀害他父母的国家，发动统一大陆的战争。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
It's Allen. You can count on him only 30%. If he had been always right, the world would have been destroyed a score times.
scripts.translation:
[金]
是艾伦说的。他的话只能信三成。要是他每次都说对，世界早就毁灭二十次了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
And the second son of the Roegenburg is doing business to arrange the fund for the war.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
罗根伯格家的次子正在经商筹集战争资金。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Who is Myer? ^0000cdIs you name Myer^000000? Jonathan Myer? Myer Jonathan? You told me to call you just Jonathan.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
迈尔是谁？^0000cd你的名字是迈尔吗^000000？乔纳森·迈尔？迈尔·乔纳森？你不是让我叫你乔纳森吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, what should I do? Tell me. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我该怎么做？告诉我，你想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know pretty in details?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道得还挺详细？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You saw these kids before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你以前见过这些孩子，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Everybody knows. It's noisy here with the story.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
大家都知道了，这个传闻在这里传得沸沸扬扬。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
At last, it is business time! Great! I like it!
scripts.translation:
[金]
终于要谈生意了！太好了！我喜欢！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. they are cute, but pretty difficult to handle them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，他们很可爱，不过也挺难应付的。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Are you Jonathan Myer? or Myer Jonathan? Let me know!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你是乔纳森·迈尔，还是迈尔·乔纳森？告诉我嘛！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
My parents are worried. They are afraid that Helmut will becomes a king and start a war.
In fact, everybody is anxious. They don't like wars.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我父母很担心。他们害怕赫尔穆特会成为国王并发动战争。
其实大家都很不安，没人喜欢战争。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I like anything pretty!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
漂亮的东西我都喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Kids. I am going to have a very important talk with him. Will you close your ears or leave us alone?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
孩子们，我要和他谈一件非常重要的事。你们能捂住耳朵，或者先离开一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Allen]
The blood on the battle field calls me!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
战场上的鲜血在呼唤我！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Verification of credentials! That's all!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
验证资格！就这么简单！

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Ears cannot be closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
耳朵是捂不住的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know what you are talking about. Please tell me slowly and in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听不懂你在说什么。能不能慢慢详细地告诉我？

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Except him.
scripts.translation:
[金]
除了他。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want to hear it if it is important.
scripts.translation:
[金]
如果是重要的事，我也想听。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Simple. Prove your strength. You will know ^0000cdMajoruros^000000, I think.
It is a devil with strong muscles. Catch it to prove that you are strong. The number for strength for it is ^0000cd33^000000!
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
很简单，证明你的实力。我想你应该知道^0000cd玛约罗瑟斯^000000吧。
那是个肌肉发达的恶魔。打倒它来证明你的强大吧。实力标准是^0000cd33只^000000！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Come on! They are going to have an important talk. Everybody, close your ears.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
好了！他们要谈重要的事了。大家都把耳朵捂起来。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I hate wars too.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也讨厌战争。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Is that enough? I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。这样够了吗？我很快就回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Good boys. After the talk I will give you liquorice.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
乖孩子。谈完以后我给你们甘草糖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your stories. That's what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢你们告诉我这些故事，这正是我想知道的。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
My ears are closed.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我已经把耳朵捂上了。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
If you have a question again, come to me anytime!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
以后还有问题的话，随时来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Wait a minute. Don't you listen to us? You said you would give compensation.
scripts.translation:
[金]
等一下！你不听我们说话了吗？你说过会给报酬的。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Ah. have a talk then.
scripts.translation:
[金]
啊，那你们聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Thank you for the book!
scripts.translation:
[金]
谢谢你把书带回来！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
You cannot just listen to Allen and leave. We are one team! Don't you know it whey you see three of use playing together?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
你不能只听艾伦说完就走。我们是一个团队！看到我们三个一起玩，你还不明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
La la la la la -
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
啦啦啦啦——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do I have to do what you want too...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也得照你们说的做吗……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are cute and smart. I am curious how they will grow up.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们既可爱又聪明，真想知道他们长大后会是什么样。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
I don't leave my friends. Do what they want. If you don't, you will lose credentials.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
我不会丢下朋友不管。照他们说的做吧，不然你会失去资格。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Yes. That's why I am here to check, teach and lead them.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
没错，所以我才来这里照看、教导并带领他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Then what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原来如此。那你们想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are doing a great job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你做得真不错。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty silk cloth! I heard Banquets are held in the palace and princesses were pretty dresses.
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我想要漂亮的丝绸布料！听说宫殿里会举办宴会，公主们都穿着漂亮的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Well. it's just what I can do. By the way, what is the message?
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
嗯，这只是我力所能及的事。对了，家里托了什么话？

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I want pretty clothes too! I want ^0000cdpretty silk cloth^000000 too! I'll tell my mother to make them for me!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我也想要漂亮衣服！我也想要^0000cd漂亮的丝绸布料^000000！我要让妈妈给我做衣服！

scripts.text: [He told Myer that Helmut had transferred heir-ship and his two brothers had gave up wars.]
scripts.translation: [他告诉迈尔，赫尔穆特已经让出了继承权，他的两个兄弟也放弃了战争。]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, OK, how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧好吧，你想要多少？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
That is great. They are my brothers I am proud of. What is the most important and fortunate is that ^0000cdWolf has changed his mind^000000. It is very annoying to argue with him.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
太好了。他们是我引以为傲的兄弟。最重要、最令人欣慰的是，^0000cd沃尔夫改变了主意^000000。和他争论实在令人头疼。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Considering my height, I want about ^0000cdtwelve^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
按照我的身高，大概要^0000cd十二块^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Wolf has to see everything to finish. It is a good in a way, though.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
沃尔夫总要亲眼确认一切才肯罢休，不过从某种角度来说也不算坏事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That is easy. Now you little one. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这很简单。小家伙，你需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
You may not believe, he is the one I like the most in the family.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
你可能不信，但他是家里我最喜欢的人。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I want a history book, which includes all history of Rune-Midgarts. It is in the royal library and I have never see it.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我想要一本记载卢恩·米德加尔特王国全部历史的书。它在王立图书馆里，我从没读过。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Ah, anyway, I am sorry that we showed you an unpleasant family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
啊，总之，很抱歉让你听到了我们家这些不愉快的家事。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
I know no one around me who can access the palace and book stores do not sell it. Please get it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
我身边没有人能进宫殿，书店也不卖这本书。请帮我拿一本来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is common for brothers to fight one another. I also....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
兄弟之间争吵很常见。我也……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want me to steal it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要我去偷吗？

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Anyway, I think I have to visit the house. The house has been annoying, but I think that it will be interesting. Please tell my family that I will help them here while I am doing my job.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
总之，我想我该回家看看了。虽然家里的事一直很烦人，不过这次应该会很有意思。请转告家人，我会一边工作一边在这里帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Jin]
Are you crazy? What do you think I am? Borrow it for me.
scripts.translation:
[金]
你疯了吗？你把我当成什么人了？帮我借一本就好。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And tell them I will visit them after the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
再告诉他们，我会在宴会后去看望他们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. ^0000cdHunting 33 Majoruroses, Getting 12 pieces of soft sick cloth an borrowing the history book on Rune-Midgarts from the royal library^000000. I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好。^0000cd打倒33只玛约罗瑟斯、收集12块柔软的丝绸布料，并从王立图书馆借来卢恩·米德加尔特王国史^000000。我很快回来。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
And please tell Agnes that I am sorry that cannot go with her to the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
请再帮我向阿格妮丝道歉，就说我不能陪她去宴会。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我会转告她。

scripts.text:
[Allen]
Men do not see anyone out.
scripts.translation:
[艾伦]
男子汉不送客。

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
I will be waiting for you!
scripts.translation:
[哈丽雅特]
我会等你回来！

scripts.text:
[Myer]
If you need my help, just find me. I will help you with all my efforts. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
需要我帮忙就来找我，我一定尽全力。保重！

scripts.text:
[Harriet]
Jonathan said that the threat of war is gone. What a relief that would be.
scripts.translation:
[哈莉特]
乔纳森说战争的威胁已经解除了。真是让人松了一口气。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Dear adventurer? What are you doing here? It is dangerous. The monster came down here just before. Please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
亲爱的冒险者？你怎么来这里了？这里很危险，刚才有魔物下来。快离开这里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm OK. I'm accustomed to everyday life of being attacked by monsters.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没事。我已经习惯了每天被魔物攻击的生活。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I forgot you are a great warrior. Please forgive my rudeness.
By the way what has brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我忘了您是位了不起的战士，刚才失礼了，请见谅。
对了，您怎么会来这里？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I came here to bring Lord Helmut. Your grandfather is very worried about you. He said you are away from home in an important time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我来接赫尔穆特大人回去。您的祖父很担心您，说您在这个关键时刻却离家在外。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I don't go back. ^0000cdI belong here, the front^000000. Please tell my grandfather so.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我不回去。^0000cd我属于这里，前线^000000。请这样告诉我的祖父。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But everybody is worried about you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是大家都为您担心。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I cannot go back. As a matter of fact, I resent the people who left my parents die since I became mature.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我不会回去。长大后，我一直怨恨那些眼睁睁看着我父母死去的人。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
And I thought that it is the right way to develop the power that makes people to have no choice but to follow.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我曾以为，只有建立起强大到让别人不得不追随的力量，才是正确的道路。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
So, my goal was to unify the continent and make my power reached at every corner of the continent. So I trained and trained myself.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
所以我的目标是统一大陆，让自己的势力遍及每个角落。为此，我不断训练自己。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
However, when I listened to Myer and Agnes, I realized that the way I pursue could cause sadness and misfortune to someone.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
但听了迈尔和阿格妮丝的话，我意识到自己追求的道路会给别人带来悲伤和不幸。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
So I decided to ^0000cdgive up the unification war ^000000that pushes people into a vortex of war.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
所以我决定^0000cd放弃这场会把人们卷入战争漩涡的统一战争^000000。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
This is where I should stay. Here I can ^0000cdprotect more people safely^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我应该留在这里。在这里，我可以^0000cd更安全地保护更多人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Considering the position of our family, I will cooperate in what is needed for the Royal Assembly.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
考虑到我们家族的地位，我会配合王室议会所需的一切。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
But I hope that Wolf will lead everything. When the Royal Assembly is closed, please tell Wolf that I will ^0000cdtransfer the position of heir to him^000000.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
不过我希望由狼来领导一切。王室议会结束后，请告诉狼，我会^0000cd把继承人的位置让给他^000000。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Wolf will need lots of power. I will stay here to protect our people.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
狼需要大量的力量。我会留在这里保护我们的人民。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
If you do so, Wolf will not insist on wars and Myer will not sacrifice himself like that anymore.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
这样一来，狼就不会再执意发动战争，迈尔也不必再那样牺牲自己。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...I see. I will tell you message to your grandfather.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...我明白了。我会把您的话转告给您的祖父。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Yes. thank you. Please take care.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
是的，谢谢。请多保重。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
This is where I should stay.
Please tell him '^0000cdI give up wars and transfer my position of heir to Wolf^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我应该留在这里。
请告诉祖父：^0000cd我放弃战争，并把继承人的位置让给狼^000000。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
If you do so, Wolf will not insist on wars and Myer will not sacrifice himself like that anymore.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
如果你这样做，狼就不会坚持战争，迈尔也不会再那样牺牲自己了。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Then, good bye.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
那么，再见。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I can feel the earth is shaking.
An attack is expected soon. I have to make preparation.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我感觉到大地在震动。
攻击很快就要来了，我得做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Give shout of concentration!!!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
一起高喊口号！！！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Louder!!!!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
再大声点！！！！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
We!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
我们！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
I am very happy that I came back here.
Now I've got something to do.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
很高兴能回到这里。
现在我也有了自己的职责。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
And I think it is great that Lord Helmut has given up the unification war.
I knew nothing about unification, but I wished that no war would break out.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
赫尔穆特大人放弃统一战争，真是太好了。
我不懂什么统一大业，只希望不要再有战争。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
Here, I would like to help Lord Helmut to protect people's safe and peaceful days.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
我想留在这里，帮助赫尔穆特大人守护大家平静安稳的生活。

scripts.text:
[Kalbern]
Now it is the time that Lord Helmut begins to feel thirsty.
I think I should prepare something to drink.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔贝恩]
赫尔穆特大人应该快渴了。
我去准备些喝的。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Thank you for coming here to deliver the message. Without you, I would not have listened to anything like the one I heard today.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
谢谢你特地来传话。要不是你，我也不会听到今天这些话。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
Fight, fight, and fight.... I don't want that either.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
打打杀杀...我也不想看到那样。

scripts.text:
[Myer]
They are my family who are closer to me than anyone.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔]
他们是我的家人，比任何人都更亲近我。

scripts.text:
[Ordinary Man]
Shh! You'd better not speak to me.
There are may eyes around.
scripts.translation:
[普通男子]
嘘！你最好别跟我说话。
周围到处都是眼线。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Butler]
It is a fast way to get stronger to take a good rest after a hard battle.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
激战之后好好休息，是快速恢复实力的好方法。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The Richard family runs various ways of training. Taking a rest is one of the most important training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族采用各种训练方式，休息也是其中最重要的一环。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The former heads of the Richard family have also taken enough rest after training. Well, it's too common to mention, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族历代家主训练后也会充分休息。这么平常的事，就不多说了。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The next training would be just as tough. You'd better take a rest now.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
接下来的训练同样会很艰苦。您最好现在先休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Everyone may know how one feels itching for more action after training. However, that is the time to take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
训练结束后，谁都会想继续大展身手。不过，那时候正该好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I feel that you must be raring to get some action. I guess it is the time to proceed with the next training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我看您已经跃跃欲试了。看来该开始下一阶段的训练了。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
How do you do? I have been waiting for you after being informed by the Chamberlain.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您好。侍从长告知我您会来，我一直在等您。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This it the room of the Richard family which has been controlling the military power of the kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这里是理查德家族的宅邸。这个家族一直掌握着王国的军事力量。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I have heard your name for that {0}, you are the hero in the subjugation of Morocc
scripts.translation:
[管家]
久仰大名，{0}。您是平定梦罗克的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Oh! I am sorry to take too much of your time. Inside the room, there is Po, the next head of the family, waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
啊！抱歉占用您这么多时间。房间里，家族继承人波正在等您。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Let me escort you inside.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
请允许我为您引路。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This it the room of the Richard family.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这里是理查德家族的房间。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Po, the next head of the family, is taking a rest. Please come back later.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
家族继承人波正在休息。请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Inside the room, there is Po, the next head of the family, waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
房间里，家族继承人波正在等您。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Have you met the next head of the family?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您见过家族继承人了？

scripts.text:
[Butler]
If the next head of the family meets you {0}, please...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
如果家族继承人要见您，{0}，请...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Oh! I am sorry about my bad manners. It is nothing. Please never mind...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
啊！刚才失礼了。没什么，请别放在心上...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I heard from Po the next head of the family that you are going to try the Richard battle training program.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我从家族继承人波那里听说，您打算尝试理查德战斗训练计划。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
For now, the training would be too overwhelming for you. You'd better learn the basics before proceeding with the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
目前的训练对您来说可能太难了。建议先打好基础，再开始训练。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I heard from Po the next head of the family that you are going to try the Richard battle training program.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我从家族继承人波那里听说，您打算尝试理查德战斗训练计划。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The training of the Richard family is differentiated from other training programs.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族的训练方式和其他训练计划不同。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You must have been getting yourself trained by hunting the monsters individually.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您之前应该一直是靠单独猎杀魔物来训练吧。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
From now on, you can be trained with hunting certain types of monsters such as human, animal, insect, fish, plant, demon, angel, nothing and dragon monsters.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
从现在开始，您可以针对特定种类的魔物训练，例如人形、动物、昆虫、鱼类、植物、恶魔、天使、不死、无形和龙族。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
It is supposed to be more effective to swing a sword than to say 100 words.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
与其说一百句话，不如挥一剑来得有效。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Good. Are you ready now?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
很好。您准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Hum, there seems to be an issue which cannot be resolved. Well, try again and if the same issue occurs, take a screenshot and send it to the admin team.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯，似乎出现了无法解决的问题。请再试一次。如果问题仍然存在，请截图并发送给管理团队。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Please select a training program to try.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
请选择一个训练计划进行尝试。

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Human
scripts.translation: 战士修行-人类

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Animal
scripts.translation: 战士修行-动物

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Insect
scripts.translation: 战士修行-昆虫

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Fish
scripts.translation: 战士修行-鱼类

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Plant
scripts.translation: 战士修行-植物

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Devil
scripts.translation: 战士修行-恶魔

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Angel
scripts.translation: 战士修行-天使

scripts.text: Warrior Discipline-Immortal

scripts.translation: 战士修行-虚无
