scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 human monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这项训练要求击杀50只等级不低于140的人形魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 animal monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这项训练要求击杀50只等级不低于140的动物魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 insect monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这项训练要求击杀50只等级不低于140的昆虫魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 fish monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这项训练要求击杀50只等级不低于140的鱼类魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 plant monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这项训练要求击杀50只等级不低于140的植物魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 demon monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这项训练要求击杀50只等级不低于140的恶魔魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 angel monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这项训练要求击杀50只等级不低于140的天使魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 Immortal monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这项训练要求击杀50只等级不低于140的不死魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 nothing monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这项训练要求击杀50只等级不低于140的无形魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This training involves hunting 50 dragon monsters of Level 140 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这项训练要求击杀50只等级不低于140的龙魔物。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Would you try this training?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您要尝试这项训练吗？

scripts.text: Try.
scripts.translation: 尝试

scripts.text: Do not try.
scripts.translation: 不尝试

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Hum... You don't like the contents of the training? Well, it's OK. Why don't you choose another training?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯...您不喜欢这项训练的内容吗？没关系，可以换一个训练项目。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You shouldn't let your guard down even when you feel that the training is too easy for your level. Good luck...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
即使觉得训练对您的等级来说很轻松，也不要掉以轻心。祝您顺利...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Congratulations on completing the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
恭喜您完成训练。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
If you keep training, you'll achieve the goal you want.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
坚持训练下去，终会达成您的目标。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
This is what I have prepared for the reward for completing training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这是为完成训练准备的奖励，请收下。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
We thank you for training with us since it benefits the Richard family. Don't feel pressured.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
感谢您参加我们的训练，这也让理查德家族受益。请别有压力。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You are participating in the training. Do you need anything?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您正在参与训练。有什么需要吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: About the way of training
scripts.translation: 关于训练方式

scripts.text: About the goal of training
scripts.translation: 关于训练目标

scripts.text: Give up the training.
scripts.translation: 放弃训练

scripts.text:
[Butler]
You should deal with the training like the actual fight! Do not let your guard down during the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
对待训练应当如同对待实战一样！在训练期间切勿掉以轻心。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The Richard family has always been concerned about the ways to produce more excellent warriors.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
理查德家族一直关注如何培养出更优秀的战士。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
One of the former heads of the family felt that the way to train with a certain monster had a limit.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
家族的前任家主之一认为，针对特定魔物的训练方式存在局限性。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The former and former head of the family... Oh! Just to clear things out, he is retired, but he is not dead.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
前任的前任家主...哦，先说明一下，他只是退休了，并没有去世。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Hum... Let's come back down to the business... He has come up with the method to train with the monster depending on the level of the trainee or the type of the monster.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯...言归正传...他想出了一种训练方法，可以根据学员等级或魔物种类来调整训练内容。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Well... The training began like that...
scripts.translation:
[管家]
嗯...训练就是这样开始的...

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The goal of the training... It is an easy and difficult question.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
训练的目标...说简单也简单，说难也难。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The most obvious goal must be getting stronger. I would have answered if I was younger.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
最显而易见的目标无疑是变强。如果我还年轻，我也会这样回答。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
However, I would like to answer that it is to protect the people around me.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
不过，我认为训练的目标是保护身边的人。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
The goal may be different for each warrior.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
对于每位战士来说，目标可能都不尽相同。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
I won't stop you from giving up. However, you should know that the progress of your training so far won't be reflected in the next training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我不会阻止您放弃。不过您要知道，到目前为止的训练进度不会保留到下一轮。

scripts.text: Do not give up.
scripts.translation: 继续训练

scripts.text: Give up.
scripts.translation: 放弃训练

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Good decision. You should deal with the training like the actual fight! Do not let your guard down during the training.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
明智的决定。对待训练应当如同对待实战一样！在训练期间切勿掉以轻心。

scripts.text:
[Butler]
Too bad. If you finished the training, you must have been able to reap the benefit of hard work.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
真遗憾。如果您完成了训练，本可以收获辛勤努力的成果。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation:
[管家]
真遗憾。如果您坚持完成训练，就能收获努力的成果了。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
An adventurer? I guess you need to try harder now.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
冒险者？看来你现在需要更加刻苦才行。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I'd like to take a rest now.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
冒险者？看来你还得再努力些。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
You must be an adventurer invited to the palace. I am taking a rest now. Talk to the butler in front of the door to make an appointment.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你一定是被邀请到宫殿的冒险者。我现在正在休息。请去门口找管家预约时间。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
That is the way to do it in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
在宫殿里就是这样办事的。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
You must be the adventurer who has made a great contribution in the subjugation of the dark lord. Your work is known in the palace as well.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你一定是在讨伐黑暗之王时立下大功的冒险者。宫里也流传着你的事迹。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Especially, us, the Richard family, are interested in your work.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
尤其是我们，理查德家族，对你的事迹非常感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Do you want to know why?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你想知道原因吗？

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Well, even if you don't want to know, I am going to say what I want to say anyway.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
好吧，就算你不想听，我也要把我想说的说清楚。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
In fact, it was not your will to come here. I am pretty sure that you must have come here since the his nibs called you. I understand that.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
其实你并不是自愿来这里的。我敢肯定，是那位大人召见了你。我能理解。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Although the adventurers may care less about the palace affairs, the Richard family is in charge of the military force of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
冒险者也许不太关心宫廷事务，但理查德家族负责掌管卢恩·米德加兹王国的军队。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
We produce many excellent warriors as well. Hum! I am curious all of a sudden. Have you heard of the warrior from the Richard family?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我们也培养了许多优秀的战士。哼！我突然有点好奇。你听说过理查德家族的战士吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是的，我听过

scripts.text: No, I haven't.
scripts.translation: 不，没见过

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Hahaha, I guess the name of Richard must be known to the adventurers as well.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
哈哈，我想“理查德”这个名字在冒险者中也是很有名的。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Oh, my. I must have been a braggart. The Richard family should try harder.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
哎呀，我是不是有点自吹自擂了？理查德家族还得更加努力才行。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Well, since it is not important, I guess we should let it pass. It's been a long time since I say this much. I am thirsty.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
算了，这不重要，就此打住吧。我好久没说这么多话了，口渴了。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Shall we take a rest before proceeding?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
在继续之前，我们要不要休息一下？

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Well, let's talk about the reason that the Richard family has been interested in you then.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
好吧，那我就说说理查德家族为什么对你感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
As known, the Richard family is producing outstanding warriors. We run a systematic training system to support that.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
众所周知，理查德家族培养出了杰出的战士。我们有一套系统化的训练体系来支持这一点。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I am not fond of such training, but I believe that it is an effective training program based on the know-how of the family.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我虽然不太喜欢这种训练，但我相信这是基于家族经验的有效训练方案。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Please listen up since I am about to get to the point.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
请仔细听，因为我马上要说到重点了。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I guess the adventurers were not that interested; however, there were many members of the royal family participating in the subjugation of the dark lord. I have been reported of your work from them.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我想冒险者对此不太关心。不过这次讨伐黑暗之王时，有不少王室成员参与其中，我从他们那里听说了你的事迹。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
When I was reported of the contributions you made, a question came to my mind. What if a free roaming adventure take part in the strict training system? What would happen? I got curious.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
听到你的功绩后，我心里冒出一个问题：如果让一位自由自在的冒险者参加严格的训练体系，会发生什么？我很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I would like to make a handsome payment if a renowned adventurer like you helps us.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
如果你这样一位著名的冒险者愿意帮助我们，我很乐意支付一笔可观的报酬。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I feel that it is an attractive offer. Would you challenge the warrior training system of the Richard family?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我觉得这是一个很有吸引力的提议。你愿意挑战理查德家族的战士训练体系吗？

scripts.text: I'll try.
scripts.translation: 我愿意试试

scripts.text: I decline.
scripts.translation: 我拒绝

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I guess the offer hasn't been attractive to you. I am sorry, but come back later when you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
看来这个提议对你没有吸引力。很抱歉，等你改变主意时再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Indeed! I like the quick decision. I value the spirit of challenge.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
太好了！我喜欢你果断的决定，也欣赏这种挑战精神。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Let me tell the butler about it. You can proceed with the training through him.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
让我告诉管家这件事。你可以通过他来进行训练。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Don't underestimate the butler who would guide you through the training.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
不要小看那位将指导你训练的管家。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
He is a member of the Richard family himself. He is an outstanding warrior.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
他本身就是理查德家族的一员。他是一位杰出的战士。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I wonder if you are happy with the rewards of the training.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我想知道你对训练的奖励是否满意。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
It would be difficult to offer you a payment higher than that for now. Please do it as if you are having a part-time job.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
目前我很难给出更高的报酬。就把它当作一份兼职来做吧。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
You may find it obvious. However, the more you get yourself trained, the more benefits that Richard family gets. We are willing to pay for it.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你可能觉得这是理所当然的。不过你训练得越多，理查德家族得到的好处也越多，我们愿意为此付报酬。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Oh! You must be participating in the training. Well, how do you find the training?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
哦！你一定正在参加训练。那么，你觉得训练怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I have participated in the training myself when I was younger. It brings back the good old memories.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我年轻时也参加过这种训练。这让我想起了美好的旧时光。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
There are a variety of training programs. Please choose what you'd like to participate. Well, the adventurers tend to do what they usually do.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
这里有各种训练项目，请选一个参加。冒险者通常都会选择自己熟悉的项目。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Accidents happen when you let your guard down. Always make sure to watch out.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
当你放松警惕时，意外就会发生。请务必时刻保持警惕。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
I believe the most important thing to a warrior is the spirit of challenge. The challenge to move on to the next level... It is the most important thing.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
我认为对战士来说，最重要的是挑战精神。挑战自我，迈向更高境界...这才是关键。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
A song of a warrior was very popular in the pub in Prontera. I am sad that I cannot hear it these days.
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
以前普隆德拉的酒馆里很流行一首《战士之歌》。最近听不到了，真遗憾。

scripts.text:
[Po Richard]
Do you like gambling by any chance? Doesn't the tension make you feel like a warrior in battle?
scripts.translation:
[波·理查德]
你喜欢赌博吗？那种紧张感，难道不像身处战场的战士吗？

scripts.translation:

请选择要使用的服务。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
There! Stop there!
Please go through the inspection for a security check.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
站住！别动！
请配合接受安全检查。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Please place your identification and personal belongings on this table and stand facing the wall...
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
请把证件和随身物品放在桌上，然后面朝墙站好...

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Martin! What are you doing?
Don't be rude to the guest to the room! I told you.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
马丁！你在做什么？
我说过别对我们的客人无礼！

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
It is for the safety of the queen.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
这是为了女王的安全。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
You are near the queen for security, not to chase away the guests discourteously.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
你在女王身边是为了保护她，而不是无礼地赶走客人。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
The palace is so hectic like this. How can we guard the queen with such an easygoing way of thinking!
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
宫里都乱成这样了，还抱着这种悠哉的想法，怎么保护女王！

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
We cannot help it during the Imperial Ordinance!
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
帝国法令期间，我们也只能照办！

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Now the Imperial Ordinance would just be...
scripts.translation:
[保镖 马丁]
如今的帝国法令简直就是...

scripts.text:
[Queen]
It is noisy out here.
scripts.translation:
[女王]
外面好吵。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Huh! Your majesty!
I am sorry.
We have a guest here.
scripts.translation:
[保镖 杰拉德]
啊！陛下！
非常抱歉。
这里有位客人。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
There! Stop there!
Please go through the inspection for a security check.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵马丁]
站住！停在那里！
请配合安全检查。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
Please place your identification and personal belongings on this table and stand facing the wall...
scripts.translation:
[卫兵马丁]
请把身份证明和随身物品放在这张桌子上，然后面朝墙站好……

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
Martin! What are you doing?
Don't be rude to the guest to the room! I told you.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵杰拉德]
马丁！你在做什么？
我说过，不要对来房间的客人无礼！

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
It is for the safety of the queen.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵马丁]
这是为了女王的安全。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
You are near the queen for security, not to chase away the guests discourteously.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵杰拉德]
你的职责是保护女王，不是无礼地赶走客人。

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Martin]
The palace is so hectic like this. How can we guard the queen with such an easygoing way of thinking!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵马丁]
宫殿里这么混乱，怎么能用这种散漫的态度保护女王！

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
We cannot help it during the Imperial Ordinance!
scripts.translation:
[卫兵杰拉德]

scripts.text:

It is supposed to be the characteristic of the Jahas.
scripts.translation:

这大概是雅哈一族的特征吧。

scripts.text:

I wonder if he is still there.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

我可不想再遇到这种事。

scripts.text:

Ha...
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Bodyguard Jerad]
She has been taking care of the state affairs alone. Not to mention the Royal Assembly...
She hasn't been able to sleep for days.
scripts.translation:

她一直独自处理国事，更别提还要主持皇家议会...
她已经好几天没睡好了。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

女王的妹妹“斯嘉丽·雅哈”刚才去了宴会厅。您或许能在那里见到她。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

皇家议会结束后，女王或许会把王位传给新国王，然后去斯嘉丽的城堡生活。

scripts.text:

I am a little worried for that I have been serving under the queen my entire life.

[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Welcome.
I am Queen Catherine D. Geoborg.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
欢迎。
我是凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
I am sorry if my knights have caused you trouble.
They are a little sensitive these days. Please understand.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
骑士们若给您添了麻烦，我很抱歉。
他们最近有些神经紧张，还请多包涵。

scripts.text: Ask about the Geoborg family.
scripts.translation: 询问关于乔博格家族的事

scripts.text: Leave the room.
scripts.translation: 离开房间

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
I see.
Come back anytime if you have any other questions.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
我明白了。
如果您还有其他问题，随时可以来找我。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Since the banquet for you heroes is being held in the Banquet Hall, please enjoy your time here.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
宴会厅正在为各位英雄举办宴会，请尽情享受。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
We, the Geoborg family, are the descendants of Tristan I who founded this world. Our family has produced numerous kings and knights for generations.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
我们乔博格家族是建立这个王国的特里斯坦一世的后裔，世世代代都诞生过许多国王和骑士。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
In the first Royal Assembly which was held, the forth prince Ernst was elected as a candidate. However, he has given up his position in the Royal Assembly this time due to several incidents.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
第一次皇家议会上，第四王子恩斯特当选王位候选人。但因为发生了几件事，他这次放弃了候选资格。

scripts.text: What do you mean by several incidents?
scripts.translation: 您说的几起事件是指什么？

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Oh... It slipped my tongue.
It is a little difficult to tell you about those incidents.
I'd rather you pretend I didn't say it.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
哦...是我失言了。
那些事不太方便向您透露。
就当我没说过吧。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
You have come here, but there isn't much that I can tell you.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
您来到这里，但我能告诉您的并不多。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
If you have more questions, you may ask Jerad and Martin here.
Please excuse me for not sharing more time with you due to some urgent duties.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
如果您还有问题，可以问问杰拉德和马丁。
我还有紧急公务，不能多陪您了，请见谅。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
You mean Prince Ernst?
Well?
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
您是指恩斯特王子？
是吗？

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
He comes here to say good morning and either helps me the work or does other things.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
他每天早上都会来向我请安，有时帮我处理公务，有时做些别的事。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Ever since the banquet started, he has been carrying his work to somewhere else.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
自从宴会开始，他就把公务带到别处处理了。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
He could be somewhere in the Banquet Hall.
scripts.translation:
[女王 凯瑟琳·D·乔博格]
他可能在宴会厅的某个角落。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Haven't you met Prince Ernst yet?
He just stopped by and went out again...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
您还没见过恩斯特王子吗？
他刚才来过，又出去了...

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
I am worried about the representative of our family wandering around like this.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
看到我们家族的代表这样四处奔走，我很担心。

scripts.text: Tell her about what you have heard.
scripts.translation: 告诉她你听到的传闻

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Oh...
Dear hero, please don't mind such stories much.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
哦...
亲爱的英雄，别太在意那些传闻。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
It is a problem that we, the Geoborg family, should get over ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
这是我们乔博格家族必须自己克服的问题。

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
The ink pad of the highest quality to be used in the royal debate room?
It is the clerk who writes down everything. Why are they buying luxury item that no one will ever use...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
要在皇家议事厅用最高级的印台？
记录员负责记下所有内容，为什么要买这种没人会用的奢侈品...

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
I have enough dresses to last my lifetime. Why do they keep making them...
A cutback!
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
我的裙子多得一辈子都穿不完，为什么还要一直做...
必须削减开支！

scripts.text:
[Queen Catherine D. Geoborg]
Hum.. Trade request from Marol Kingdom...
I should dispatch an envoy to take care of it soon...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·D·乔博格女王]
嗯...马罗尔王国提出了贸易请求...
得尽快派特使去处理...

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, what can I help you, dear adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
噢，有什么可以帮您的吗，亲爱的冒险者？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, what can I help you, dear adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
噢，有什么可以帮您的吗，亲爱的冒险者？

scripts.text: Ask about the Geoborg family.
scripts.translation: 询问关于乔博格家族的事

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Heh!
Is there no one around here who is curious about me?
Everyone who ever talks to me talk about that!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
哼！
就没人对我本人感兴趣吗？
每个来找我说话的人都只谈那个！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
Don't be startled.
It is a joke.
Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
噢！
别被吓到了。
这是个玩笑。
哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
As you know, the Geoborg family is the descendant of...
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
如你所知，乔博格家族是...的后裔。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Tristan I who have founded the kingdom!
Is there anyone who doesn't know the story in this kingdom?
Dear Lady Jaha.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
是创建这个王国的特里斯坦一世！
这个王国里还有谁不知道这段历史？
雅哈女士。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, my!
Lidion Geoborg!
Why are you out here in the Banquet Hall? You must not be feeling so well.
You should have been taking a rest in your manor!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
噢，天哪！
利迪翁·乔博格！
您怎么会在宴会厅？您身体一定不舒服吧。
您应该在您的宅邸里休息！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
I couldn't risk letting a lady of the Jaha family pretend to know about the Geoborg family. I couldn't just take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
我可不能放任雅哈家族的女士对乔博格家族的历史一知半解，还装作很了解。怎么能安心休息？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, my!
Lidion Geoborg!
Why are you out here in the Banquet Hall? You must not be feeling so well.
You should have been taking a rest in your manor!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
噢，天哪！
利迪翁·乔博格！
您怎么会在宴会厅？您身体一定不舒服吧。
您应该在您的宅邸里休息！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
I couldn't risk letting a lady of the Jaha family pretend to know about the Geoborg family. I couldn't just take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
我不能冒让雅哈家族的女士假装了解乔博格家族的风险。我不能就这样休息。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Phew, that old jerk!
He is younger than me and always tries to preach!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
唉，那个老顽固！
明明比我年轻，却总爱教训我！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
Well... For that reason, the Geoborg family will retire to a quiet life for a while as soon as the Royal Assembly is over.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
哦！
嗯...所以，皇家议会结束后，乔博格家族会暂时退下来，过些清静日子。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
I really hope that Catherine doesn't suffer from sorrow anymore.
That's why I fully support such decision!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
我真希望凯瑟琳别再受苦了。
所以我完全支持这个决定！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
However, Prince Ernst is nowhere to be found.
His aunt has come a long way to comfort her poor nephew, you know!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
不过恩斯特王子不见踪影。
我这个姨妈可是大老远赶来安慰可怜的外甥呢！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
My sister chased me away to the Banquet Hall, saying she was busy. And I cannot find my nephew either.
Eww...
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
姐姐说自己很忙，把我赶到宴会厅来了。我也找不到外甥。
真是的...

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
If you run into Ernst in the Banquet Hall, please tell him to come this way.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
如果你在宴会厅遇到恩斯特，请告诉他来这里一趟。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
However, Prince Ernst is nowhere to be found.
His aunt has come a long way to comfort her poor nephew, you know!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
不过，恩斯特王子却不知去向。
他的姨妈可是大老远赶来安慰他那可怜的外甥的，你知道吗！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
My sister chased me away to the Banquet Hall, saying she was busy. And I cannot find my nephew either.
Eww...
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
我姐姐把我赶到了宴会厅，说她在忙。我也找不到我外甥。
真是的...

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
If you run into Ernst in the Banquet Hall, please tell him to come this way.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
如果你在宴会厅遇到恩斯特，请告诉他来这里一趟。

scripts.text:
- You have too many items in possession.
Please organize your inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 你持有的物品太多了。
请整理你的背包并再试一次。-

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
Haven't you found him yet?
Should I ask Catherine?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
噢！
你还没找到他吗？
我应该问问凯瑟琳吗？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
That expression on your face... You must have heard what people say.
There must have been no good stories in particular...
Please don't mind such stories much.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
看你的表情...你肯定听到那些议论了。
大概也没听到什么好话...
别太在意那些流言。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Ernst must have been hiding from such whispers as well.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
恩斯特肯定也在躲避这些闲言碎语。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Well, I guess he needs some rest.
You hero, cheer up and enjoy the banquet!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
好吧，我想他需要休息一下。
英雄，振作起来，好好享受宴会吧！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
What a waste to let the banquet end like this!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
让宴会这样结束，真是浪费！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh, hero!
Are you having a good time?
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
噢，英雄！
你玩得开心吗？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
If you have some time to spare, please tell me some fun stories from your adventure.
I am sick of listening to Lidion's nitpicking.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
如果你有空，给我讲讲冒险时遇到的趣事吧。
我已经听腻了利迪翁的挑剔。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
We, the Geoborg family, is one of the seven royal families, but we are the creme de la creme for producing the highest number of kings in the history.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
我们乔博格家族是七大王族之一，也是历史上诞生国王最多的家族，堪称王族中的翘楚。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
In fact, we are settled in Prontera, the center of the Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
我们的家族扎根于卢恩·米德加兹的中心——普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Despite the series of unfortunate events regarding the princes after the death of King Tristan III,
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
特里斯坦三世国王去世后，王子们接连遭遇不幸，

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Prince Ernst Geoborg was elected as the most regnant candidate in the last Royal Assembly. It shows just influential the Geoborg family is.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
而恩斯特·乔博格王子在上一次皇家议会上当选最有希望继位的候选人。这足以证明乔博格家族的影响力。

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
He has given up from the position.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
他已经放弃候选人的身份了。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
What?
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
什么？

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
I said!
Prince Ernst gave up his position as the candidate to the throne.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
我说！
恩斯特王子已经放弃王位候选人的身份了。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
What a nonsense!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
真是胡闹！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Oh!
You didn't know!
You must have been separated from the outside world for too long!
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
哦！
你不知道吗？
你一定和外界隔绝太久了！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Arghhhh!
I won't let this punk... Ernst....!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
啊...！
我绝不会让那个小子...恩斯特...！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Punk?
Even if you are an elder of the family, he is still a prince. You should extend him every courtesy.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
小子？
即使你是家族长老，他终究还是王子。你应该对他以礼相待。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Arghhhh!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
啊...！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Arghhhh!
I won't let this punk... Ernst....!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
啊...！
我绝不会让那个小子...恩斯特...！

scripts.text:
[Scarlet Jaha]
Punk?
Even if you are an elder of the family, he is still a prince. You should extend him every courtesy.
scripts.translation:
[斯嘉丽·雅哈]
小子？
即使你是家族长老，他终究还是王子。你应该对他以礼相待。

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Arghhhh!
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
啊...！

scripts.text:
[Lidion Geoborg]
Tut...
Letting anybody in like this... The dignity of the palace has fallen down to the ground.
scripts.translation:
[利迪翁·乔博格]
真是的...
就这样任由任何人进出...宫殿的威严都荡然无存了。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Did you hear the story?
The skeleton of King Tristan III has been found.
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
你听说了吗？
特里斯坦三世国王的骸骨被发现了。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Oh my!
Gosh!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
天哪！
真不敢相信！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
It is a secret. Don't tell anyone.
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
这是秘密，别告诉任何人。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
...So the princes must have been poisoned...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
...所以那些王子一定是被毒死的...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
What on earth!
Well, in the last Royal Assembly...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
怎么会这样！
说起来，上次皇家议会的时候...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Ha!
He has given up the royal authority like that!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
哈！
他就这样放弃了王权！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Doesn't he even care for the people of his family?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
他连自己的族人都不关心了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Your voice is too loud!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
你的声音太大了！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
No...
I didn't say anything wrong.
Did I?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
不...
我又没说错。
是吧？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
How can he decide such a major issue as he wants?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
这么重大的事情，他怎么能想怎么决定就怎么决定？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
I knew it. He has been hanging out with that punk from the third-rate family too long...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
我就知道。他和那个三流家族的小子来往太久了...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
So is the queen who is handling all the matters of the palace now?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
那么现在是王后在处理宫里的事务吗？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
She hasn't showed her presence to the public so far...
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
她至今都没有公开露面...

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
How foolish it is to give up the regal power like that!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
就这样放弃王权，真是太愚蠢了！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
I won't ever let go of such power!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
我可绝不会放弃这样的权力！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Hey, you!
Not anyone can have such power.
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
喂，你！
这种权力可不是谁都能拥有的。

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Why not?
I am free to dream!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
为什么不行？
我有做梦的自由！

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Is the Geoborg family cursed?
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
乔博格家族是受诅咒了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mumbling Sound]
Shh!
You shouldn't say such a thing so easily!
scripts.translation:
[喃喃细语]
嘘！
这种话可不能随便说！

scripts.text:
[Bachelor]
The women in the line here are so scary.
They curse, push and fight...
scripts.translation:
[单身汉]
这里排队的女人真可怕。
她们又骂又推，还会打架...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why don't you just go back then?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你干脆回去不就好了？

scripts.text:
[Bachelor]
Are you telling me to go back when Jurgen is right inside of the door?
I won't!
scripts.translation:
[单身汉]
尤尔根就在门里面，你居然叫我回去？
我才不回去！

scripts.text:
[Bachelor]
I won't go before seeing the elegant and luminous presence of him!
I have come here from Payon to meet Jurgen!
scripts.translation:
[单身汉]
不亲眼见到他优雅而耀眼的身姿，我绝不离开！
我可是从斐扬专程赶来见尤尔根的！

scripts.text:
[Miss]
Who was it? Who pretended to be close to Katrin and went along with her? Come out here! We have made a pact not to stand out!
scripts.translation:
[小姐]
是谁？是谁假装和卡特琳亲近，还跟着她混进来的？快出来！我们明明约好不引人注目的！

scripts.text:
[Miss]
Jurgen treats us all the same. We should have a sense of fair play.
Who ever it was, turn yourself in!
scripts.translation:
[小姐]
尤尔根对我们一视同仁。我们也该公平竞争。
不管是谁，快出来承认！

scripts.text:
[Womenfolk]
I won't let anyone monopolize Jurgen! The heaven may forgive, but I won't!
scripts.translation:
[妇女们]
我不许任何人独占尤尔根！老天或许会原谅你，我可不会！

scripts.text:
[Womenfolk]
Jurgen belongs to all of us! No one should have him to oneself! I won't let anyone to do that!
scripts.translation:
[妇女们]
尤尔根属于我们所有人！谁也不能独占他！我绝不允许这种事发生！

scripts.text:
[Gyusoo]
It is no use getting a ticket number... It is just too difficult to wait for my turn.
scripts.translation:
[圭秀]
拿到号码牌也没用...等到我都不知要排到什么时候。

scripts.text:
[Gyusoo]
When will Jurgen come out?
When will be my turn to see him?
scripts.translation:
[圭秀]
尤尔根什么时候出来？
什么时候才轮到我见他？

scripts.text:
[Bachelorette]
There! If you are a newbie, don't be so naive and try to fit in here!
scripts.translation:
[单身女子]
喂！新来的就别这么天真，以为能轻易混进这里！

scripts.text:
[Bachelorette]
[Bachelorette]
Hey, don't you push me there! Stand in the line. Isn't it your first time here to see Jurgen?
scripts.translation:
[单身女子]
[单身女子]
喂，别推我！好好排队。你是第一次来见尤尔根吗？

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Hey, you lady! Don't push!
Stay in the line!
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
喂，那位女士！别推人！
排好队！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
There was this lady who was carried out with a broken ankle from pushing!
It is all for your own good!
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
刚才有位女士因为推搡被抬了出去，脚踝都摔断了！
这也是为你们好！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Ha, I am already feeling tired as always.
I didn't know that women were so strong before.
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
哈，我还是一如既往地累。
以前真不知道女人们这么有劲。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
I started yesterday and realized why the people who had worked here before quit.
Despite being with so many ladies here, I am not happy at all.
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
我昨天才来这里工作，这才明白之前在这里工作的人为什么会辞职。
虽然身边有这么多女士，我却一点也高兴不起来。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
As you see, there are no guards guarding the doord to other family's residences.
However, there are too many infiltrators to the Wigner residence who get in there to see Jurgen. Now the door is guarded at all times.
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
你看，通往其他家族宅邸的门都没有卫兵把守。
可是，想闯进维格纳宅邸见尤尔根的人太多了，所以现在这里一直有人看守。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Oh, be quiet there!
It is too noisy that Jurgen cannot take his beauty rest!
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
喂，那边安静点！
吵得尤尔根都没法好好休息了！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
It is not for my sake, but for Jurgen.
It would make you sad if Jurgen is unable to sleep, right? So be quiet!
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
我不是为了自己，是为了尤尔根。
要是尤尔根睡不好，你也会难过吧？所以安静点！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Oh, wait there! Stop there!
Aren't you the one who has infiltrated the room before? You don't have to run hiding your face! Come back here!
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
喂，站住！别跑！
你是不是之前潜入过房间的那个人？不用遮着脸逃跑，给我回来！

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
She went off again. She sure is fast.
I am glad that my own sister doesn't come to a place like this.
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
她又跑了。真够快的。
还好我妹妹不会来这种地方。

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
When I applied to become a guard, I wanted to keep the palace safe with my own hands...
Never did I know that I would end up here...
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
当初我申请当卫兵，是想亲手守护宫殿的安全...
没想到最后竟然被派到这种地方...

scripts.text:
[Strong Guards]
Hey, you! There! Stand in the line! Stop there! You shouldn't block the way!
If you keep doing that, I'll stop you from coming here!
scripts.translation:
[强壮的卫兵]
喂，你！那边那个！排好队！站住！别挡路！
再这样，我就不让你进来了！

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, although I respect your hard work going through all the obstacles and hardships, it is still a little too early for you to be here.
I hope I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，我很敬佩你一路克服重重困难来到这里，但现在还不是你来的时候。
希望之后还能见到你。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Who are you?
Only the people with permission can enter this place. Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
你是什么人？
只有得到许可的人才能进入这里。请离开。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, welcome to the Wigner family. My name is ^0000cdLevuiere Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，欢迎来到维格纳家族。我叫^0000cd勒维埃尔·维格纳^000000。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
I am honored by your visit while you are attending the banquet held for you, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，您专程参加为您举办的宴会，还抽空来拜访我，我深感荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
This banquet carries more meaning than celebration since the Royal Assembly is conducted at the same time. Did you hear that?
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
这场宴会不只是庆祝活动，因为皇家议会也在同时举行。您听说了吗？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
There is a candidate from our family who participates in the Royal Assembly as well. Would you like to meet him?
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
我们家族也有人参加皇家议会。您想见见他吗？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
She is the lady of the Wigner house, ^0000cdCatherine Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
她是维格纳家的女主人，^0000cd凯瑟琳·维格纳^000000。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
How do you do? Please make yourself at home while you are staying with us, the Wigner family. Please let me know if you experience any inconvenience here.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
您好。您在维格纳家做客期间，请尽管把这里当成自己家。如果有任何不便，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
We, Wigners, will support as much as possible for your convenience, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
亲爱的冒险者，我们维格纳家会尽力为您提供方便。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please visit our manor too if you have the time, dear adventurer. You are always welcome.
Where is ^0000cdJurgen^000000 now?
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
亲爱的冒险者，有空也请来我们的宅邸坐坐，随时欢迎您。
^0000cd尤尔根^000000现在在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Are you looking for me?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你在找我吗？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
There you are! Dear adventurer, this is the ^0000cdheir of the Wigner family^000000, and the ^0000cdcandidate for the throne^000000 participating in the Royal Assembly this time.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
你来了！亲爱的冒险者，这位是^0000cd维格纳家族的继承人^000000，也是这次参加皇家议会的^0000cd王位候选人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Hello. My name is ^0000cdJurgen Wigner^000000. It is very nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你好，我叫^0000cd尤尔根·维格纳^000000。很高兴认识你。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, please make yourself home here. If you need anything or find anything inconvenient, please let us know anytime.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，请在这里尽管把这里当成自己家。如果需要什么，或觉得有任何不便，随时告诉我们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your hospitality.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢你们的款待。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Then, please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
那么，失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Tut, I am worried that he lacks sociability. He would have to meet a lot of people as the heir of the house, you know. Dear adventurer, please excuse my son's discourtesy.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
唉，我担心他不太擅长交际。作为家族继承人，他以后得和很多人打交道。亲爱的冒险者，请原谅我儿子的失礼。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
If time allows, would you like to meet our children? They have been excited to meet the hero who defeated Morocc in the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
如果时间允许，您愿意见见我们的孩子吗？他们一直很期待见到那位在宴会上击败梦罗克的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Then please make yourself at home and take a look around, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
那么，亲爱的冒险者，请随意参观，四处看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, please make yourself home and take your time looking around here.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，请把这里当成自己家，慢慢参观吧。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
If time allows, would you please tell our children the stories of your adventures? It would be an invaluable experience for them.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
如果您有空，可以给我们的孩子讲讲冒险故事吗？这对他们来说会是无比珍贵的经历。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Then, have a restful time.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
那么，请好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, did you meet the children? I would love to have some tea with you and listen to your stories if you are available.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，您见过孩子们了吗？如果您有空，我很想和您喝杯茶，听听您的故事。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
We like to hear the stories of adventurers very much.
Those adventures are valuable experiences that money cannot buy.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
我们很喜欢听冒险者讲述他们的经历。
那些冒险是金钱买不到的宝贵经验。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I wonder if our children have observed their manners though. We must have spoiled them for that they sometimes act so imprudently.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
不知道孩子们有没有注意礼仪。他们有时会那么鲁莽，想必是我们太宠他们了。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I am trying to warn them a little these days, Please excuse their behaviors if they have done anything rude to you.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
最近我一直在提醒他们。如果他们有哪里冒犯了您，还请多包涵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not at all. Jurgen seemed to have grown since my last visit.
Katrin and Isaac impressed me as well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不会的。尤尔根看起来比我上次来时成熟了不少。
卡特琳和艾萨克也让我印象深刻。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
We have been too easy on them.
We are ashamed that we were not prepared properly for the Royal Assembly last time.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
我们对他们太宽容了。
上次皇家议会时准备不足，我们实在惭愧。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
It is not important whether he becomes the king or not.
If he is a king material, he will be. If not, he doesn't have to be the king. I don't want to stress him out for that.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
他能不能当上国王并不重要。有国王的资质，自然会成为国王；没有的话，也不必勉强。我不想因此给他压力。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Don't you have any ambitions? What a glory would it be if we turn out a king from our family of our generation!
Since our ancestors founded this kingdom, we deserve to produce a king.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
您就没有一点野心吗？如果我们这一代能出一位国王，该是多大的荣耀！
我们的祖先既然建立了这个王国，我们也理应为王国诞生一位国王。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
The king is a hollow position. It only comes with responsibilities?
Haven't I told you before? Did you forget?
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
国王不过是个虚位，伴随它的只有责任。
我以前不是跟你说过吗？你忘了？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
If our family turns out a king, much of our fortune will be spent. Once, our family has really suffered from it.
Near the king, there are always a swarm of pesky flies.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
如果我们家族出了国王，就得耗费大量财富。我们家曾经因此吃过大苦头。
国王身边总围着一群讨厌的苍蝇。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
You know, it could be the exact opposite.
It may reinforce our family.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
您知道吗，也可能恰恰相反。
这或许能增强我们家族的势力。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Now there are Katrin and Isaac who can back up Jurgen.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
现在还有卡特琳和艾萨克可以辅佐尤尔根。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Hum... Isaac.
Thinking of him makes me confident.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
嗯...艾萨克。
一想到他，我就有信心了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You must trust Isaac quite a lot.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来您很信任艾萨克。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Oh, we must have left you out of the conversation, dear adventurer.
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
哎呀，亲爱的冒险者，看来我们把您晾在一边了。
真抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not at all. I have been enjoying the conversation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没关系，我很享受这段谈话。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Now that you mention it, how do you find our third child, Isaac?
He is the most Wigner-like one among the children.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
说起来，您觉得我们的第三个孩子艾萨克怎么样？
在几个孩子中，他最有维格纳家族的风范。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
While Jurgen is interested in the looks, he doesn't really care for money or the throne...
If Katrin was a son, I would have gladly leave everything to her.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
尤尔根很在意外表，却不怎么在乎金钱或王位...
要是卡特琳是个男孩，我会很乐意把一切都交给她。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Fortunately, the third child who used to be a mischievous boy has grown up to be suitable for the name of Wigner.
Not that the other two are inadequate.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
幸好，那个曾经调皮捣蛋的三儿子已经长大成人，配得上维格纳这个姓氏了。
当然，另外两个孩子也并非不够格。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I know what you mean.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白您的意思。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Nevertheless, don't talk like that in front of the children. It is not good to favor a child.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
不过，请别在孩子们面前这么说。偏袒其中一个孩子可不好。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
As a member of the Wigner family, one must be able to cope with criticism.
They should be able to determine what's right upon listening to the words of other people. Also, they need to be able to deal with the hard truths.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
维格纳家族的人必须学会面对批评。
他们要能听取别人的意见、判断是非，也要能接受残酷的事实。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please don't talk like that in front of the children.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
请别在孩子们面前这么说。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
I never talk to them like this you know.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
你知道的，我从来不会这样对他们说。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Anyways, Isaac seems busy doing something these days. Do you know what he is doing?
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
对了，艾萨克最近好像一直在忙。你知道他在做什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
I heard that he is doing something with the third son of the Roegenburg family. You don't need to worry about Isaac. He knows how to take care of himself.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
我听说他在和罗根堡家族的三公子一起做事。别担心艾萨克，他知道怎么照顾自己。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Arghhhhhhhhh!
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
啊啊啊啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
^0000cdKatrin?^000000

[Catherine]
^0000cdKatrin?^000000 Has something happened to my baby? I should get going...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
^0000cd卡特琳？^000000我的宝贝出什么事了？我得赶紧过去...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You two stay here. It might be dangerous. Let me go take a look first.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们两个留在这里，可能会有危险。我先过去看看。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Has something happened to our child, I mean, Katrin?
Shouldn't I go down there myself?
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
我们的孩子出事了吗？我是说卡特琳。
我不该亲自下去看看吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It could be dangerous. Please wait here for a minute.
I'll go.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那里可能有危险。请在这里稍等片刻。
我去看看。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, welcome.
I asked what had happened to the children, but they didn't tell me.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，欢迎回来。
我问过孩子们发生了什么事，但他们没有告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Are they hiding something bad from me...?
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
他们是不是瞒着我什么不好的事...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, they are not. You don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没有，他们没瞒您什么。您不用担心。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Then please tell me what it is about.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
那请告诉我到底是怎么回事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If they have decided not to tell you, it is not my story to tell.
Since I have to run some errands, I should get going now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然他们决定不告诉您，那就不该由我来说。
我还有些事要办，先告辞了。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, you seem busy.
Is it about what our children have asked you?
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，您看起来很忙。
是在处理孩子们拜托您的事吗？

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
We have decided not to question it any more.
They have grown up, but we still tend to baby them too much...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
我们决定不再追问了。
孩子们虽然已经长大，我们却还是总把他们当小孩子一样宠着...

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Anyways, if you need help, please let me know anytime.
And thank you for helping our children.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
总之，如果您需要帮助，随时告诉我。
也谢谢您帮助我们的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, I have heard the story from the children.
They didn't go into all the details, but I heard that they owed you a huge favor.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，我已经听孩子们说了这件事。
他们没讲太多细节，不过我听说他们欠了您一个大人情。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
The children are getting along so much better these days.
Not that they were on bad terms, but now they seen to care for one another more. I am so glad.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
孩子们最近相处得融洽多了。
他们以前关系也不差，但现在似乎更关心彼此了。真让人高兴。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
You seem to be the messenger of luck to our family.
It is our family tradition to keep a person like you close and treat well.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
您似乎是给我们家带来好运的人。
按照家族传统，我们会亲近并善待像您这样的人。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please visit our manor after the banquet is over.
We would be honored to have you as a guest to our home.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
宴会结束后，请来我们的庄园做客。
能邀请您来家里，我们深感荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Hello, dear adventurer. Welcome!
We are honored by your visit to the Wigner family.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
您好，亲爱的冒险者，欢迎！
维格纳家族很荣幸能迎来您的拜访。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please let me know if you experience any inconvenience here.
As the lady of the house I would make your stay as pleasant as possible.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
如果您在这里遇到任何不便，请告诉我。
作为女主人，我会尽力让您住得舒适。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
You may talk to the head of the family standing next to me. His name is Levuiere Wigner.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
您可以和我身旁的家主谈谈。他叫勒维埃尔·维格纳。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Have you met our children? Having a conversation with you would be an invaluable experience for our children, dear adventurer.
They haven't been through any trouble growing up so we feel that they lack in various life experiences.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
您见过我们的孩子了吗？亲爱的冒险者，能和您交谈，对他们来说会是宝贵的经历。
他们成长过程中没遇到过什么波折，所以我们觉得他们缺少各种人生阅历。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Since I am married to a man from the family which has founded this country, I want to raise my children worthy of the name. However, my husband is not interested in fame and power.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
我既然嫁给了这个国家的创建家族，就想把孩子培养得配得上这个姓氏。可我丈夫对名声和权势并不感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I feel very sorry about it.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
对此我深感抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
However, I tend to let our children to whatever they want to do, which makes me wonder if I have spoiled them...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
不过，我总是让孩子们想做什么就做什么，现在不禁怀疑自己是不是太宠他们了...

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I'd like to hear your stories for that.
It is always a great joy to listen to the stories of the people who have gone through a lot of experiences.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
我也想听听您的故事。
听有丰富阅历的人讲故事，总是令人开心。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
What if anything has happened to my baby, Katrin?
I'd better I go down there myself.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
我的孩子卡特琳是不是出什么事了？
我还是亲自下去看看吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It could be dangerous, please wait here for a minute.
Let me go down there and see what has happened.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那里可能有危险，请在这里稍等片刻。
我下去看看发生了什么事。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I hope everything is OK.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
希望一切平安无事。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear adventurer, welcome.
I asked what had happened to the children, but they didn't tell me.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
亲爱的冒险者，欢迎。
我问过孩子们发生了什么事，但他们没告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Are they hiding something bad from me...?
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
他们是不是瞒着我什么不好的事...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, they are not. You don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没有，他们没瞒您什么。您不用担心。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Then please tell me what it is about.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
那请告诉我到底是怎么回事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If they have decided not to tell you, it is not my story to tell.
Since I have to run some errands, I should get going now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然他们决定不告诉您，那就不该由我来说。
我还有些事要办，先告辞了。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
I wonder if our children haven't bothered you much. Although we are very curious, we have decided not to question it any more.
They have grown up, but we still tend to baby them too much...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
不知道孩子们有没有给您添麻烦。虽然我们很好奇，但已经决定不再追问了。
他们都长大了，我们却还是忍不住把他们当小孩子宠着...

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Anyways, if you need help, please let me know anytime.
And thank you for helping our children.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
总之，如果您需要帮助，随时告诉我。
也谢谢您帮助我们的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
For some reason, our children have become very close to one another.
I think it is all thanks to you.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
不知为何，孩子们最近变得亲密多了。
我想这都要归功于您。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please visit our manor after the banquet is over.
Please give us the opportunity to treat you, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
宴会结束后，请来我们的庄园坐坐。
亲爱的冒险者，请让我们有机会好好款待您。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You seem to have a lot of luggage. Are you OK?
It looks a lot and large.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你带的行李好像很多，没问题吧？
看起来又多又大。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
要不要先收拾掉一些？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Are you a fan of mine? Did you make an appointment? If you are a guest of mine, why don't you go see my father over there?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你是我的粉丝吗？预约了吗？既然是我的客人，怎么不去那边见见我父亲？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, I am glad that you are still here. Sorry about my bad manners earlier. I wanted to have more conversation with you. However, if I make any mistakes while I talk in front of my mother, I get scolded.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，很高兴你还在这里。刚才失礼了，抱歉。我本想和你多聊一会儿，可在母亲面前说错话的话，我就会挨骂。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Not that she would be harsh on my, but it still kind of bothers me so I had to leave. I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
她倒不会对我太严厉，但我还是会有点在意，所以只好先离开了。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, since you are already here, may I introduce my family to you? This elegant lady here is my sister, ^0000cdKatrin Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，既然你已经来了，我可以向你介绍家人吗？这位优雅的女士是我的姐姐，^0000cd卡特琳·维格纳^000000。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You shouldn't call me your sister, but the first daughter of the Wigner family in this occasion.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
这种场合别叫我姐姐，应该称呼我为维格纳家的长女。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Dear adventurer, I am honored to meet you. I hope you have a restful stay with the Wigners.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
亲爱的冒险者，很荣幸见到你。希望你在维格纳家住得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
This is my brother, ^0000cdIsaac Wigner^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
这是我的弟弟，^0000cd艾萨克·维格纳^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
He is the youngest child of the Wigner family. Unlike my sister and I who are not interested in the family business, he is a prodigy who will shine the name of the Wigner family.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
他是维格纳家最小的孩子。我和姐姐都对家族事业没兴趣，而他是个天才，将来一定能让维格纳家族扬名。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Hello? I am Isaac Wigner. What a trouble you are going through to visit a boring family like this. I hope you have fun here if you can...
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
你好？我是艾萨克·维格纳。让你特地跑来拜访我们这个无聊的家族，真是辛苦了。希望你在这里玩得开心...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Isaac, I have warned you about such manner of speaking before.
You are also being disrespectful to Jurgen who has just introduced you. Are you going to put us all to shame?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
艾萨克，我以前就提醒过你，说话要注意礼貌。
你刚才对介绍你的尤尔根也很不敬，难道想让我们全家蒙羞吗？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
It is a joke, just a joke! Sister, you are so inflexible.
In a dreary atmosphere like this, this adventurer deserves to laugh a little, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我只是开个玩笑，开个玩笑！姐姐，你也太死板了。
气氛这么沉闷，总得让这位冒险者笑一笑吧？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You are not being funny but disrespectful to the guest. Dear adventurer, please excuse the bad manners. I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
这不是幽默，而是对客人的不敬。亲爱的冒险者，请原谅他的无礼。实在抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
By the way, I want to go home as soon as possible. This place is too narrow and gloomy.
I would like to be in the Banquet Hall at least.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
对了，我想尽快回家。这里又窄又阴暗。
至少让我待在宴会厅吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
There must be a lot of people who want to see me. I am obliged to show my face.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
一定有很多人想见我，我有义务露个面。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
My presence will light up the dark palace, you know. I should entertain the bored people there.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我的光彩能照亮这座昏暗的宫殿，你知道的。我应该去招待那些无聊的人。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You are insulting the Royal Assembly. You need to do your best. Royal Assembly is more sacred that you think.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你这是在侮辱皇家议会。你必须认真对待。皇家议会比你想象的更加神圣。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You shouldn't forget that you are one of the candidates for the throne who will lead the kingdom with the seven royal families.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
别忘了，你是王位候选人之一，将来要和七大家族一起领导王国。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
It means that you shouldn't act like a child. I have told you not to take the weight of your responsibility and duty so lightly.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
所以别再像个孩子一样。别把自己的责任和义务看得这么轻。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Of course, I know that well. That's why I have tidied up my looks and fixed my hair perfectly.
I tried not to loosen up, you know.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
当然，我很清楚。所以我才整理好仪容，把头发打理得一丝不乱。
我可没有松懈哦。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You need to be able to groom yourself up well to take care of greater matters.
Of course, I am well-prepared.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
想要承担更重要的事务，就得先把自己打理得体面。
当然，我已经准备好了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Would you like to see my new cape?
It goes with the color of my eyes. It would definitely brighten up the palace.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
想看看我的新斗篷吗？
它和我的眼睛很相配，一定能让宫殿更加亮眼。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh, there he goes again. I should get going now. Dear adventurer, I would like to see you later.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
他又开始了。我先走一步。亲爱的冒险者，希望稍后还能见到你。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh, not again. Dear adventurer, you should be used to this to have a conversation with my brother at our home.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
唉，又来了。亲爱的冒险者，想在我们家和我弟弟交谈，你得先习惯这一套。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Dear adventurer, I guess that is it for today. If you are not busy, ^0000cdwhy don't you go have a cup of tea with our parents^000000?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
亲爱的冒险者，今天就到这里吧。如果你不忙，^0000cd不如和我们的父母喝杯茶^000000？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
My parents love to hear the stories of adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我的父母很喜欢听冒险者讲故事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is a good idea. Please excuse me then.
[Jurgen]
Our ^0000cdparents^000000 are over there. They'd like to talk to you.
By the way, are there many people waiting outside the door?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好主意，那我先失陪了。
[尤尔根]
我们的^0000cd父母^000000在那边，他们想和你聊聊。
对了，门外有很多人在等吗？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
They are waiting for me. However, it is a little tiring to meet them all one by one.
It is very demanding to guard the world's peace with my beauty.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
他们都在等我。不过逐一接见他们也挺累的。
用美貌守护世界和平，可真不容易。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Our ^0000cdparents^000000 are over there. They'd like to talk to you.
By the way, are there many people waiting outside the door?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我们的^0000cd父母^000000在那边，他们想和你聊聊。
对了，门外有很多人在等吗？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
They are waiting for me. However, it is a little tiring to meet them all one by one.
It is very demanding to guard the world's peace with my beauty.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
他们都在等我。不过逐一接见他们也挺累的。
用美貌守护世界和平，可真不容易。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It seems that my sister has lost something. I couldn't understand her words since she was in such a hurry.
Would you please ask her what it is about?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
姐姐好像丢了什么东西。她刚才太着急，我没听清楚。
能帮我问问是怎么回事吗？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Whatever she has lost, it must be very valuable to her. I feel that she'd better get someone to help her to find it.
Well, then she would be scolded by our father though...
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
不管她丢了什么，对她来说一定很重要。我觉得最好找人帮她一起找。
不过这样一来，父亲可能会责骂她...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I wonder if you can look into it as fast and quietly as possible.
My sister's fate depends on your hands.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你能不能尽快、悄悄地查清楚？
我姐姐的命运就掌握在你手里了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It seems that she may drop dead if she doesn't find whatever she has lost.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
要是找不到丢的东西，她可能会急得昏过去。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, you are here. How did it go?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，你来了。情况怎么样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. Everyone has seen it there, but no one has seen it taken.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没有。大家都看见它在那儿，却没人看到是谁拿走的。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
How about the one who has taken it? Oh, right, the one who has taken it wouldn't say so.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
那拿走东西的人呢？哦，对了，拿走的人当然不会承认。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way, people seem to have a strange prejudice about Katrin. I know the words they say are not true, but you'd better to something about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
对了，大家似乎对卡特琳有些奇怪的偏见。我知道他们说的不是真的，但你最好想办法处理一下。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What do you meant?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你什么意思？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, please don't take it wrong. Some people have said that Katrin may have done it to draw attention or they cannot trust Katrin.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
别误会。有些人说卡特琳是为了引人注意才这么做的，也有人说不信任她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What a nonsense! Phew... This is exactly why I have told her to open her heart to others and talk more...
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
真是一派胡言！唉...所以我才一直劝她敞开心扉，多和别人交流...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Why should I do that? I don't care about the people who don't know me well anyway.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我为什么要那样做？我本来就不在乎那些不了解我的人。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Sister, when did you come back?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
姐姐，你什么时候回来的？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I came here just a minute ago. However, I heard what you said. So, do you think it's my fault to hear such things?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我刚回来。不过我听到了你们说的话。所以，你觉得别人这么说是我的错吗？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You are to blame to a certain level. Look at me. I always to treat others with all my hearts. They all love me for that.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
这件事你也有一定责任。看看我，我总是全心全意地对待别人，所以大家都喜欢我。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Do you think people like you for your attitude?
Don't you remember the trouble that all the family members have been through because of your attitude issue during the Royal Assembly?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你以为大家喜欢的是你的待人方式吗？
你不记得皇家议会时，因为你的态度问题，全家人都惹上了多少麻烦吗？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
If it is not my attitude, then for what?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
如果不是因为我的态度，那是因为什么？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Do you mean that it is for my looks?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你是说因为我的长相？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Can you deny it? Since you were young, when you are doing nothing, no, even when you are rude, people have been nice to you.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你能否认吗？从小到大，你什么都不用做——不，就算你态度恶劣，大家也会对你很好。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
They all smiled at you to please the pretty-looking heir of the Wigner family, the candidate to the throne.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
他们都对你笑脸相迎，只为了讨好维格纳家族那位英俊的继承人、王位候选人。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You say that is for my looks?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你是说大家喜欢我只是因为长相？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Looks have played an important role. You cannot deny it. Looks are part of your talent, right?
Especially, in our family. You should know it by now.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
长相确实起了很大作用，你无法否认。外表也是你的天赋之一，对吧？
尤其是在我们家，你应该早就明白了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Even if it's all for my looks, have I ever wanted it to be that way?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
就算大家都是因为我的长相才喜欢我，我又什么时候希望事情变成这样的？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Even when I am not doing anything wrong, I am always compared to my handsome brother, and bad rumors follow me. Do you think I have ever wanted it to be that way?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
就算我没做错什么，大家也总拿我和英俊的哥哥比较，关于我的坏话也总是传个不停。你觉得我想这样吗？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
That's why you need to open up to others and act nice...
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
所以你才应该敞开心扉，对别人友善一点...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
The best way not to cause misunderstanding is to be silent. When I don't talk, I don't make a mistake.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
避免被误解的最好办法就是沉默。不说话，就不会说错话。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
That doesn't always work. About what happened today, you know. Even when you were silent...
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
沉默也不总是有用。就像今天的事，你明明什么都没说...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I am already doing my best! You know what? The darkest shadow is always right next to the brightest light! It is just like me next to you! I have been trying!
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我已经尽力了！你知道吗？最深的阴影总在最耀眼的光芒旁边，就像我站在你身边一样！我一直都在努力！

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
However, people don't see who I really am! What else should I do now?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
可大家根本看不到真正的我！我还能怎么办？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Both of you should calm down.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们两个都先冷静一下。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Yes. Whatever it is, you'd better calm down. I could hear you yelling at each other from the other end of the hallway.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
没错，不管发生什么，你们都该冷静点。我在走廊那头都听见你们吵架了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Our family is supposed to have a reputation to keep, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我们家不是很重视名声吗？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
What you have ruined last time is about to be recovered now, brother.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
哥哥，你上次搞砸的事，现在总算要挽回了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
......

[Isaac]
By the way, ^0000cdisn't it your box^000000, sister? It was on the table while there are a bunch of people hanging out. I kept it not to get it lost.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
对了，^0000cd姐姐，这不是你的盒子吗^000000？刚才它放在桌上，周围又有很多人。我怕它丢了，就先替你收起来了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
This... ^0000cdWas it you who had taken it^000000?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
这个...^0000cd是你拿走的吗^000000？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You should have let me know when you were taking it. Do you know how much trouble I have been through for this?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你拿走时应该告诉我一声。你知道我为找它吃了多少苦头吗？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Wait, this is unfair! No? I have taken it with me for your sake, sister.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
等等，这不公平吧？姐姐，我把它带在身上也是为了你好啊。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
You know how our father gets furious if anything goes missing in our house!
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
你知道父亲发现家里有东西不见时会多生气！

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
He would go on and on about how we don't need a person who cannot manage even a small thing in the Wigner family and how management skill is the greatest virtue of our family... Just think about it scares me.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
他会一直念叨，说维格纳家族不需要连小事都管不好的人，还说管理能力是家族最大的美德...光是想想就让我害怕。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What is in there? Why did you fuss about it so much?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
里面到底是什么？你为什么这么在意？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
There is nothing which is considered valuable by others in it. However, it is the most precious thing to me. Look.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
里面没有别人眼中的贵重物品，但对我来说却是最珍贵的东西。你们看。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
A note?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
一张纸条？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
A diary?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
日记？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
It is better to avoid a futile conversation. If you don't talk, you don't make mistakes. However, there are moments that you want to be honest with yourself.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
与其进行徒劳的交谈，不如保持沉默。不说话就不会犯错。可是，有时人还是想对自己坦诚。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
This diary has been capturing the moments that I want be true to myself.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
这本日记记录了那些我想对自己坦诚的时刻。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Nevertheless, I still am mistaken by others even I stay quiet. I guess silence has not been the best policy after all. Since I have my diary back, I should get going.
Dear adventurer, please excuse me for all the trouble.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
即使我保持沉默，别人还是会误解我。看来沉默终究不是最好的办法。既然日记已经找回来了，我该走了。
亲爱的冒险者，给您添麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Sister, I...
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
姐姐，我...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
That's all right now. I'll forget it all. You don't have to care about it either.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
没关系，就当什么都没发生吧。你也不用放在心上。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
She walks so fast. What was it all about?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
她走得真快。刚才到底怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It's all because you have taken the box without a word... Phew... Well, long story short, our sister is upset.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
都怪你一声不吭就拿走了盒子...唉...简单来说，姐姐生气了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Argh! Why is she upset?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
啊？她为什么生气？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It is complicated. I guess there are some bad rumors about her out there.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
说来话长。我想外面流传着一些关于她的坏话。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh, I have heard about it before. However, I thought you would take care of it since it is mainly your fault.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
哦，我以前听说过。不过我以为你会处理，毕竟主要是你的错。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You knew about that? Why didn't you tell me about it?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你知道这件事？为什么不告诉我？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Even if I did, you wouldn't have taken it seriously. It is true that you were born with that blessed looks.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
就算告诉你，你也不会当回事。你确实天生就有一副令人羡慕的好相貌。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
That's why the people around you have looked up to you. Not that our parents have been hard on us. No wonder you have grown up to be so carefree.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
所以周围的人都仰慕你。倒不是父母对我们不好...难怪你长大后这么无忧无虑。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Are you picking up a fight with me?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你是在找我吵架吗？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
No, listen to me. I am telling the truth here. No hard feelings.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
不是，听我说。我只是在讲实话，别介意。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Due to your superlative looks, we have been quite disadvantaged, growing up.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
因为你长得太出众，我们成长过程中一直很吃亏。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Do you remember what our sister has said? How the darkest shadow is always right next to the brightest light? It is true.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
你还记得姐姐说的吗？最深的阴影总在最耀眼的光芒旁边。她说得没错。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I don't get it. Beauty is a good thing. Everyone likes it.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我不明白。长得好看是好事，大家都喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
The people who see it may appreciate it. However, the people right next to it are being compared to it.
Among the three of us, it must have been the hardest for our sister.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
旁人会欣赏那份美，可站在美人身边的人就会被拿来比较。
我们三兄妹里，姐姐一定最难受。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Imagine a plain person standing next to an angelic beauty. Despite looking completely normal, she or he would look unattractive and somber. We have been compared to you like that, all our lives.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
想象一个普通人站在天使般美丽的人旁边。明明一切正常，却会显得平庸阴沉。我们一辈子都被拿来和你这样比较。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Our sister must have suffered from the stress even more. She has managed to endure it with her extraordinary patience and generosity. In fact, I think she could be an angel.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
姐姐承受的压力一定更大。她靠着非凡的耐心和宽容熬了过来。说真的，我觉得她简直像天使。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I didn't know that... At all..
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我以前完全不知道...真的一点都不知道...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What should I do now?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我现在该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I don't think it is entirely your fault. It was our parents who have created you like that.
Oh, well, you are to blame for your carefreeness though.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我觉得这也不能全怪你。毕竟是父母把你养成这样的。
不过你确实该为自己的粗心负责。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Anyway, who we need to worry about is our sister. Has she ever been mad at us? What should we do when she is upset?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
总之，现在该担心的是姐姐。她以前生过我们的气吗？她难过的时候，我们该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Well, she has been mad at me once when I was young.
I guess it was somewhat similar to what has just happened. She said something about comparison then...
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
嗯，我小时候她有一次生过我的气。
好像和刚才的情况有些像，当时她也提到了被拿来比较...

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I was too young to remember it. However, I do remember how our sister became very quiet after arguing with you.
You have been the main culprit of it after all.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我那时太小，不记得具体情况。不过我记得她和你吵完后就变得很沉默。
说到底，你才是主要原因。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It is not the time to waste time to distinguish between right and wrong. What should we do, dear adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
现在不是浪费时间争论谁对谁错的时候。亲爱的冒险者，我们该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know. Have you ever tried to countervail someone's anger?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也不知道。你试过想办法平息别人的怒气吗？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
No. No one's ever been mad at me, except our sister.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
没有。除了姐姐，从来没人对我发过火。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, please help us out here.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，请帮帮我们吧。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Leave me out of it. I wasn't the one who got her mad.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
别把我扯进来，又不是我惹她生气的。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You were the cause of the problem.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
这事就是因你而起。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I was trying to keep it safe... Please, dear adventurer, help us!
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我只是想替她保管好...亲爱的冒险者，求你帮帮我们！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What can you do? You'd better wait until your sister lets off steam... Or, you could try giving her something she likes...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们能做什么？最好先等她消消气...或者，送她一件喜欢的东西也行...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What doesn't she like? Do you know?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
她喜欢什么？你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I know as much as you do.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我知道的和你一样多。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Which means you know nothing, great!
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
也就是说你什么都不知道，真有你的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She seems to value experiences and memories. Don't you have any good memories with her? Trace back your memory back a little.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她似乎很珍惜经历和回忆。你们之间有什么美好的回忆吗？仔细回想一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Hum... Hum... There's no such... Wait! Yes, I remember one!
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
嗯...好像没有...等等！我想起来了！

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
What? Is there any?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
什么？真有吗？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Do you remember how we walked around the Comodo beach together during the summer vacation? We picked up some pretty stones on the shore and in the cave.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你还记得暑假时我们一起在克魔岛海滩散步吗？我们在岸边和洞穴里捡了些漂亮的石头。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Our sister really liked...This clear stone containing some sea water and a piece of coral inside.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
姐姐特别喜欢那块透明的石头...里面封着海水和一片珊瑚。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
The Sea Stone?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
大海之石？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Yes, that's it! She lined up those stones near the window and enjoyed looking at them glittering in the sun.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
对，就是它！她把那些石头摆在窗边，喜欢看它们在阳光下闪闪发亮。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh, I remember now. I remember seeing them glittering in her room.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
哦，我想起来了。我记得那些石头在她房间里闪闪发光。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The ^0000cdSea Stone^000000? What is it?

[Jurgen]
It is a pretty stone which can only be found in Comodo. It is called the Sea Stone because it looks as if there is the sea captured inside of it, with the sea water and corals.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
那是只能在克魔岛找到的漂亮石头。里面仿佛封存着大海，有海水和珊瑚，因此被称作大海之石。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Some romantics call it, the gift from a mermaid.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
有些浪漫的人把它称为美人鱼的礼物。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You may find them upon digging the ground on the Comodo beach once in a while. Our sister, Isaac and I used to dig them out whenever we are on summer vacation.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
偶尔能在克魔岛海滩挖到。我们三个以前每逢暑假都会去挖。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I have heard that it is not found on the beach these days. Instead, you can get it by killing the ^0000cdMedusa inside the cave in the west of Comodo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
听说现在海滩上已经找不到了。如今得去克魔岛西边的洞穴打倒^0000cd米杜沙^000000才能获得。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What? Did the Medusa take them all?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
什么？米杜沙把它们全拿走了吗？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Who knows? It is supposed to be the gift from a mermaid. Some say, the Mermen have given them to the Medusa. Well, this also sounds like a fairytale.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
谁知道呢？大海之石据说是美人鱼的礼物。也有人说是海人族送给米杜沙的...听起来像童话吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
How do you know it so well?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你怎么知道得这么清楚？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I have once tried to distribute them all over the continent. You used to be able to get them by just digging the ground. Tourists used to pick them up as souvenirs or gamblers used to use them as talismans for their prayers to the sea-god.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我以前想把它们推广到大陆各地。那时只要挖土就能找到。游客会捡来当纪念品，赌徒则把它当作向海神祈祷的护身符。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Since it became hard to get them, I have given up the plan. The game is not worth the candle, having to kill the Medusa on the way.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
后来它们变得很难找，我就放弃了。为了挖石头还得一路打倒米杜沙，实在得不偿失。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I didn't know that. Anyway, I remember there was something else next to the stone.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我还真不知道。对了，我记得石头旁边还有别的东西。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
There were some flowers, a bunch of them. What flower was that? I lasted so long that it never seemed to wither at all.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
好像有一大束花。那是什么花来着？放了那么久，似乎一直都没有枯萎。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, do you have any idea what flower that would have been?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，你知道那会是什么花吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If it didn't whither for so long, it could have been a Witherless Rose.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果一直没有枯萎，可能是永恒玫瑰。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Is there such a thing? Why do you need a Witherless Rose when you can just buy another flower before the older one withers?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
还有这种东西？旧花枯萎前再买一朵新的不就好了，为什么非要永恒玫瑰？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You want what you like to last long. If you replace it with another flower, it is not the same flower you liked anymore.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
人总希望喜欢的东西能长久。换成另一朵花，就不是原来那朵了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Hum... Well, I guess I can imagine myself being replaced with another person. I understand it now.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
嗯...如果我被别人取代，应该也能理解这种感觉了。我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
So, when are you going to get them for us?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
那你打算什么时候去帮我们找？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Isaac]
You didn't think that we would go there to get them ourselves, did you?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
你不会以为我们要亲自去找吧？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I am busy with my business, and Jurgen attracts too many people around him.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我忙着做生意，尤尔根身边又总围着一大群人。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
We need someone else we can trust, who happens to be right in front of us.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我们正好需要一个值得信赖的人，而这样的人就在眼前。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I was worried about it as well. Please, dear adventurer, help us. The loving relationship among us depends on you.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我也正担心这件事呢。亲爱的冒险者，请帮帮我们。我们兄妹能不能和好就靠你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you say so... How many of them do you need? Where can I get the Sea Stone?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你们这么说...需要多少？大海之石要去哪里找？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Hum... I guess we need ^0000cd1 Witherless Rose^000000 and ^0000cd10 Sea Stones^000000 since we want to decorate the window with them.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
嗯...我们想用它们装饰窗边，所以需要^0000cd1朵永恒玫瑰^000000和^0000cd10块大海之石^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
We are depending on you.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, you came! Did you bring what we asked you for? Please tell us that you did.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，你来了！带了我们拜托的东西吗？拜托你说带了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I wasn't able to bring them all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没能全部带来。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Why? Did you forget what to bring by any chance? Let me tell you once more.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
为什么？你是不是忘了要带什么？我再告诉你一次。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
^0000cd10 Sea Stones^000000. You can get them while hunting Medusa in Comodo. They are valuable because it is difficult to kill Medusa.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
^0000cd10块大海之石^000000。去克魔岛打米杜沙时可以获得。米杜沙很难对付，所以这些石头很珍贵。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
And ^0000cd1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
还有^0000cd1朵永恒玫瑰^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I know that's a lot of things to bring, but I believe we need them all to make our sister feel better.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我知道要带的东西不少，但我相信只有凑齐这些，才能让姐姐开心起来。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, did you bring what we asked you for? Please tell us that you did.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，你带来我们拜托的东西了吗？拜托你说带来了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Yes, please tell us that you did. We tried our best to balance out her anger. However, she's been giving the cold shoulder to us.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
是啊，快说带来了吧。我们已经尽力想让姐姐消气，可她还是一直对我们爱理不理。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I brought them. You'd better not to press an angry person so impatiently like that, you know.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我带来了。对生气的人可别这么着急地催促，你们懂的。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Whoa, they are all here! You saved our lives. We should call our sister now. What if she is still mad at us...
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
哇，全都带来了！你真是救了我们一命。我们现在就叫姐姐过来。万一她还在生气怎么办...

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I have already called her.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我已经叫她来了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Why do you keep calling me? Please leave me alone for that I am not mad at you any more.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你们为什么一直叫我？让我一个人静一静吧，我已经不生气了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Sister, forgive us. Please stop being mad at us.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
姐姐，请原谅我们。别再生我们的气了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
...Do you know what you have done wrong?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
...你们知道自己做错了什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I don't think I am to blame, but I am sorry that I have taken your stuff without telling you.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我觉得我不该受责备，不过没告诉你就拿走你的东西，确实是我不对。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Well, I am sorry about it all. I haven't been considerate of your feelings. However, it wouldn't have hurt you to open up to me a little, since we are family.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
嗯，这一切都是我的错。我没有顾及你的感受。不过我们毕竟是一家人，你也可以稍微对我敞开心扉。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
If we don't be honest to each other, we will just grow away. We will get our wires crossed again.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
如果我们不坦诚相待，就会渐渐疏远，也会再次产生误会。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You are right. I have given it a thought as well. I think some part of it is my fault. I should have been honest with you, at least.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你说得对。我也想过了，觉得自己也有错。至少，我应该坦诚地告诉你们。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
When we were young, we used to talk a lot, and have some good times. Look at these. We used to run around looking for things like these. Do you remember this stone? You liked to watch them glitter in the sun.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
小时候我们常聊天，也有过很多快乐时光。看这些，我们以前总会到处找这样的石头。还记得这块吗？你喜欢看它们在阳光下闪闪发亮。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
They are.. When did you get them...?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
这些是...你什么时候找到的...？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
The adventurer helped us. I guess those were the times when we were the closest to one another. Look at this.
This stone is so clear that you can see the seawater and coral reef inside right through it.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
多亏冒险者帮忙。我想那时我们最亲近了。看这个。
这块石头很透明，能直接看到里面的海水和珊瑚。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
