I think people are just the same. We don't need to show everything, but we do need to show some to let others know how pretty we are inside.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我觉得人也一样。不必什么都展示出来，但总该让别人看到一些，知道我们的内心也很美好。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Yes, you are right. I think you have got the point. I'll try. I'll do it to avoid any more misunderstanding.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你说得对。我想我明白你的意思了。我会试着改变，避免再发生误会。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
By the way, when did you learn to talk like that? I think I am finally able to talk with you guys now.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
对了，你什么时候变得这么会说话了？我觉得现在终于能和你们好好聊聊了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You mean, you haven't been able to talk with us?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你是说以前一直没法和我们好好说话吗？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Well, thanks to my effort, we brothers and sister have become close to one another again.
Thank you for your work, dear adventurer. This is not much, but I hope you take it. Sorry about all the trouble you have been through for us.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
嗯，多亏我努力，我们兄妹又亲近起来了。
亲爱的冒险者，谢谢你帮忙。这点谢礼不算什么，希望你收下。让你为我们费心了，真抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Material reward has never seems to small before.
I guess what you have done for us is just that priceless.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
以前我从没觉得物质上的谢礼如此微不足道。
你为我们做的一切实在无价。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I am sorry to cause such an embarrassing scene in front of you. If you have time, please come by again. We will make sure to receive you properly next time.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
很抱歉让你看到这么尴尬的一幕。有空请再来，下次我们一定好好招待你。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, I have learned new lessons and earned many things, thanks to you. If you need our help, we will try to help you as much as we can. I wish you luck!
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，多亏了你，我学到了很多，也收获良多。如果你需要我们帮忙，我们一定尽力。祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Jurgen, Hello?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
尤尔根，你在吗？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Oh, dear adventurer, welcome.
Are you enjoying the banquet? Do you need any help by any chance?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
哦，亲爱的冒险者，欢迎。
宴会还愉快吗？需要帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. I just wanted to talk to you for a second.
I wonder how your sister is doing these days as well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没什么，只是想和你聊几句。也想问问你妹妹最近怎么样。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Thanks to your help, we have never been better than this.
I've been talking to my sister much more, and..
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
多亏了你的帮忙，我们兄妹的关系比以往都好。
我现在常和姐姐聊天，而且...

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
打扰了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I am sorry. I thought no one was here. I just wanted to clean the room, I am really sorry. I'll come back later.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
抱歉，我以为里面没人。我只是来打扫房间的，真的很抱歉。我晚点再来。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Not at all. Please come in. It is a nonsense that you cannot clean the room because of the people inside.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
没关系，请进。不能因为有人在里面就不打扫房间。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, long time no see. Sorry about the trouble you went through last time. Fortunately, the box thing has been resolved well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，好久不见。上次让你费心了，抱歉。幸好盒子的事已经顺利解决了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh... Yes... I see...
Hello...
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
哦...是的...我明白了...
你好...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Is this the person from the last time? Whom you asked about the box...?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
这就是上次那个人吗？就是你问过盒子事情的那位？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, she is.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，就是她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I am sorry about that. We were desperate and in a hurry. I apologize if you were upset by it.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
那件事很抱歉。当时我们又急又慌。如果让你不高兴了，我向你道歉。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Thank you for telling me that. Since I am a maid, there are people who suspect me or treat me like a thief.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
谢谢您告诉我这些。我只是个女仆，有些人会怀疑我，甚至把我当成小偷。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
However, you seem different, dear prince. I am a little surprised. I thought people who belong to the high society didn't know how to apologize.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
不过，王子殿下，您似乎不一样。我有些惊讶，一直以为上流社会的人都不会道歉。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, it was very presumptuous of me.
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
哦，是我失礼了。
对不起。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
No, that's OK.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
没关系。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Then, I should get going.
I am supposed to clean the room when there is no one inside anyway. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
那我先告辞了。
反正房间里没人时我还得来打扫，请见谅。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You shouldn't have to... Well, she's gone...
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
不用这样...唉，她走了...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Well, dear adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
那么，亲爱的冒险者？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Jurgen]
Well, I think ^0000cdI have fallen in love^000000 .
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
嗯，我想^0000cd我坠入爱河了^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, you have.

[{0}]
What?

[Jurgen]
I have never met anyone who looks directly into my eyes like that.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我从没遇过一个人，能那样直视我的眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I fell in love with her. I love her dignified and calm voice. Unaffected behaviors That tone of voice reflecting strong will...
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我爱上她了。我喜欢她端庄沉静的声音、自然不做作的举止，还有那透着坚定意志的语气...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
All the women I have seen so far are like flowers in the greenhouse. However, she resembles a wild flower in the field.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我见过的女人都像温室里的花，可她就像田野中的野花。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
She is totally different from the ladies I have met before.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
她和我以前认识的那些贵族小姐截然不同。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer! How can I tell someone I have fallen in love at first sight how I feel? Should I go take her hands and say I love her?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者！要怎么向一见钟情的人表达心意？我该不该牵起她的手，告诉她我爱她？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? You don't know anything about it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？你对这种事一窍不通？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
She is my ^0000cdfirst love^000000. My life will never be the same since I have met her.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
她是我的^0000cd初恋^000000。遇见她之后，我的人生就不一样了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hum... Try to remember what all the people outside the door have done to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...想想门外那些人都对你做过什么。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Well... Nothing that I can recall... Hum... There have been some impressive people though. There was this person who penetrated defense and hid behind the curtain in my room...
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
嗯...我想不起来有什么特别的...不过有些人确实令人印象深刻。有人突破防守，躲到我房间的窗帘后面...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hum... That's impressive. However, it is a crime. You should forget it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...真厉害。不过那是犯罪，还是忘了吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
There was this person who sent me a life-size golden statue. I sent it back since I didn't need it and it didn't look as good as real me.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
有人送过我一尊等身大的金像。我不需要，而且它看起来也不如真人帅，所以就退回去了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
How about sending her a gold statue looking exactly like me?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
要不我送她一尊和我一模一样的金像？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She will be repelled if you try too hard like that from the very beginning. How about sending her a ^0000cdletter^000000 with a small gift?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一开始就这么卖力，会把她吓跑的。不如寄一封^0000cd信^000000，再附上一件小礼物？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It is a good idea! Please wait a moment!
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
好主意！请稍等！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? Wait for what?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？等什么？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Did you forget? If I take a step out of that door, I'll draw attention.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你忘了吗？我只要一走出那扇门，就会引起大家注意。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It would cause her trouble, wouldn't it. By the way, I didn't even get the chance to ask her what her name was.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
那样反而会给她添麻烦。对了，我甚至还没来得及问她叫什么名字。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please send this letter to her with this box containing jewelry.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
请把这封信和装着珠宝的盒子一起送给她。

scripts.text: OK.
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text: It will be difficult.
scripts.translation: 有点困难

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It will be difficult. I have other things to do.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这有点困难，我还有别的事要做。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Sorry about the difficult request. I guess I should go there myself. You may be able to see the news that the heir of the Wigner family has been crushed to death by his followers on Daily Rune-Midgarts tomorrow morning.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
抱歉拜托你这么难办的事。看来我只能亲自去了。明天早上，你或许会在《卢恩·米德加兹日报》上看到维格纳家族继承人被狂热粉丝压死的新闻。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Or, the poor maid could be hospitalized by tomorrow. Anyway, I understand.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
或者那位可怜的女仆明天就得住院。总之，我理解。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK. I should get going then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好，那我这就出发。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer! I've been waiting for you. How did it go? Has she said she loves me too?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者！我一直在等你。事情怎么样了？她也说喜欢我了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I haven't been able to meet her yet. Let me go see her again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我还没能见到她。我再去找她看看。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer! I've been waiting for you.
How did it go? Has she said she loves me too?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者！我一直在等你。
事情怎么样了？她也说喜欢我了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, actually... She ^0000cdturned it down^000000. She returned what you had sent her as well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，其实...她^0000cd拒绝了^000000，还把你送的东西退了回来。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
She turned me down?
Why? Did she say that she didn't like my looks? Or wasn't what I had sent her enough for her?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
她拒绝我了？
为什么？她说不喜欢我的长相吗？还是我送的东西不够好？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, not that... She has said she is currently not in the situation to go out with someone. She seems to have a reason.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是那样...她说目前不适合和别人交往，似乎另有原因。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Does she already have a boyfriend? I am not surprised. She is so attractive after all. No wonder I have fallen for her.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
她已经有男朋友了吗？我倒不意外，毕竟她那么迷人。难怪我会爱上她。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, not that either... She just has said she is currently not in the situation to date someone.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
也不是...她只是说目前不适合和别人约会。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Whoa... ^0000cdIt is my first time to want something so badly in this life^000000. Never did I know that it would be so difficult to get.
Is living such a difficult thing?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
天哪...^0000cd这是我这辈子第一次如此渴望得到某样东西^000000，没想到实现起来这么难。
人生怎么会这么难呢？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
However, my father has told me that I should always try at least three times.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
不过父亲告诉过我，无论什么事，至少要尝试三次。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
First try to begin, second try to confirm and the third try to give up since it is not meant to be.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
第一次是为了开始，第二次是为了确认，第三次则是为了放弃，因为那注定不属于自己。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
So, dear adventurer. Please do this one more time for me.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
所以，亲爱的冒险者，请再帮我一次。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I think you should write the letter again...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我想你应该重新写一封信...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I need something special. Something pretty and shiny which reflects my feelings...
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我需要特别的东西，一件漂亮又闪亮、能表达我心意的东西...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
The Sea Stone! And flower!
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
大海之石！还有花！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Jurgen]
I want to send her ^0000cdthe heart that is as wide and beautiful as the sea^000000 and ^0000cdthe amaranthine heart for her^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我想送她^0000cd如大海般广阔美丽的心^000000，以及^0000cd永不凋零的爱意^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I go get them all myself as well?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
难道还要我亲自去把它们都找来？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please, dear adventurer, be the messenger of love for me. Please send her my heart wider than the sea which never withers.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，请做我的爱情信使吧。替我送上这颗比大海更广阔、永不凋零的心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you say so, I'll do it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你这么说，那我就去吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please send her my letter with ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
请把这封信和^0000cd15颗大海之石、1朵永恒玫瑰^000000一起送给她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
As I told you before, you can get the Sea Stone from killing Medusa.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
正如我之前说的，大海之石可以通过击败米杜沙获得。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, I will never forget this and make it up to you. We, Wigners, never forget any debt.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，我不会忘记这份恩情，一定会报答你。我们维格纳家族从不欠人情。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not that I am doing it expecting something in return, but I will deliver them to her since you look so desperate.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可不是为了回报才帮忙的，不过看你这么着急，我就替你送去吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Thank you! Oh, do you happen to get her name by any chance?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
谢谢！对了，你知道她叫什么名字吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mary, her name is Mary.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她叫玛丽。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
^0000cdMary^000000. It is a common but pretty name. What is common means that it is well loved by many people. I'll get all my things embroidered with this name from now on.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
^0000cd玛丽^000000。普通又好听的名字。所谓普通，就是很多人都喜欢。从今以后，我要把这个名字绣在所有东西上。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, you may set off now. Please deliver my feelings to her safely.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，你可以出发了。请把我的心意平安送到她那里。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Did you deliver my heart to Mary safely? You have come back so early.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你把我的心意平安送给玛丽了吗？你回来得真快。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Have you forgotten what you have to bring with you?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你忘了要带什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You need to bring ^0000cd15 Sea Stones which you can get from killing Medusa and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你需要带^0000cd15颗通过击败米杜沙获得的大海之石，以及1朵永恒玫瑰^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Mary wouldn't feel uncomfortable if I express my feelings with ordinary things like these, right? Please send her my heart wider than the sea which never withers.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
玛丽收到这些普通的礼物，应该不会觉得不自在吧？请替我送上这颗比大海更广阔、永不凋零的心。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer! You are back!
I couldn't stop thinking about her even while you were gone.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者！你回来了！
你不在的时候，我满脑子都是她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Even when I eat, drink a tea, look into the mirror and talking to other people! I though about her all day. It was painful but I was in a flutter.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
无论是吃饭、喝茶、照镜子还是和别人说话，我整天都在想着她！虽然很煎熬，心里却又小鹿乱撞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's what falling in love is like.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这就是恋爱的感觉。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Oh, then I must have been doing bad things to numerous people. There is nothing I can do for them.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
哦，那我一定辜负过很多人的心意。我也没办法补偿她们了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
By the way, since your hands are empty, I guess she has accepted my heart at last!
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
对了，你两手空空地回来，看来她终于接受我的心意了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, hum... She didn't react negatively, but you'd better be careful since you don't know each other yet.
Why don't you spare her some time?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...她没有表现出反感，但你们还不熟，最好谨慎些。不如给她一点时间？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
She must have not accepted my heart completely then. I am all right though! She hasn't turned me down yet!
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
看来她还没有完全接受我的心意。不过没关系！至少她还没拒绝我！

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I didn't know how painful it was to love someone. I did know how I would be fidgety about a word or gesture of her.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我以前不知道爱一个人会这么痛苦，也没想到自己会因为她的一句话、一个动作而坐立不安。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is true. Winning someone's heart is the hardest thing.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
确实如此。赢得一个人的心是最难的事。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I guess I should be nicer to the people who like me.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我想我应该对那些喜欢我的人好一点。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think that is a good idea...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得这主意不太好...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, thank you again. Would you come by again tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，再次谢谢你。明天还会再来吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Jurgen]
It seems like a good sign. Paddle as the wave approaches. That's one of the many mottos of our family.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
这似乎是个好兆头。趁浪头到来时划桨，这是我们家族格言之一。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I want to let her know of my blazing heart every day.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我想每天都让她知道我这颗炽热的心。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I have a feeling that everything will turn out great if you send it for me.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我觉得只要你替我送去，一切都会顺利的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How about allowing her some time?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不如给她一些时间？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
What if she forgets about me? Then, please send her my message once a day. You wouldn't say no, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
万一她把我忘了怎么办？请每天替我给她捎个口信，好吗？你不会拒绝吧？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Oh, I almost forgot. It is not much, but please accept this as my token of gratitude for the messenger of my love.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
哦，差点忘了。礼物不算贵重，请收下这点谢意，感谢你做我的爱情信使。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I'll see you tomorrow then!
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
那明天再见！

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Did you deliver my heart to Mary safely? You have come back so early.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你把我的心意平安送给玛丽了吗？你这么快就回来了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Have you forgotten what you have to bring with you?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你忘了要带什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You need to bring ^0000cd15 Sea Stones which you can get from killing Medusa and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你需要带^0000cd15颗通过击败米杜沙获得的大海之石，以及1朵永恒玫瑰^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Mary wouldn't feel uncomfortable if I express my feelings with ordinary things like these, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
玛丽收到这些普通的礼物，应该不会觉得不自在吧？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please send her my heart wider than the sea which never withers.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
请替我送上这颗比大海更广阔、永不凋零的心。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, I'd like to call you who has delivered my message of love to her, the ^0000cdMessenger of Love^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，我想称呼你这位替我传递爱意的人为^0000cd爱情信使^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please don't...

[Jurgen]
^0000cdCupid of Love^000000...

[{0}]
Please stop it.

[Jurgen]
On the day Mary accepts my feelings, I would like to give you a huge pure gold statue.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
等玛丽接受我的心意时，我要送你一座巨大的纯金雕像。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You really don't have to do that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的不用了。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
However, this is the only thing I can offer you for now. Please visit our manor later. There are some real valuable things.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
不过这就是我现在唯一能送你的东西。稍后请到我们庄园来，那里有真正珍贵的东西。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Then dear adventurer, I'll see you again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
那么，亲爱的冒险者，明天再见。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, what brought you here around this time? May I help you?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，这个时间来有什么事吗？我能帮上忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Are you here to deliver my message of love to Mary?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你是来替我向玛丽传达爱意的吗？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Oh, well, it was you who had said that she would be repelled by my impatience.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
哦，对了，是你说我太着急会让她反感。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I am trying hard not to send her my love letter every minute and second. Please comeback when the time comes.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我正在努力克制自己，不每分每秒都给她写情书。等时机到了再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, you came! It seems that something good may happen today.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，你来了！看来今天会有好事发生。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please deliver her the message of my love with deliver my message of love with ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
请把我的爱意和^0000cd15颗大海之石、1朵永恒玫瑰^000000一起送给她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Do you remember? You can get the Sea Stone by killing Medusa.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
还记得吗？击败米杜沙就能得到大海之石。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please send them to her and tell me how Mary is doing today. I am sad that she doesn't come here to clean the room anymore.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
请把这些交给她，再告诉我玛丽今天过得怎么样。她不再来这里打扫房间，我有些失落。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
I want to go see her myself. However, I guess she will feel uncomfortable.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
我也想亲自去见她，可我想她会觉得不自在。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Dear adventurer, I am depending on you!
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
亲爱的冒险者，就拜托你了！

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Dear adventurer, we are honored to have you with us. Have you met our father who is the head of the Wigner family?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
亲爱的冒险者，欢迎来到我们家。您见过维格纳家族的家主，也就是我的父亲了吗？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
How about meeting Jurgen, the hair of the Wigner family who is participating in the Royal Assembly?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
要不要去见见正在参加皇家议会的维格纳家族继承人尤尔根？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Then, have a comfortable time in the Wigner family.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
那么，请在维格纳家好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I am over!
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我先走了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is going on?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Sister, please calm down. Where did you put it? Are you sure you have left it here?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
姐姐，先冷静一下。你把它放在哪里了？确定是放在这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Here, I have left it right here! After talking to the adventurer, I put it here and... It was gone... Where did it go?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我明明就放在这里！和冒险者谈完后，我就把它放在这儿了...怎么不见了...到底去哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What did you lose?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们丢了什么？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
My jewelry box... Well, it is technically not a jewelry box since it doesn't hold any jewelry in it, but anyways, ^0000cda small box containing something very important is missing.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我的首饰盒...虽说里面其实没装首饰，总之，^0000cd一个装着重要东西的小盒子不见了^000000。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I took it out of my bag and out it here. Then it was gone. What should I do? I don't know what I should do without it... I cannot afford to let anyone see it...
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我从包里拿出来放在这里，然后就不见了。我该怎么办？没有它我真不知道该怎么办...我不能让任何人看到里面的东西...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
It could be the ^0000cdmaid^000000 who came here earlier to clean the room. She may have taken it.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
会不会是刚才来打扫房间的^0000cd女仆^000000拿走了？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You haven't seen her taking it. You shouldn't doubt other people without proof.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你又没看到她拿走。没有证据就不该怀疑别人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not that I am suspicious of her, but it may help to ask her. If she saw it or when was the last time she saw it...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是怀疑她，不过问问她也许能有帮助。比如她有没有看到，或最后一次看到是什么时候...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Please don't. She would be upset if she feels that she is being suspected.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
请别这么做。她会觉得我们在怀疑她，一定会很难过。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
But you are being so nervous. Isn't it an important thing to you?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
可你这么紧张，这东西对你很重要吧？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
It is, but...
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
是很重要，不过...

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
You really need to get it back, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
你很想把它找回来，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
You are right, but...
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
你说得对，可是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll make sure to ask her about it as politely as possible. Please relax and wait here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会尽量礼貌地问她。请放松些，在这里等我。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I don't know if is the best idea. I don't want her to feel that we are suspecting her.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我不知道这是不是个好主意。我不想让她觉得我们怀疑她。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Just wait until the adventurer comes back. The adventurer is really experienced in this kind of stuff.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
等冒险者回来吧。冒险者很有处理这类事情的经验。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Should I...
Then, please help me, dear adventurer. I'll go search other pleases then.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我应该...
那就拜托你了，亲爱的冒险者。我去别的地方找找。

scripts.text:
[Jurgen]
Please, help her. I have heard that ^0000cdthe maids are in the kitchen^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尤尔根]
请帮帮她。我听说^0000cd女仆们都在厨房^000000。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Oh, what should I do?
I should have taken better care of it...
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
唉，我该怎么办？
我应该好好保管它的...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Please make sure not to hurt other people's feelings.
I would like to go find it myself, but I am not in the situation to do that...
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
请别伤害其他人的感情。
我也想亲自去找，但现在不方便...

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I don't even want to imagine anyone else sees it though...
I would be embarrassed to death.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我甚至不敢想象被别人看到里面的东西...
那会让我羞愧得无地自容。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Please leave me alone now!
Ah, it was you, dear adventurer. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
请让我一个人静一静！
啊，是你啊，亲爱的冒险者。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your feeling must have been hurt by your brothers.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的兄弟们一定伤了你的心。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
It is not that.
I am... I am just angry at myself.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
不是那样的。
我...我只是生自己的气。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Something like this never would have happened if was more careful...
Moreover, I shouldn't have said such things to my brothers either.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
如果我再小心一点，这种事根本不会发生...
而且我也不该对兄弟们说那样的话。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
However, I couldn't take it anymore when I heard the rumors and Jurgen's attitude...
I thought I was used to those things... I guess I am not.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
可是听到那些流言，再看到尤尔根的态度，我实在忍不下去了...
我以为自己早就习惯了...看来并没有。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I should have given it up by now...
Oh, I am sorry. I believe you haven't come here to listen to a story like this.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我本来早就该放下了...
啊，抱歉。我想你不是特地来听我说这些的。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I am sorry, but I want to be alone for now.
Please.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
对不起，我现在只想一个人待着。
拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Thanks to you, we have become closer to one another now.
Now I can open up to my brothers more.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
多亏了你，我们现在亲近多了。
我也能更敞开心扉地和兄弟们交流了。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I have tried to hide my feelings and save my words. However, I have realized that It is not the best policy.
From now own, I am going to tell them how I feel to avoid any misunderstanding.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我一直压抑感受、尽量少说话，但我明白了这并不是最好的办法。
从今以后，我会告诉他们我的想法，避免再产生误会。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
Dear adventurer, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
亲爱的冒险者，谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
I believe I haven't met you before. Are you here to see my father?
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我想我们之前没见过。您是来见我父亲的吗？

scripts.text:
[Katrin]
My father is over there.
scripts.translation:
[卡特琳]
我父亲在那边。

scripts.text:
[Isaac Wigner]
Dear adventurer, do you know the old saying that the emptier it is, the more you can fill it?
It is one of the many aphorisms passing down in our family.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克·维格纳]
亲爱的冒险者，你听过“越空的容器，越能装下东西”这句老话吗？
这是我们家族代代相传的格言之一。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, Isaac Wigner.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，艾萨克·维格纳。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh, welcome, dear adventurer, my brother is over there...
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
哦，欢迎，亲爱的冒险者。我哥哥在那边...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. I am here to see you, Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我是来见你的，艾萨克。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Is it about Wolf?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
是关于狼的事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. How did you know it...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。你怎么知道...？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Wolf is not here even after the time he has promised. He is the man of his word. Something must have happened to him.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
狼已经过了约定时间还没来。他一向言而有信，一定是出了什么事。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I never expected you would come here instead though. So is he cancelling the appointment today then?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
不过我没想到你会亲自来这里。他今天是取消约定了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, he is. And he asked me to get ^0000cda certain thing^000000 from you, Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，他取消了。他让我向你，艾萨克，取^0000cd一样东西^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
That thing...? Wolf must trust you, dear adventurer. Or it could be...
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
那样东西...？狼一定很信任你，亲爱的冒险者。或者，这是...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Some kind of a test.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
某种考验。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Don't take it the wrong way. I am just be careful. In order to do what I do, I need to know who I can trust first.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
别误会，我只是谨慎行事。要做我正在做的事，首先得知道谁值得信任。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I understand.

[Isaac]
You can bring it to Wolf. Please be careful with it.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
你可以把东西交给狼。请小心保管。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
May I ask you for one more thing? I have heard that there is ^0000cda strange rumor^000000 circulating in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我还能再拜托你一件事吗？我听说普隆德拉正在流传^0000cd奇怪的传闻^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
It is supposed to be about ^0000cdHelmut Roegenburg^000000. Would you investigate about the rumor and let me know the truth?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
据说和^0000cd赫尔穆特·罗根堡^000000有关。能调查一下传闻，告诉我真相吗？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Since I have a reputation to keep. I cannot afford to have a scandal. Please help me.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我得维护自己的名声，不能惹上丑闻。请帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Please excuse me then.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
那么，我先失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Have you deliver the thing to Wolf safely? You should be careful with it since it can be dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
你把东西安全交给狼了吗？那东西可能很危险，要小心。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
And, don't forget to ask about the rumor as well.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
还有，别忘了打听那个传闻。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Please excuse me then.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
那么，我先失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Dear adventurer, you are back. Did you deliver the thing safely? What did he say about the rumor?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
亲爱的冒险者，你回来了。东西安全交给他了吗？他对传闻怎么说？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here is the document about that. Here... It was. Wait, I must have forget to bring it with me. I am sorry. I'll be back with it soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是那件事的文件。在这里...咦？等等，我好像忘了带。抱歉，我马上回去拿。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Such things happen. Take your time. I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
这种事难免会发生。慢慢来，我会等你的。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Dear adventurer, you are back. Did you deliver the thing safely? What did he say about the rumor?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
亲爱的冒险者，你回来了。东西安全交给他了吗？他对传闻怎么说？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here is the ^0000cddocument^000000 about it. It is written by Wolf Roegenburg himself.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是相关的^0000cd文件^000000，出自沃尔夫·罗根堡本人之手。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Let's see... Hum... So the new business will be delayed indefinitely. The direction of the business will be changed.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我看看...嗯...看来新业务要无限期推迟，经营方向也会改变。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I'll see you again after taking care of the matters. - W. R.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
处理好事情后，我会再与你见面。——W. R.

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
It means that he would stop the deal about the war, right? The rumor must have been quite threatening.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
这意味着他要取消有关战争的交易，对吧？那个传闻一定造成了很大影响。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I feel sorry. It would have been a great chance for me to impress my family.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
真遗憾，本来是我向家族证明自己的好机会。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Well, I believe Wolf would find a better direction to the business. Please tell Wolf that I support his decision. And that I am excited about his new business.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
不过，我相信狼会找到更好的经营方向。请告诉他，我支持他的决定，也期待他的新业务。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好，我会转告他。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Please excuse me then.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
那么，我先失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
It is a shame.
It was a great opportunity for me and Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
真可惜。
这原本是我和狼的大好机会。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
However, since my partner wants to quit, I shouldn't force him to carry on with it.
I believe that Wolf must already have the plan about the next business item in his mind.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
不过既然搭档想退出，我也不该强迫他继续。
我相信狼已经在考虑下一项生意了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
That's why I accepted his suggestion to be partners in business.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
所以我才接受了他的提议，和他合伙做生意。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Please excuse me then.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
那么，我先失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Dear adventurer, since you are here to the Wigner family, why don't you go meet some other members of the family?
Like my parents, my brother who is the candidate to the throne or my sister who is the eldest child.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
亲爱的冒险者，既然你来到维格纳家了，不妨去见见其他家人吧。
比如我的父母、作为王位候选人的哥哥，或身为长女的姐姐。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I believe that you would have more productive time with them.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我相信和他们相处会更有收获。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Dear adventurer, did you bring what I had asked you?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
亲爱的冒险者，你带来我拜托的东西了吗？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I'd like to go get them myself or ask other people to do it. But, I feel a little uncomfortable since it is a family matter.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我本想自己去拿，或让别人代劳，但这毕竟是家事，我有点不好意思。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I know how it is troubling you, but please help us. You have not forgotten what to bring, have you?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我知道这让你为难，但还是请帮帮我们。你还记得要带什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
You need to bring ^0000cd10 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
你需要带^0000cd10块大海之石和1朵永恒玫瑰^000000。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Our fate depends on you! We may be able to get along again or we may become distant.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我们的命运就交给你了！我们可能重归于好，也可能从此疏远。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Please bring them to us as soon as possible!
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
请尽快把它们带来！

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Thanks to you, my brother and sister have become close to each other again.
What would they do without me?
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
多亏了你，哥哥和姐姐又亲近起来了。
要是没有我，他们可怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Dear adventurer, I'll see you around then.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
亲爱的冒险者，那我们回头见。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Is it your first time to visit the Wigner family?
Then, ^0000cdyou should meet our parents^000000 over there first.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
这是你第一次来维格纳家吗？
那么，^0000cd先去那边见见我们的父母^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Womenfolk]
Jurgen, you are mine!
scripts.translation:
[妇女们]
尤尔根，你是我的！

scripts.text:
[Bachelor]
I couldn't shake hands with Jurgen! Oh, it's too hot!
scripts.translation:
[单身汉]
我没能和尤尔根握手！啊，好烫！

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, you shouldn't bring too much stuff in here.
As you see there are a lot of fragile things.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
哦，你不该带这么多东西进来。
这里有很多易碎品。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
You need to leave some out. It would be a big problem if the bundle touches the dishes and breaks them.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
有些东西得放在外面。要是包裹碰到餐具把它们打碎，就麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I am cleaning the kitchen now, which is the hardest place to clean. It is really difficult to get rid of all the dirt in here.
My arms are way too weak to handle it.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
我正在打扫厨房，这里是最难清理的地方。要清除所有污垢可不容易。
我的手臂实在没力气。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I happen to see someone with a strong set of arms... Those arms... What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
我刚好看到一位手臂很有力的人...那双手臂...你来这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, I am the adventurer invited to the royal banquet. Are you the maid who have cleaned the Wigner residence this afternoon?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我是受邀参加皇家宴会的冒险者。你是今天下午打扫维格纳宅邸的女仆吗？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Yes, I am. What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
是的。有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you happen to see ^0000cda small box^000000 in the Wigner residence? It was supposed to be on the table next to the bed. The box belongs to Princess Katrin. Have you seen it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你有没有在维格纳宅邸看到^0000cd一个小盒子^000000？它原本放在床边的桌上，是卡特琳公主的。你见过吗？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Yes, I have. It was the box which looked simple but classy. I held it up for a second to clean the table and put it down. I remember it.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
见过。那是个看起来朴素却很有格调的盒子。我擦桌子时把它拿起来过一下，之后又放回去了。我记得。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you see it there when you leave the room? Wasn't there anyone else in the room?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你离开房间时还看到它吗？当时房间里还有别人吗？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Wait a moment. I know where you are getting with this. We, maids, often get into a situation like this.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
等一下，我知道你想问什么了。我们女仆经常遇到这种情况。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Isn't the box missing and are you ^0000cdsuspecting the maid who has cleaned the room^000000? Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
盒子不见了，所以你^0000cd怀疑打扫房间的女仆^000000，对吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am not suspecting you. I am just ^0000cdasking you about the situation^000000 to track the box.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没有怀疑你，只是想^0000cd了解一下当时的情况^000000，好找到盒子。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
With an element of suspicion in your mind, right?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
心里多少还是有点怀疑吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I am not suspecting you. Please don't get me wrong. I am just asking you when you have seen it and if there haven't been anyone else there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没有，请别误会。我只是想问你什么时候看到它的，以及当时有没有其他人在。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Ha, you are not being honest with me. If I say that there was no one around, I would be suspected, right?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
哈，你还是不肯坦白。如果我说当时没有别人，岂不是更让人怀疑？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I can tell you this one though. I didn't take it. If you ask me if there was anyone in the room, well...
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
不过有一点我可以告诉你：我没有拿。如果你问当时房里有没有人，那...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There was someone in the room, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当时房间里有人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Was there? This kitchen is too messy that I cannot think straight. ^0000cdI may be able to recall if it is cleaned up^000000.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
有吗？厨房太乱了，我脑子都转不过来。^0000cd把这里打扫干净后，我或许就能想起来^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, the kitchen is messy and so are the thoughts inside my head. Oh, how dirty and messy!
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
厨房乱糟糟的，我脑子里也一团乱。真是又脏又乱！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
May I help you clean up?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以帮你打扫吗？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, would you do that for me? I would be so grateful. Here is a ^0000cdPoring Scrub Sponge^000000, please scrub every inch of this place clean.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
哦，你愿意帮我吗？那我太感激了。这是^0000cd波利擦洗海绵^000000，请把这里每个角落都擦干净。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Since it is a specially-maid Scrub Sponge, it serves multiple purposes. It coaches you on how to clean so make good use of it.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
这是特制的擦洗海绵，用途很多。它还会教你怎么清洁，好好利用吧。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
You may be surprised by it, but it is a safe Scrub Sponge which doesn't hurt others. Don't worry.
It is a Scrub Sponge developed by a legendary figure.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
你可能会觉得奇怪，但这块擦洗海绵很安全，不会伤到人。别担心。
它是一位传奇人物发明的。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, wait! You know, there is a certain protocol when it comes to cleaning. You first need to wipe off the mold on the wall. Then you have to clean up the grease. The last thing for you to do is cleaning the floor.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
等等！打扫也有顺序。先擦掉墙上的霉菌，再清理油污，最后才打扫地板。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Have you finished it already?
It doesn't seem so. The thoughts in my head haven't cleared up yet.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
已经打扫完了吗？
看起来还没有呢，我脑子里的思绪还没理清。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I think I would be able to recall when you come back after cleaning the kitchen with the Scrub Sponge I have given you.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
等你用我给的擦洗海绵把厨房打扫干净再回来，我应该就能想起来了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Wow... The kitchen has become so clean! You really need to clean the grease with a strong set of arms!
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
哇...厨房真干净！清理油污确实需要一双有力的手臂！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Argh... My arms... Was there anyone else in the room?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...我的手臂...房间里当时还有别人吗？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
You must know what kind of family that is. It is the wealthiest family in Rune-Midgarts. Despite being a temporary residence, the room was decorated with so much care.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
你应该知道那是什么样的家族。他们是卢恩·米德加兹最富有的家族。虽说这里只是临时住所，房间还是布置得十分用心。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
All the gorgeous pieces of furniture and carpets... I have never seen tiger skin as white and huge as that one in there.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
华丽的家具和地毯...我从没见过那么大、那么白的虎皮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why are you talking about the furniture all of a sudden?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你怎么突然说起家具了？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, my, how are you going to deal with the members of the royal families with such slow wit?
Think. Why would I ^0000cdtalk about the furniture^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
哎呀，你反应这么慢，怎么应付王室成员？
想想看，我为什么要^0000cd谈家具^000000？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You ^0000cdcan ask the person who was delivering the furniture^000000 .

[Maid]
I cannot point it out, but I think I have given you enough clues.
By the way, is the box really missing in the first place?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
我不能直接点破，不过线索已经给得够多了。
对了，那个盒子真的不见了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
It is not my opinion, but there are these words people say. You know, the rumors.
Since the prince of the Wigner family looks so handsome...
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
这不是我的看法，只是大家都这么说的...你知道，那些流言。
维格纳家的王子长得那么英俊...

scripts.text:
[Maid]
He has been the center of the attention since he was young. People say that the lady is stressed about it and does things to draw attention.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
他从小就是众人关注的焦点。大家都说，那位小姐因此压力很大，还会故意做些引人注目的事。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
This could be one of her tricks, they say.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
据说这可能也是她的把戏之一。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
The words haven not been spread yet, but I am sure that everyone will be talking about it even before the teatime is over.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
这些话现在还没传开，但我敢说茶会结束前，大家就会议论纷纷。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think that is true. She is not that kind of person.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不觉得这是真的。她不是那种人。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
That's what people say. You don't have to reason with me. Anyways, I should get back to my cleaning duty. If you are not going to help me, please leave me alone now.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
大家都是这么说的，你不用跟我讲道理。总之，我得回去打扫了。如果你不打算帮忙，就别打扰我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you know where the man who have delivered the furniture is?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道送家具的人在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
He must be somewhere in Prontera. Why don't you try visiting the area ^0000cdnear the district office^000000. Most stores are located there.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
他应该在普隆德拉的某个地方。去^0000cd区公所附近^000000找找吧，那边店铺很多。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, by the way, you didn't hear it from me. Not that I said anything to you.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
对了，刚才的话别说是我告诉你的。我可什么都没跟你说。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course. Thank you for your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然。谢谢你配合。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Dear adventurer, didn't you say that you were going to visit the delivery man?
He must be somewhere ^0000cdnear the district office^000000.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
亲爱的冒险者，你不是说要去找送货员吗？
他应该在^0000cd区公所附近^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Since I need to clean up. please leave now.
You are getting in the way.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
我还得打扫，请你先离开。
你挡着我了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, I am sick of cleaning! I have enough things to clean at home. I don't need to do more out here.
I should just give it all up and run away.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
唉，我受够打扫了！家里要打扫的东西已经够多了，我不想在外面还做这些。
我干脆辞职逃走算了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, why can't I get it off easily? I guess I won't be able to go home early.
Why should I do this?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
唉，怎么这么难擦？看来今天没法早点回家了。
我为什么要做这种工作？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello. Do you have a moment?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，有空吗？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Yes... Well... Hum.. You are...
Aren't you the adventurer who was at the Wigner residence?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
有...嗯...你是...
你就是在维格纳宅邸见过的那位冒险者吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. And I have come here before, and I have helped you with cleaning.
^0000cdDon't you remember...?^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是我。我之前还来帮你打扫过。
^0000cd你不记得了吗...？^000000

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, I am really sorry. ^0000cdI am not good at remembering faces.^000000
What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
啊，实在抱歉。^0000cd我不太擅长记人脸。^000000
你这次来有什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Jurgen of the Wigner family has asked me to give it to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
维格纳家的尤尔根让我把这个交给你。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
What is it? Why did he give it to me? Is it an invoice? Have I done anything wrong?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
这是什么？他为什么给我这个？是账单吗？我做错什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it is not. Please just read it first.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，请先读一下。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Hum... I have fallen in love with you at first sight.
Well... Hum... Please accept my love for... Eh... Umm...
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
嗯...我对你一见钟情。
那个...请接受我的爱...呃...唔...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He has used some really direct languages here. How very Wigner of him for that he values efficiency... Hahaha...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他写得可真直接。真是维格纳家的作风，凡事都讲求效率...哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Hum... It is... It is... Well, is it what I think it is?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
嗯...这...这是...我想的那种东西吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is a love letter.

[Maid]
Phew... I am sorry, but you should take it back.
Well... I appreciate his feelings for me... I really do... But please just take it back.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
唉...抱歉，请把它拿回去。
我很感激他的心意...真的...但还是请你拿回去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Really? He has just tried to express his feelings... You may as well just keep it...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的吗？他只是想表达心意...你不妨收下吧...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, are you in a relationship or engaged? Or are you married?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，你有交往对象或未婚夫了吗？还是已经结婚了？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
No, no, I am not. Just take it back with you.
I feel rather overwhelmed... And there is the social class issue as well...
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
不，不是这些。请把信带回去吧。
我实在有些不知所措...而且我们之间还有身份差距...

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Most of all, I am not in the situation to date anyone. ^0000cdIt is for a personal reason.^000000
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
最重要的是，我现在不适合和人交往。^0000cd这是个人原因。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you say so, I cannot force it. I'll deliver your words to him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你这么说，我也不能勉强。我会把你的话转告他。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Yes. I am really sorry.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
嗯，真的很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
May I get your name at least?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
至少能告诉我你的名字吗？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Mad... No, ^0000cdMary^000000. My name is Mary.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
玛...不，^0000cd玛丽^000000。我的名字叫玛丽。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Then let me deliver your words to Jurgen.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
知道了，那我会把你的话转告尤尔根。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Well, have you told the prince about it? Please make sure not to hurt his feelings much.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
那么，你已经告诉王子了吗？请尽量别让他太伤心。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Please.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, when will it end.
I won't let go of this, really!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
唉，什么时候才会结束啊。
我真的不会放弃！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I don't think it is the right time. May I come back later?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，现在好像不太方便。我晚点再来可以吗？

scripts.text:
[Mary]
No, not at all.
Dear adventurer, you have a hole in your pocket. Have you lost anything?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
没有，不是那样。
亲爱的冒险者，你的口袋破了。是不是掉了什么东西？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! When did I get a hole in there? Where are the ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose...?^000000
They are gone! Let me come back later! I have forgotten to bring something!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！什么时候破的？^0000cd15颗大海之石和1朵永恒玫瑰...^000000
都掉了！我晚点再来！我忘了带东西！

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, when will it end.
I won't let go of this, really!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
唉，什么时候才会结束啊。
我真的不会放弃！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, hello.
Is it a bad time? Should I just go?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好。
现在不方便吗？我先走？

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, no.
By the way, you are back. Is it about the prince of the Wigner family again?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
哦，不是。
对了，你又来了，是为了维格纳家的王子吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. Jurgen seems to be really serious about it.
He wants you to have these.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。尤尔根似乎很认真。
他想把这些送给你。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I turned it down.
Oh, this really is... So pretty. There is water inside this glass-like thing...
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我已经拒绝过了。
啊，这个真的...好漂亮。像玻璃一样的东西里面竟然有水...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. Jurgen wants me to let you know about his heart as wide and beautiful as the sea.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。尤尔根想让你知道，他的心如大海般宽广美丽。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, I really cannot go out with him. Well, there really is a reason that I cannot accept this feelings. I wonder if I should tell you this.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
唉，我真的不能和他交往。确实有原因让我无法接受这份心意。我不知道该不该告诉你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please tell me. If you have a good enough reason which Jurgen can understand, he would not bother you again, Mary.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请告诉我。如果理由足够充分，尤尔根也能理解，就不会再打扰你了，玛丽。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I don't think it would be a good idea. You shouldn't tell this to anyone. Please keep the secret.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我觉得还是别说比较好。请不要告诉任何人，替我保守秘密。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
In fact, I am ^0000cdthe younger sibling of the maid who used to work here^000000. The maid you have met before.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
其实，我是^0000cd以前在这里工作的那位女仆的弟弟^000000。就是你之前见过的那位。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, no wonder you couldn't remember my face. I found it a little strange. By the way, you two sisters must have worked here together.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，难怪您想不起我的脸。我之前还觉得有些奇怪。对了，你们姐妹俩应该曾一起在这里工作吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, what would it matter since it is you whom he has fallen for?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过，既然他爱上的是您，这又有什么关系呢？

scripts.text:
[Mary]
It matters. ^0000cdBecause, I am her brother^000000.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
当然有关系。^0000cd因为，我是她的弟弟^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, you are...

[{0}]
Wha... What? A brother?

[Mary]
I am ashamed to work in this outfit since I am a man. However, there is a reason for me to stay here like this.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
身为男人，却穿着这身衣服工作，我觉得很羞耻。但我留在这里是有原因的。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
My sister was very disheartened by what had happened to her and ran off with her lover saying that she couldn't work here anymore.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
姐姐因为之前发生的事深受打击，后来带着恋人离开了，说再也没法在这里工作。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
When I told the person who is in charge of managing the maids at the palace, he said, he didn't care about my sister running off against the contract ^0000cdas long as I would bring someone to fill her position^000000.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我把这件事告诉了负责管理宫廷女仆的人。他说，只要我能找人^0000cd接替姐姐的职位^000000，姐姐违反契约逃走也没关系。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
He added how ^0000cdan enormous indemnity would be imposed on us^000000 if we fail to do so.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
他还说，如果我们做不到，^0000cd就要支付巨额赔偿金^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
When I told him that I would fill her spot, he said there were enough male chamberlains and ^0000cdhe needed a maid^000000 who would work in the kitchen and run cleaning duties.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我说我可以接替姐姐，他却说男性侍从已经够多了，^0000cd他需要一名女仆^000000负责厨房和清洁工作。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I tried to find a replacement for her, but I couldn't. Everyone was already busy working at the palace or supplying the things for the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我试着找人替她，可找不到。大家都在宫里忙着工作，或是为宴会准备物资。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
After consulting my mother, I decided to work here pretending as if I was my sister. Since everyone was so busy, no one paid attention to me who was working quietly in this corner.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
和母亲商量之后，我决定假扮姐姐在这里工作。大家都很忙，没人注意到我一直安静地在角落做事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You have managed not to be busted so far.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你居然一直没被发现。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Since ^0000cdI look just like my sister^000000, no one seems to notice.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
因为^0000cd我和姐姐长得一模一样^000000，所以似乎没人察觉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What should we do then? Jurgen really wants you to accept his love.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那现在怎么办？尤尔根真的很希望你接受他的心意。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He is in sorrow saying how difficult it is to get the first thing he has ever wanted in this entire life.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他很伤心，说这是他这辈子第一次想得到什么，却没想到会这么难。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I feel sorry for that ^0000cdthe first thing he has ever wanted to get happens to be fake^000000.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
真替他难过，^0000cd他这辈子第一次想得到的东西，竟然是假的^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I assumed that the people who have all the money in the world and have seen all the good things in the world must have a keen eye. I stand corrected.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我原以为拥有世上所有财富、见过世间一切美好事物的人，眼光一定很敏锐。看来是我错了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You get blinded when you are in love.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
人在恋爱时，总会变得盲目。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And, you really are doing so remarkably at what you are doing now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
而且，你现在的表现确实很出色。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess I should go back and tell him the truth.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想还是回去告诉他实情吧。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh! No, you shouldn't. I told you. You are the only one who knows about it.
^0000cdIf I get busted, I would be in trouble^000000. We don't have the money to pay the compensation.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
不行！我不是说过了吗？现在只有你知道这件事。^0000cd要是我被揭穿，就会惹上大麻烦^000000。我们根本赔不起。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I am keep sending the message to my sister to comeback, but it seems difficult to reach her. Would you please keep it secret until the banquet is over?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我一直在联系姐姐，让她回来，可似乎很难找到她。请帮我保守秘密，直到宴会结束，好吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Jurgen would keep sending me to earn your love, and this means that we are deceiving him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
尤尔根会一直派我来争取你的爱，这等于我们在欺骗他。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I am sorry for him, but my life depends on this.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我很抱歉，可这关系到我的生计。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hum, I don't feel comfortable doing this...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，这样做让我心里不太舒服...

scripts.text:
[Mary]
It is not my fault to be here in this clothing... Please feel for me.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
穿成这样出现在这里又不是我的错...请体谅我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, OK. Calm down. I'll tell Jurgen that you have held off the answer.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，别激动。我会告诉尤尔根，你暂时还不想答复。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please take good care of the stuff. If you return them, he will send me down here again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请把东西保管好。如果你还回去，他会再派我过来的。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Really? Then let me return them at once on the last day of the banquet. Please explain him well so that it doesn't hurt his feelings.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
真的吗？那就请在宴会最后一天再把东西还给我。请好好解释，别伤了他的心。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, I guess I should change my cleaning area so that I don't bump into him.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
哦，我应该换个打扫区域，这样就不会碰见他了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I guess it would work.
Then, let me go tell him that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好，我觉得这样可行。
那么我去告诉他。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Did you tell the prince about it?
I am worried about the consequences if anything goes wrong.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
你告诉王子了吗？
我担心万一出了差错会有什么后果。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
I may have to run off like my sister.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
我可能也得像姐姐一样逃走。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Did you tell the prince about it? I hope he gives up from tomorrow without sending you down here again.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
你告诉王子了吗？希望他明天就放弃，不再派你过来。

scripts.text:
[Mary]
Oh, when will it end.
I won't let go of this, really!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
唉，什么时候才能结束啊。
我真的不会放弃！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I don't think it is the right time. May I come back later?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，现在好像不太方便。我晚点再来可以吗？

scripts.text:
[Mary]
No, not at all.
Dear adventurer, you have a hole in your pocket. Have you lost anything?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽]
不，没事。
亲爱的冒险者，你的口袋破了。是不是掉了什么东西？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! When did I get a hole in there? Where are the ^0000cd15 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose...?^000000
They are gone! Let me come back later! I have forgotten to bring something!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！口袋什么时候破了？^0000cd15颗大海之石和1朵永恒玫瑰...^000000
都不见了！我稍后再来吧，忘了带东西！

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Adventurer? What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
冒险者？您来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Jurgen sent me here to deliver his love to you again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
尤尔根又派我来向您传达他的爱意。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Again... I really hoped he would have given up by today... I guess it must have been a vain hope.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
又来了...我还以为他今天会放弃呢...看来只是我一厢情愿。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Please tell him I appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
请告诉他，我很感激他的心意。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
I really want the banquet to be over soon. Or my sister could just come back.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
我真希望宴会快点结束，或者姐姐能回来就好了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Anyway, I am sorry to put you in the difficult situation again today.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
总之，很抱歉今天又让您为难了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well then, since I have delivered you what I have to deliver you, I should get going.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然该传达的话已经带到了，我就先告辞了。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Yes, please go back safely. I hope he gives up by tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
好的，请平安回去。希望他明天就放弃。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Oh, I am sick of cleaning! I have enough things to clean at home. I don't need to do more out here.
I should just give it all up and run away.
scripts.translation:
[女仆]
啊，我受够打扫了！家里已经有够多东西要打扫，我不想在这里还做这些。
我干脆辞职逃走算了。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Dear human, are you the one who have waken me up?
After a long sleep, I am waken up before such a mess.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
亲爱的人类，是你把我唤醒的吗？
沉睡了这么久，醒来面对的竟是这样一团糟。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Since you have the Mold Powder and alcohol with you, try getting rid of the mold now.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
你带了霉菌粉末和酒精，那就试着清除霉菌吧。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Human, what are you doing now?
I told you! You need ^0000cd1 Mold Powder and 1 Holy Water^000000 to clean up the mold!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
人类，你在做什么？
我说过了！要清除霉菌，必须带来^0000cd1份霉菌粉末和1瓶圣水^000000！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
This is not the proper way of wiping off the mold, but this is the only way to get rid of such severe mold.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
这不是清除霉菌的正确方法，但要对付这么严重的霉菌，也只能这样了。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
I am the god of cleaning sealed in the Scrub Sponge.
You shall pay for your sin of interrupting my rest with cleaning.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我是封印在擦洗海绵里的清洁之神。
你打扰我清洁休眠的罪过，就用打扫来偿还吧。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Wipe the Mold Power over the mold which resembles demon's skin and sprinkle it with Holy Water.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
把霉菌粉末涂在恶魔皮肤般的霉斑上，再洒上圣水。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Let's see. This must be ^0000cda cluster of mold^000000!
You cannot get this mold without borrowing strength from its own race and the god.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
让我看看...这一定是^0000cd一团霉菌^000000！
想清除这种霉菌，得借助同类和神明的力量。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
And wipe it as I tell you. I am not going to tell you again so pay attention.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
然后按我说的擦。我不会再说第二遍，给我仔细听好。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Tap it once gently and tap it three times more. You really need to soak the wall with the Holy Water and Mold Powder to wipe it off. This is very important.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
先轻轻拍一下，再多拍三下。用圣水和霉菌粉末把墙面充分浸湿，才能擦掉霉菌。这一步很重要。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Then, you need to scrub hard about ten times and wipe it off in circles about five times. Why don't you try now?
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
接着用力擦十下，再绕圈擦五下左右。现在试试看吧。

scripts.text:
Well done. You have cleaned it so well.
As a Scrub Sponge, I am very contented.
scripts.translation:
干得好，清理得真干净。
我这块擦洗海绵很满意。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
That's not it! Relax your arms a little!
Cleaning is not just about physical strength. You are still too far behind to reach the enlightenment. Ease your mind and body to try again.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
不对！手臂放松些！
清洁不只是靠蛮力。你离领悟清洁的真谛还差得远。放松身心，再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
That's not it! You really need to be determined to get rid of the flower of devil.
Compose yourself and listen again carefully.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
不对！想清除恶魔之花，就得下定决心！
定定神，再仔细听一遍。

scripts.text:
[Wall Which Used to Be Moldy]
The clean wall reminds me of the Scrub Sponge which has been through the cleaning duty with me.
scripts.translation:
[曾经发霉的墙]
这面干净的墙让我想起了曾与我一起清洁的擦洗海绵。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
How can you clean up without them?
Go get them first.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
没有材料怎么清理？
先去找来再说。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Bring ^0000cd1 Mold Powder and 1 Holy Water^000000!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
带来^0000cd1份霉菌粉末和1瓶圣水^000000！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Since I have fulfilled my duty, I shall go now!
Thank you, human... Thank you for being with me for this life...
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
既然我的职责已经完成，就该走了！
谢谢你，人类...谢谢你陪我度过这一生...

你打扰我的沉睡，就得用清洁来赎罪。

Wipe the Mold Power over the mold which resembles demon's skin and sprinkle it with Holy Water.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
把霉菌粉末涂在那像恶魔皮肤一样的霉菌上，再洒上圣水。

Let's see. This must be ^0000cda cluster of mold^000000!
You cannot get this mold without borrowing strength from its own race and the god.

不借助霉菌同族和神明的力量，可清不掉它。

scripts.text:

And wipe it as I tell you. I am not going to tell you again so pay attention.

照我说的步骤擦拭。我不会再讲第二遍，仔细听好。

身为擦洗海绵，我非常满意。

That's not it! You really need to be determined to get rid of the flower of devil.

[Wall Which Used to Be Moldy]

scripts.translation:
[曾经发霉的墙]
干净的墙面让我想起陪我一起完成清洁工作的擦洗海绵。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
How can you clean up without them?
Go get them first.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
没有那些东西怎么清洁？
先把它们拿来吧。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Bring ^0000cd1 Mold Powder and 1 Holy Water^000000!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
拿来^0000cd1份霉菌粉末和1份圣水^000000！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Since I have fulfilled my duty, I shall go now!
Thank you, human... Thank you for being with me for this life...
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我的使命已经完成，该离开了！
谢谢你，人类……谢谢你陪我走过这一生……

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Is it you...? Are you the one who has guided me to ^0000cdthe ingrained grease^000000?
Nice to meet you. I have been a sleep in this waiting for someone who would clean up something with me.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
是你吗...是你引导我找到了^0000cd顽固油渍^000000？
很高兴见到你。我一直沉睡在这里，等着有人和我一起清理污垢。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Since we have the orange and alcohol, let's clean up together now!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
橙子和酒精都齐了，我们现在一起清理吧！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Oh, wait a moment!
You need ^0000cd1 orange and 1 alcohol^000000 to clean up the ingrained grease.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
等等！
清理顽固油渍需要^0000cd1个橙子和1瓶酒精^000000。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Peel the orange and put the orange peels in the alcohol. Then wait a moment. You may eat the flesh of orange if you want. Yum!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
剥开橙子，把橙皮放进酒精里，等一会儿。橙肉你可以自己吃。真香！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
I am the fairy of cleaning sealed in the Scrub Sponge.
I wake up when I am near somewhere dirty.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我是封印在擦洗海绵里的清洁妖精。
靠近脏污的地方时，我就会醒来。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Well, the essence of the orange peels must have been infused in the alcohol by now. Spray it over the grease and wipe with me.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
好了，橙皮精华应该已经融入酒精了。把它喷在油渍上，再用我擦干净。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Thank you for choosing me to clean the grease.
I always wanted to clean grease in style.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
谢谢你选我来清除油渍。
我一直想优雅地清理油污。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
It takes some skills to wipe it off.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
擦掉油渍也需要技巧。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
First you need to scrub gently, gently once more and hard! Then scrub with medium strength and scrub harder.
You should then spray the mixture once more and keep wiping with medium strength.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
先轻轻擦一下，再轻轻擦一次，然后用力擦！接着用中等力道擦，再加大力气。
然后再喷一次混合液，继续用中等力道擦。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
I think you are scrubbing too gently. You should allow sometime for the grease to dissolve in the mixture.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我觉得你擦得太轻了。让油渍有些时间溶解在混合液里。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Whoa, good job! The grease is gone now!
Even better, the fresh scent remains after cleaning, making the passengers happy.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
哇，干得漂亮！油渍已经清除干净了！
而且清洁后还留下了清新香气，乘客们一定很开心。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
You shouldn't just wipe it too hard. You need to let the mixture melt into the grease to get it off.
Scrub gently and wipe it off at once. Well, listen up again.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
别只顾着用力擦。得让混合液渗入油污，才能把它除掉。
轻轻擦过后马上擦干净。再听我说一遍。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
First, you need to penetrate the grease with the mixture. Then you need to wipe off the grease. Well, let's try again.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
先让混合液渗进油渍，再把油污擦掉。来，再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
However, I will disappear soon.
It is the fate of dirty Scrub Sponge.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
不过，我很快就要消失了。
这就是脏擦洗海绵的命运。

scripts.text:
[Scrapped-off Wall]
The clean wall reminds me of the Scrub Sponge has been really kind to me.
scripts.translation:
[被刮掉的墙]
这面干净的墙让我想起那块对我很好的擦洗海绵。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
I would like to prepare it myself but I am just a Scrub Sponge.
Please bring them with you.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我也想自己准备，可我只是一块擦洗海绵。
请把材料带来。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Hum... For the ingrained grease, ^0000cdthe mixture of orange and alcohol^000000 works the best.
Would you bring ^0000cd1 orange and 1 alcohol^000000? Let's clean up with them!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
嗯...对付顽固油渍，^0000cd橙子和酒精的混合物^000000效果最好。
能带来^0000cd1个橙子和1瓶酒精^000000吗？我们用它来清理吧！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
However, I was happy to spend the short life of a Scrub Sponge with you.
I want to be born as a human in my next life to be a close... Friend of yours...
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
不过，能和你一起度过擦洗海绵短暂的一生，我很开心。
希望下辈子能转生成一个人，成为你的...亲密...朋友...

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Is it you...? Are you the one who has guided me to ^0000cdthe ingrained grease^000000?
Nice to meet you. I have been a sleep in this waiting for someone who would clean up something with me.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
是你吗……？是你把我带到了^0000cd顽固油渍^000000这里吗？
很高兴见到你。我一直在这里沉睡，等待有人陪我一起清理。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Since we have the orange and alcohol, let's clean up together now!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
既然橘子和酒精都准备好了，我们现在就一起清理吧！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Oh, wait a moment!
You need ^0000cd1 orange and 1 alcohol^000000 to clean up the ingrained grease.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
哦，等一下！
清除顽固油渍需要^0000cd1个橘子和1份酒精^000000。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Peel the orange and put the orange peels in the alcohol. Then wait a moment. You may eat the flesh of orange if you want. Yum!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
剥开橘子，把橘子皮放进酒精里，再稍等片刻。橘子肉你可以自己吃掉。真好吃！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
I am the fairy of cleaning sealed in the Scrub Sponge.
I wake up when I am near somewhere dirty.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我是封印在擦洗海绵中的清洁精灵。
只要附近有脏东西，我就会醒来。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Well, the essence of the orange peels must have been infused in the alcohol by now. Spray it over the grease and wipe with me.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
橘子皮的精华应该已经浸入酒精了。把它喷在油渍上，再用我来擦。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Thank you for choosing me to clean the grease.
I always wanted to clean grease in style.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
谢谢你选我来清理油渍。
我一直想潇洒地清理一次油污。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
It takes some skills to wipe it off.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
要擦掉它可是需要技巧的。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
First you need to scrub gently, gently once more and hard! Then scrub with medium strength and scrub harder.
You should then spray the mixture once more and keep wiping with medium strength.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
先轻轻擦，再轻轻擦一次，然后用力擦！接着中等力度擦，再更用力地擦。
然后再喷一次混合液，继续用中等力度擦拭。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
I think you are scrubbing too gently. You should allow sometime for the grease to dissolve in the mixture.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我觉得你擦得太轻了。要给混合液一点时间溶解油污。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Whoa, good job! The grease is gone now!
Even better, the fresh scent remains after cleaning, making the passengers happy.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
哇，干得漂亮！油污已经清除啦！
更棒的是，清洁后还留下了清新的香气，乘客们一定很开心。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
You shouldn't just wipe it too hard. You need to let the mixture melt into the grease to get it off.
Scrub gently and wipe it off at once. Well, listen up again.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
不能一味用力擦。要让混合液渗入油污才能清除。
轻轻擦拭，然后马上擦掉。再听我说一次。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
First, you need to penetrate the grease with the mixture. Then you need to wipe off the grease. Well, let's try again.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
先让混合液渗透油污，再把油污擦掉。好了，再试一次吧。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
However, I will disappear soon.
It is the fate of dirty Scrub Sponge.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
不过我很快就要消失了。
这就是脏海绵的命运。

scripts.text:
[Scrapped-off Wall]
The clean wall reminds me of the Scrub Sponge has been really kind to me.
scripts.translation:
[刮净的墙]
干净的墙面让我想起了对我照顾有加的擦洗海绵。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
I would like to prepare it myself but I am just a Scrub Sponge.
Please bring them with you.
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我也想亲自准备那些东西，可我只是一块擦洗海绵。
请你把它们带来。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Hum... For the ingrained grease, ^0000cdthe mixture of orange and alcohol^000000 works the best.
Would you bring ^0000cd1 orange and 1 alcohol^000000? Let's clean up with them!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
嗯……清除顽固油渍，效果最好的是^0000cd橘子和酒精的混合液^000000。
能带来^0000cd1个橘子和1份酒精^000000吗？我们用它们来清洁吧！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
However, I was happy to spend the short life of a Scrub Sponge with you.
I want to be born as a human in my next life to be a close... Friend of yours...
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
不过，能和你一起度过擦洗海绵短暂的一生，我很开心。
下辈子我想投胎做人，成为你的亲密……朋友……

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Is it you? Are you the one in charge of the cleaning mission today?
Nice to meet you! I am the cleaning instructor sealed in the Scrub Sponge!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
是你吗？你是今天负责清洁任务的人吗？
很高兴见到你！我是封印在擦洗海绵里的清洁教官！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Good! It has all been prepared!
Let's start cleaning now!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
很好！材料都准备好了！
现在开始清扫！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
What are you doing now?
You cannot get rid of the black dirt stuck in the gaps of tiles without the lemon and powdery find sand!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
你在做什么？
没有柠檬和细粉砂，就清不掉卡在地砖缝里的黑垢！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
If you follow my lead, you can get through the most difficult cleaning mission in this world!
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
跟着我的指示，就能完成世上最艰难的清洁任务！
听明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Squeeze the lemon and sprinkle the juice over the floor. Then sprinkle the powdery fine sand over it!
This will whiten and polish the floor! Not to mention the fresh scent of lemon adding something extra!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
把柠檬挤汁，洒在地板上，再撒上细粉砂！
这样能让地板洁白光亮！柠檬的清香更是锦上添花！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Let's check today's target! It is ^0000cdthe black dirt of devil^000000 stuck in the gaps in the floor!
We have a Thor 3 situation here!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
看看今天的目标！是卡在地板缝里的^0000cd恶魔黑垢^000000！
这是雷神之锤3级的紧急状况！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Then you scrub briskly with me!
The method of scrubbing is as follows! It is not difficult if you follow me! Listen up!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
接下来和我一起快速擦洗！
方法是这样的！跟着做并不难，听好了！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
In other words, we can resolve it as long as we have all the materials ready!
You need ^0000cd1 Powdery Fine Sand and 1 Lemon^000000 to get rid of the target!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
也就是说，只要材料齐全就能解决！
要清除目标，需要^0000cd1份细粉砂和1个柠檬^000000！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Three times to the left! Once to the right! Once to the left again! Twice to the front!
Then twice to the left to wrap up! Start now!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
向左三次！向右一次！再向左一次！向前两次！
最后再向左两次收尾！开始！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
When did I teach you like that? Don't you dare say that you have learned it from me!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我什么时候教过你这种方法？别说是跟我学的！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Well done!
You have completed the cleaning mission beautifully!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
干得漂亮！
你完美地完成了清洁任务！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Wrong!
Try to keep it together! Repeat once again!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
错了！
集中注意力，再来一次！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Try to keep it together! Listen up once more!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
集中注意力！再听一遍！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
I believe that you can handle cleaning perfectly even without me!
Old soldiers never die! They just fade away! So save the tears!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
我相信没有我，你也能把清洁工作做得很好！
老兵不死，只是渐渐凋零！所以别哭！

scripts.text:
[Shining Floor]
The clean floor reminds me of the Scrub Sponge who has been tough but soft inside.
scripts.translation:
[闪亮的地板]
干净的地板让我想起那块外表强硬、内心柔软的擦洗海绵。

scripts.text:
[Shining Floor]
The clean floor reminds me of the Scrub Sponge who has been tough but soft inside.
Let's go back to the maid and report that the cleaning is completed.
scripts.translation:
[闪亮的地板]
干净的地板让我想起那块外表强硬、内心柔软的擦洗海绵。
回去告诉女仆，清洁工作完成了。

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Prepare 1 Powdery Fine Sand and 1 Lemon now!
Go!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
现在准备好1份细粉砂和1个柠檬！
快去！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
Go get them now!
Go!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
现在就去拿材料！
快去！

scripts.text:
[Scrub Sponge]
You may think of me whenever you see and clean the black dirt stuck in the gaps of tiles!
Now disperse! Go!
scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
以后看到并清理地砖缝里的黑垢时，记得想起我！
现在解散！出发！

快去！
