scripts.translation:
[擦洗海绵]
以后每当你看到并清理砖缝里的黑垢时，就想想我吧！
现在解散！出发！

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Oh, my arms, legs, back and my entire body hurts. Well, I am just glad that today's work is done. I can take some rest now. I should go have some hot soup. Is it supposed to be the meat soup for today?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
哎呀，我的胳膊、腿、背，全身都疼。不过今天的工作总算完成了，可以休息了。我得去喝碗热汤。今天应该是肉汤吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
May I ask you something?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我能问你一件事吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
What is it? Is it about furniture delivery? I am off my duty today. Unless it is really urgent, would you please come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
什么事？是家具配送的事吗？我今天已经下班了。除非特别紧急，否则明天再来好吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
I am exhausted from today's work. I almost cannot stand with my back straight now.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
今天的工作把我累坏了，现在腰都快直不起来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it is not about that. You are the one who has delivered the furniture to the Wigner family, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是关于家具的。你就是把家具送到维格纳家的人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Yes, I have... Is there any problem with the furniture? What should I do? I would never be able to afford the furniture!
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
是我送的...家具出问题了吗？我该怎么办？那些家具我可赔不起！

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
What if there is a dent? Should I call James to fix it? Damage? Wrong delivery? What should I do? What is it about?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
如果家具磕坏了呢？要叫詹姆斯来修吗？要是损坏了或送错了怎么办？到底出什么事了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, nothing like that. Please relax.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，不是那样。别紧张。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
What is it? Additional delivery? I really want to take some rest now... However, I guess I have no choice since it is the Wigners that I am dealing with. Oh, I really hate it... It is just too difficult to make ends meet.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
什么事？还要追加送货吗？我现在真的想休息...不过既然是维格纳家的事，我也只能照办。唉，真烦...日子过得太难了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I just have a question for you. Have you seen a small box on the table in the room?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是，我只是想问你一件事。你在房间的桌上看到一个小盒子了吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
What box? I was busy delivering the furniture... Wait, I remember it.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
什么盒子？我当时忙着搬家具...等等，我想起来了。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
You mean the ^0000cdsmall box^000000 on the table next to the bed, right? The locked box with no particular decoration.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你是说床边桌上的^0000cd小盒子^000000吧？那个没有装饰、上了锁的盒子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I believe so.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
应该就是它。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Yes, I remember it. It was a simple box without any decoration, but it looked very classy.
The wood was of the finest quality and the locking device was exquisite. I could tell that it must have been made by a master artisan at a glance.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
嗯，我记得。那是个没有装饰的素净小盒子，却显得很典雅。
木料上乘，锁具也很精巧。我一眼就看出那是名匠的作品。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Since I work with furniture, a piece like that really catches my eyes. It really was a work of art.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
我毕竟是做家具这行的，那样的东西特别引人注目。真是件艺术品。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Was the box still there after you delivered the furniture?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你送完家具后，盒子还在吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Yes, it was. The box cannot move itself, can it?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
还在啊。盒子总不会自己长腿跑掉吧？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Oh, wait? Are you telling me that it is missing? Are you implying that it has been carried out in my carriage?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
等等，你是说盒子不见了？你怀疑它被装上我的马车带走了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. Please calm down. I am not suspecting you. I just want to listen to your story. I am just tracking the whereabouts of the box based on the words of the people who have seen the box.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是。请冷静，我没有怀疑你。我只是想听听你的说法，根据见过盒子的人提供的线索追查它的去向。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
If anything goes missing, it is always us, the ordinary people, who are suspected. Do you know that it is just a prejudice?
The people who have less must be hungry for money. And they are unvirtuous...
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
东西一丢，总是我们这些普通人先被怀疑。你知道这其实是种偏见吗？
好像穷人就一定贪财、品行不端似的...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It is just a misunderstanding. Trust me, I am not suspecting you.... You know, you look for any witnesses when a person goes missing.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这只是误会，相信我，我没有怀疑你...出了什么事，总得找目击者问问。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
I don't want to hear it! Why are you scaring an innocent furniture delivery man for some missing box?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
我不想听！一个盒子不见了，你干吗要吓唬无辜的送货员？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry to make you uncomfortable. I am just asking everyone who has been in that room. I am not suspecting you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉让你不舒服了。我只是在询问进过房间的人，并没有怀疑你。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Heh, not that it makes me feel any better. I think I may be feeling even worse since I am hungry. Oh, my stomach is growling... I don't feel well...
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
哼，这话也没让我好受些。我现在饿得更难受了，肚子都在叫...我不舒服...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you need something to eat?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你想吃点东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
It doesn't change anything even if you say that...Well, I may be able to let it go if I have some Ox Head Slices... I cannot forget the taste from 10 years ago...
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你这么说也没用...不过要是能吃到牛头肉片，我也许就不计较了。我忘不了十年前吃到的味道...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Would it make you feel better?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
吃点东西会让你舒服些吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Well, not that it will... OK, good! I'll let it go for ^0000cd3 Ox Head Slices^000000! Fair is fair after all.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
嗯...也不一定...好吧！给我^0000cd3份牛头肉片^000000，事情就算了！这才公平。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Would it be enough? OK, please wait for me then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这些够吗？好，那请等我一下。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
You are here. If you came here any late, I would have been really upset as I get parched with thirst.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你来了。再晚一点我可真要不高兴了，口都渴干了。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Your hands seem empty.
Did you forget? I said I would let it go with ^0000cd3 {0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你两手空空的。
忘了吗？我说过给我^0000cd3份{0}^000000就不计较了。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
I wouldn't let it go without them! I won't! I'll tell people that there is an adventurer who frames an innocent person! He!
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
没有肉片我绝不算了！绝不！我要告诉大家，有个冒险者在诬陷无辜的人！哼！

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
You are here. If you came here any late, I would have been really upset due to my raging stomach.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你来了。再晚一点我可真要不高兴了，肚子都饿得咕咕叫。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it was very difficult to get them. Here you are.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
弄到这些可不容易。给你。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Let's see! Oh, this is it! Have you had good wine with some Ox Head Slices? You will never get over this heavenly combination!
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
让我看看！哦，就是这个！你吃过牛头肉片配美酒吗？这绝妙的组合，吃过就忘不了！

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
This tastes the same as it did 10 years ago! Now I feel fully recovered from the fatigue! I don't feel tired any more! All the stress is gone!
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
味道和十年前一模一样！我现在彻底恢复精神了，一点也不累，压力也全消了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, it sure looks delicious. I should try some later. Anyways, do you know anything else about the box?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看起来真美味，我稍后也尝尝。对了，你还知道那个盒子的其他消息吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Are we still talking about it? Let's not talk about such thing while I am enjoying some wine and meat. My carriage is heavy when I get in, but it is as light as a feather when I get out.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
还在说那个盒子啊？我正享受美酒佳肴，别提那些事。我的马车上车时很沉，下车时却轻得像羽毛。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
If you feel suspicious, ask the Gate Guard. He inspected my carriage.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你要是怀疑，可以去问城门卫兵。他检查过我的马车。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Oh, well. By the way...
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
哦，对了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
对了什么？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Have you seen the princess of the family? You must have. Doesn't she appear suspicious to you? I can tell people's character by their faces. She seems to be hiding something. She may stab you in the back.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你见过那家的公主吗？肯定见过吧。你不觉得她很可疑吗？我看人很准，她似乎藏着什么秘密，说不定会在背后捅你一刀。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Isn't it called a prejudice to judge some based on the appearance?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
仅凭外表判断别人，不也是一种偏见吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
You are right. I feel sorry, However, there are people talking about it. There's no smoke without fire.
No? Well. Perhaps, there could be smoke without fire.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你说得对，我不该这么说。不过确实有人在议论她。俗话说，无风不起浪。
不是吗？嗯...也许有时无火也会有烟。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Katrin was not that kind of person as far as I observed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
据我所知，卡特琳不是那种人。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Well, if not, that's fine. Anyways, the box was there in its place when I left the room. You may go if you don't have any business left here.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
那就好。总之我离开房间时，盒子还在原处。你没别的事就可以走了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Dear adventurer, why are you here again? Didn't you say you were heading back to the palace?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
亲爱的冒险者，你怎么又回来了？你不是说要回宫里吗？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
Do you have more things to as me? Or are you going to drink with me?
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
你还有什么事要问我？还是想留下来陪我喝一杯？

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
I wouldn't mind.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
我倒是不介意。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
I should earn enough money to open a store of my own. The owner only lets me deliver the furniture and never teaches me how to make one.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
我得攒够钱自己开家店。老板只让我送家具，从来不教我怎么制作家具。

scripts.text:
[Furniture Deliveryman]
All the cutting and delivery work will break my back.
Oh, my back hurts.
scripts.translation:
[家具送货员]
又是切割又是搬运，简直要把我的腰累断了。
唉，我的背好疼。

scripts.text:
[Ryosun]
I finally have the strawberry cake no one has ever touched.
The things I have been through to keep the cake in the expedition camp... I am about to burst into tears... Aww...
scripts.translation:
[良孙]
我终于拿到了没人碰过的草莓蛋糕。
为了把它从远征营地保下来，我吃了不少苦...我都快哭出来了...呜呜...

scripts.text:
[Ryosun]
Strawberry! Strawberry! This strawberry cake belongs to Ryosun! I won't give it to anyone.
scripts.translation:
[良孙]
草莓！草莓！这块草莓蛋糕是良孙的！谁也别想拿走。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain]
Are you having a good time?
We have put a lot of efforts since it's a big event in the palace in a long while.
I hope you like it.
scripts.translation:
[侍从长]
玩得开心吗？
这是宫里难得一见的大型活动，我们为此费了不少心思。
希望您能喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
It is always my pleasure to attend a banquet. Traveling and learning about different cultures are always interesting. It just makes it better to have good music and delicious food.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
参加宴会总是我的荣幸。旅行和了解不同的文化总是很有趣。如果有美妙的音乐和美味的食物，那就更好了。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
It is always tiring to attend a banquet. I am still tired from the trip, it is just too painful to mingle with people... Phew...
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
参加宴会总是很累的。我还在旅途的疲劳中，与人应酬实在太痛苦了...呼...

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
The Palace of Rune Midgarts is so big and glamourous. It somewhat feels exotic too. It's been a long way, but I am glad to be here.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
卢恩·米德加兹的宫殿如此宏大华丽。它甚至带有一点异域风情。路途遥远，但我很高兴能来到这里。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
Oh, aren't you the adventurer who has saved the world? Please visit Portmalaya someday. Everyone will welcome you there! Your story is known even to a far away place from here!
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
哦，您不就是那位拯救了世界的冒险者吗？请有一天来波塔马拉亚。那里的人都会欢迎您！您的故事甚至传到了离这里很远的地方！

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
The music played by the music makes me so emotional. It is worthwhile to come here for this music alone.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
乐手演奏的音乐让我如此感动。光是为了这音乐，来这里就值得了。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
Wait, I have been looking at the flowers here. Are they blinking? How wonderful!
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
等等，我一直在看这里的花。它们在眨眼吗？太美妙了！

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
I visited the Palace of Rune Midgarts long time ago. It has changed a lot ever since. It has become much more glamourous and magnificent that I really enjoy being guided around this place.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
我很久以前就参观过伦米德加特的宫殿。自那以后它变化很大，变得更加华丽宏伟，我很享受在这里被引导参观。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
There are a long of people here. I almost feel dizzy. However, still, I like the lively atmosphere.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
这里人真多。我几乎要头晕了。不过，我依然喜欢这种热闹的氛围。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
I have come to Prontera to attend the banquet from Amatsu. It sure feels totally different from Amatsu. Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
我从天津町来普隆德拉参加宴会。感觉和天津町完全不同呢。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
Grandfather, don't overtax your strength.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
爷爷，别太勉强自己了。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
All the nobility who are in charge of the market in Rune Midgarts are here. We, the Cat Hand Services, shouldn't miss this chance.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
负责伦米德加特市场的所有贵族都在这里。我们“猫爪服务”可不能错过这个机会。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
I'll score contracts as tall as my height.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
我要签下和我身高一样高的一摞契约。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
I am an old fan of Orint of the band.
I have spent a lot of money and time not to miss any of his performance.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
我是乐队成员奥林的资深粉丝。
我花了很多钱和时间，只为不错过他的任何一场演出。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
It was very difficult to get my hands on the invitation to this banquet.
It was so exclusive that I almost joined the expedition!
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
拿到这次宴会的邀请函非常困难。
它太专属了，我差点就加入远征队了！

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Guest]
The twin sisters of the band are of completely different characters. However, they are good at imitate each other.
When they pretend to be one person, they really looks like Doppelgangers.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅宾客]
乐队里的双胞胎姐妹个性截然不同，却很擅长模仿彼此。
她们假扮成同一个人时，简直就像分身一样。

scripts.text:
[Ekinasia]
You have been invited to the banquet as well.
Well, no wonder... If you think about it.
scripts.translation:
[埃基纳西亚]
你也受邀参加宴会了。
嗯，难怪...仔细想想也是。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Oh, you are still alive!
I am glad to see you here. Life must be treating you well!
scripts.translation:
[琳]
哦，你还活着！
很高兴在这里见到你。生活一定对你很好吧！

scripts.text:
[Ekinasia]
Come to think of it, Kid is here too.
He met the people from the guild and went to see them...
scripts.translation:
[埃基纳西亚]
说起来，小孩也在这里。
他遇到了公会的人，就过去找他们了...

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Hum... Then he was taken by a strange guy among the bunch to the dining hall.
You may go say hi.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
嗯...然后他被那群人中的一个奇怪的家伙带到了餐厅。
你可以去打个招呼。

scripts.text:
[Ekinasia]
It is a banquet in a long time. We may as well enjoy it.
scripts.translation:
[埃基纳西亚]
这是很久以来的一场宴会。我们不妨好好享受一下。

scripts.text:
[Lin]
Well, this is how the aristocrats spend their time!
Haha, let's see which lady is wearing the most beautiful dress.
scripts.translation:
[琳]
原来贵族们是这样打发时间的！
哈哈，让我们看看哪位女士穿着最漂亮的裙子。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Who are you...?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
你是谁...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
...Oh... You have visited us to change your class, I remember.
We have recommended you as a representative of the guild.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
...哦...我记得你来过我们这里转职。
我们推荐你作为公会的代表。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I am glad to see you all grown up.
Never forget the weight of the blood to be covered on your hands at all times.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
很高兴看到你长大了。
永远不要忘记你手上沾染的血的重量。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You must have been invited to the banquet.
So are we.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
你一定是受邀参加宴会的。
我们也是。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
It is rare to see the palace open to public like this. Enjoy as much as you can.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
像这样向公众开放宫殿的机会很少见。
请尽情尽兴吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
...I don't like a crowded place like this, but I cannot help it when I am on a mission.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
...我不喜欢这种拥挤的地方，但执行任务时身不由己。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are here too.
Well, I guess you are supposed to be here.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你也在这里。
看来你本该出现在这里。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
...What a trouble.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
...真是麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh, is it the first time since our last encounter for your class change?
Thanks to your contribution, the position of the guild has been strengthened.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
哦，这是自上次为你办理转职以来我们第一次见面吧？
多亏了你的贡献，公会的地位更加稳固了。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I guess you will be the hero of the palace.
I am glad to see you well.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
我想你将成为宫殿里的英雄。
很高兴看到你一切安好。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hum... Did we meet at Criatura?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
嗯...我们是在克里阿图拉见过的吗？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I have dealt with too many people...
Your face seemed familiar...
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
我接触的人太多了...
你的脸看起来很眼熟...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Well whatever.
Are you enjoying the banquet?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
算了，无所谓。
你在宴会上玩得开心吗？

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Aristocrat]
I really like banquets.
The drowsy music, the whispering people and the chamberlains carrying the refreshments. I think I am nobly born to see it.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅贵族]
我真的很喜欢宴会。
慵懒的音乐，低语的人群，还有端着点心的侍从长。我觉得自己生来就是为了欣赏这一切的。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Aristocrat]
I know this banquet is held for someone else. However, it still is a great opportunity for me to meet someone I can spend my life with.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅贵族]
我知道这场宴会是为别人举办的。不过，这对我来说也是一个寻找能共度一生之人的绝佳机会。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Aristocrat]
Everyone else seems to love the banquet, but I don't. I am forced by my parents to come here. I really want to go home and take a rest now.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅贵族]
其他人都似乎很享受宴会，但我并不喜欢。我是被父母逼着来的。我现在真的很想回家休息。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Hall Aristocrat]
This band is pretty good.
I'd like to invite them to the royal villa for my party.
scripts.translation:
[宴会厅贵族]
这支乐队相当不错。
我想邀请他们去皇家别墅参加我的派对。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Ellie]
Dwit! Look at the nobility over there. Aren't they beautiful?
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 艾莉]
德威特！看那边的贵族们。他们是不是很迷人？

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
Hum, yes they are. I think you would fit in there perfectly though.
One day, I'll play the guitar next to you dancing and singing in a blue dress.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 德威特]
嗯，确实如此。不过我觉得你在那里会非常合拍。
总有一天，我会弹着吉他，看着你穿着蓝色裙子跳舞唱歌。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Occi]
Haha, that woman in the blue dress, it could be me!
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥奇]
哈哈，那个穿蓝裙子的女人，说不定就是我！

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
You are mistaken if you think I cannot distinguish you twin sisters, Occi. I can tell your differences from the steps you take and the sound of your breath.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 德威特]
奥奇，如果你以为我分不清你们这对双胞胎姐妹，那可就错了。我能从步态和呼吸声分辨出你们。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
When I first met Orint, I thought he was stoic and unconcerned. However, he turned out to be a man of extraordinary concentration and possessiveness.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 德威特]
我第一次见到奥林特时，以为他沉默寡言、什么都不在乎。后来才发现，他专注得惊人，而且占有欲很强。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
He always tries to be the best. That's why he can play the tune like that.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 德威特]
他总是力求做到最好。这就是为什么他能演奏出那样的旋律。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
However, he doesn't know when to concentrate. His behavior is often misread.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 德威特]
然而，他不知道何时该专注。他的行为常常被误解。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Dwit]
Anyways, we are invited to an honorable place like this thanks to Orint.
If you want to hear any song, ask him to play it for you.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 德威特]
总之，多亏了奥林特，我们才能受邀来到这样尊贵的地方。
想听什么曲子，就请他演奏吧。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Occi]
It has been our dream to ensemble in a place like this. Am I right, Orint?
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥奇]
能在这样的地方合奏一直是我们的梦想。我说得对吧，奥林特？

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Orint]
Chatting is forbidden while working.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥林特]
工作时禁止闲聊。

scripts.text:
[Court Musician Occi]
Yes, I see. You are so boring. But it is part of your charm, haha.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师 奥奇]
好的，我知道了。你真无趣。不过这也是你魅力的一部分，哈哈。

scripts.text: - That lazy-looking cat is sitting near the feet of the musician. It shows no interest in you. -
scripts.translation: - 那只懒洋洋的猫坐在乐师脚边，对你毫不在意。 -

scripts.text:
[Hiba Ajif]
Since Ashbacuum has been taken care of, I want to go home and take a nap. However, they are holding me here.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉夫]
阿什巴克姆的事既然已经处理完，我真想回家睡个午觉。可他们偏偏把我留在这里。

scripts.text:
[Avidal the Advisor]
It is the event to praise our contributions. Try to smile a little.
scripts.translation:
[顾问阿维达尔]
这是表彰我们贡献的活动，稍微笑一笑吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Brother, these shoes hurt my feet. May I go back to the guest room and sleep?
scripts.translation:
[指导员伊格丽德]
哥哥，这双鞋磨得我脚疼。我能回客房睡觉吗？

scripts.text:
[Avidal the Advisor]
I have spent too much time in the tension between the two races. It just feels like I am dreaming to be in a happy and relaxing place like this. This must be what they call peace, right?
scripts.translation:
[顾问阿维达尔]
我在两个种族的紧张关系中待了太久。能身处这么轻松愉快的地方，简直像做梦。这就是所谓的和平吧？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
If they really want to do something for us, they really let us take a rest.
Only the ones who don't work in the field like an event like this. It is true.
scripts.translation:
[指导员伊格丽德]
他们真想为我们做点什么，就该让我们休息。
只有不在一线工作的人才喜欢这种活动。确实如此。

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Argh... I have never been to a place like this...
I am so nervous... I shouldn't have come...
scripts.translation:
[布鲁诺]
啊...我从没来过这种地方...
紧张死了...我真不该来...

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
Everyone dresses so fancy...
scripts.translation:
[布鲁诺]
大家都穿得好华丽...

scripts.text:
[Bruno]
By the way, where has the master gone leaving me alone?
scripts.translation:
[布鲁诺]
对了，师父把我一个人丢在这里，自己去哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[Karian]
Banquets are fun!
Good food! Beautiful music! People talking to one another!
scripts.translation:
[卡里安]
宴会真有趣！
好吃的食物！美妙的音乐！大家有说有笑！

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
I have heard that my grandson is under indebtedness to your son these days.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
我听说最近我的孙子欠了你儿子一笔人情。

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Not at all. My son is supposed to be learning from your smart grandson. Haha.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
哪里哪里，我儿子才该向您聪明的孙子多学习。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Please take care of our son, Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
请多关照我们的儿子艾萨克。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
Many things have changed since the last time we were here in the palace. I want to come here more often, but we cannot find the excuse to come...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
自从上次来王宫，已经有很多变化了。我想常来看看，可我们总找不到合适的理由...

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
You can come here with an invitation. It is not difficult visiting here.
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
有邀请函就能来，不难的。

scripts.text:
[Catherine]
You know that is not what I mean...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳]
你知道我不是这个意思...

scripts.text:
[Levuiere]
Dear Roegenburg, how are your children doing? I often hear about your third grandson from Isaac/
scripts.translation:
[勒维埃尔]
罗根堡先生，您的孩子们近来如何？我常听艾萨克提起您的三孙子。

scripts.text:
[Maximilian]
Oh, they are doing fine. Please visit our home when you get the time.
scripts.translation:
[马克西米利安]
哦，他们都很好。有空欢迎来我们家做客。

scripts.text:
[Bagette Teeblack]
I have a lot of study to do... I feel terrible to be dragged to a banquet like this.
scripts.translation:
[巴盖特·蒂布莱克]
我还有好多功课要做...被拉来参加这种宴会，真让人难受。

scripts.text:
[Bagette Teeblack]
I wonder if Theodor is handling the work well by himself.
scripts.translation:
[巴盖特·蒂布莱克]
不知道西奥多一个人处理工作顺不顺利。

scripts.text:
[Isabella]
I really like banquets. Especially the ones hosted by the palace! Everything is so glamourous and sparkly!
scripts.translation:
[伊莎贝拉]
我真的很喜欢宴会，尤其是王宫举办的！一切都那么华丽闪耀！

scripts.text:
[Beatrice]
In a banquet like this, we, women, study other women. About who is wearing which dress and what kind of jewelry she is wearing...
scripts.translation:
[贝阿特丽丝]
这种宴会上，女士们总会观察彼此，看看谁穿了什么裙子、戴了什么首饰...

scripts.text:
[Beatrice]
Those judging eyes are as sharp as those of ferocious beasts. If we find a lady who looks fabulous, we admire her looks with pure admiration.
scripts.translation:
[贝阿特丽丝]
我们审视彼此的目光像猛兽一样锐利。遇到打扮出众的女士，我们也会由衷地欣赏。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Hahahahaha!
I should have seen the face! Please invite me to one of those events next time.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
哈哈哈哈！
我真该看看当时的表情！下次也邀请我参加这种活动吧。

scripts.text:
[Isabella]
Oh, you are always so busy, Isaac. A banquet like this one is the only occasion I can see your face.
scripts.translation:
[伊莎贝拉]
哦，艾萨克，你总是那么忙。这种宴会是我唯一能见到你的机会。

scripts.text:
[Beitrice]
Yes! You must be ranked in top 3 of the busiest people in Prontera these days, Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[贝阿特丽丝]
没错！艾萨克，你现在肯定是普隆德拉最忙的三个人之一。

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
He also comes home late after discussing business with Isaac everyday. I really don't like it.
scripts.translation:
[索菲娅]
他每天和艾萨克谈完生意都很晚才回家。我真不喜欢这样。

scripts.text:
[Bryan]
Don't you say such a thing!
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
别这么说！

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
Oh! I am sorry to keep Bryan with me. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
哦，抱歉让布莱恩一直陪着我。失陪了。

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
However, please understand. It is the most important time for our business. I'll tell him to devote his time to you after this time is over, dear Sophia.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
不过请理解，这是我们生意最关键的时期。等忙完这阵子，我会多陪陪你，亲爱的索菲娅。

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Oh, you should keep those words!
scripts.translation:
[索菲娅]
哦，你可要说到做到！

scripts.text:
[Isaac]
I'll make sure of it. I swear in the name of Isaac Wigner.
scripts.translation:
[艾萨克]
我一定做到。我以艾萨克·维格纳之名起誓。

scripts.text:
[Isabella]
Haha, since you have promised me in the name of your family, I guess I can trust you, Isaac.
scripts.translation:
[伊莎贝拉]
哈哈，既然你以家族之名起誓，我想我可以相信你，艾萨克。

scripts.text:
[Bryan]
Don't leave me alone today. I feel nervous if you are not next to me.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
今天别丢下我一个人。你不在身边，我会紧张。

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Oh dear, I want to catch up with the people whom I haven't been able to see for a long time. You may go talk to other people.
scripts.translation:
[索菲娅]
亲爱的，我想和好久没见的人叙叙旧。你也可以去和别人聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Bryan]
They only talk about business. I don't enjoy it at all. I don't want to feel like being at work when I am here.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
他们只谈生意，我一点也不喜欢。我可不想在这里也像在上班。

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Then, you should follow me.
scripts.translation:
[索菲娅]
那你跟我来吧。

scripts.text:
[Bryan]
Well.. I don't feel comfortable... With too many ladies around...
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
嗯...我不太自在...周围女士太多了...

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Oh, darling, I love to be here in the palace after a long time. There are so many friendly faces around here.
However...
scripts.translation:
[索菲娅]
哦，亲爱的，难得来一次王宫，我真开心。这里有好多熟悉的面孔。
不过...

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Everyone else looks so nice, and I feel rather underdressed.
scripts.translation:
[索菲娅]
大家都穿得那么漂亮，显得我穿得太随便了。

scripts.text:
[Bryan]
It is not true! You are the most beautiful person in this place. You are the only one I see here.
scripts.translation:
[布莱恩]
才不是！你是这里最美的人，我眼里只有你。

scripts.text:
[Sophia]
Oh, I am so embarrassed...
scripts.translation:
[索菲娅]
啊，我真不好意思...

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
If you are going to borrow a book, you'd better reduce your luggage. It seems that there is no space for a book.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
要借书的话，最好先清理一下行李。看起来你没地方放书了。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Have you read the book? Did you come to return the book. Well, seeing your hands empty, it seems that you didn't finished the book yet.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
书看完了吗？你是来还书的？看你两手空空，应该还没读完吧。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Take the time to look around. Take out and read any book that comes into your favor.
The book always enriches mind.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
慢慢找吧。选一本你喜欢的书出来读读。
书本总能充实心灵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, I'm looking for a book. Would you please advice me where it is?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我在找一本书。能告诉我它在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
What kind of book are you looking for?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
你在找什么书？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A book about history of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一本关于卢恩·米德加兹历史的书。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Hm... history of Rune-Midgarts.
Are you going to borrow the book?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
嗯...卢恩·米德加兹的历史。
你要借这本书吗？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
May I see your library card, please?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
请出示你的借书证。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Library card? I don't have such a thing.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
借书证？我没有这种东西。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Then, I cannot borrow a book to you.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
那我就不能把书借给你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How can I have a library card?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我怎么才能得到一张借书证？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
If you present your identification card, we will make you one instantly.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
出示身份证明，我们就能马上为你办理借书证。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh... I don't have it. I left all my things to attend the banquet.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...我没有。我把所有东西都留在参加宴会的地方了。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Banquet? You mean the banquet held in the palace? Are you the adventurer invited to it?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
宴会？你是说在宫殿里举办的那个宴会吗？你是受邀参加的冒险者吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I am...

[Uptight Librarian]
Then you are a person guaranteed by the kingdom and I can borrow a book to you through a simple process.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
那你就是王国认可的人，我可以简化手续把书借给你。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
The kingdom circulated your details and ordered to provide maximum convenience to you.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
王国已经传阅了你的资料，并要求我们尽可能为你提供便利。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's nice, but I feel that privacy is not protected.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这倒不错，不过感觉隐私没有得到保护。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
What is you name, sir?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
请问，先生，你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Let me see...
Yes, here it is. Sir {0}...
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
让我看看...
是的，在这里。{0}先生...

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
But this book consists of 12 volumes. Only the first volume is here and the others are already borrowed.
Is it OK with you?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
不过这套书一共有12卷。现在只有第一卷在馆里，其余都借出去了。
你觉得可以吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, it is.

[Uptight Librarian]
Hmm. Anyway, can I ask you some questions? I know nothing as I stay in the library all day long.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
嗯。对了，我能问你几个问题吗？我整天待在图书馆，外面的事什么都不知道。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I tell you as long as I know.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，只要我知道，我就告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
^0000cdWhat kind of banquet ^000000 is being held in the palace? Why are you and royal family members invited?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
^0000cd王宫里举办的是什么宴会^000000？为什么你和王室成员都受邀参加？

scripts.text: Birth of prince.
scripts.translation: 王子诞生

scripts.text: Birthday of king.
scripts.translation: 国王生日

scripts.text: In memory of defeating Morocc.
scripts.translation: 纪念击败梦罗克

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我刚才想到别的事，说错了。
我弄混了。你刚才说什么来着？

^0000cd宫殿里正在举办什么样的宴会^000000？为什么你和王室成员都被邀请了？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Ah, I see.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
啊，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Did ^0000cdall royal families^000000 attend the banquet?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
^0000cd所有王室家族^000000都出席宴会了吗？

scripts.text: 8 royal families attended it.
scripts.translation: 8个王室家族都出席了

scripts.text: 7 royal families attended it.
scripts.translation: 7个王室家族都出席了

scripts.text: 6 royal families attended it.
scripts.translation: 6个王室家族都出席了

Did ^0000cdall royal families^000000 attend the banquet?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
^0000cd所有王室成员^000000都参加了宴会吗？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
The palace must be crowded. It is very rare that all royal families gather like this, but...
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
王宫里一定很热闹。所有王室家族齐聚一堂的场面很少见，不过...

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
I heard that there are royal families ^0000cdwho do not attend the Royal Assembly^000000. Who's that?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
我听说有几个王室家族^0000cd没有参加皇家议会^000000。是哪几家？

scripts.text: Wigner and Heine.
scripts.translation: 维格纳家族和海涅家族

scripts.text: Roegenburg and Richard.
scripts.translation: 罗根堡家族和理查德家族

scripts.text: Geoborg and Walther.
scripts.translation: 乔博格家族和瓦尔特家族

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我刚才想到别的事，说错了。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
I heard that there are royal families ^0000cdwho do not attend the Royal Assembly^000000. Who's that?
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
我听说有几个王室家族^0000cd没有参加皇家议会^000000。是哪几家？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Well, it is understandable that the Geoborg and the Walther do not attend the assembly.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
嗯，乔博格家族和瓦尔特家族不参加议会，倒也情有可原。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
The family of the previous king ^0000cdbecame so due to the old curse^000000...
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
前任国王的家族^0000cd因古老的诅咒而变成这样^000000...

scripts.text: You mean the Nerius?
scripts.translation: 你是说内里乌斯家族？

scripts.text: You mean the Geoborg?
scripts.translation: 你是说乔博格家族吗？

scripts.text: You mean the Richard?
scripts.translation: 你是说理查德家族吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry, I said wrong as I thought of something else.
I made a mistake. What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我刚才想起别的事，说错了。
我弄混了。你刚才说什么来着？

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
The family of the previous king ^0000cdbecame so due to the old curse^000000...
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
前任国王的家族^0000cd因古老的诅咒而变成这样^000000...

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Yes, you are right. it is ^0000cdthe Geoborg^000000. The queen must be lonely.
Thank you very much for advising me though you are busy.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
没错，是^0000cd乔博格家族^000000。女王一定很孤独。
谢谢你百忙之中提醒我。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
I have been alone these days as no one has visited the library due to the banquet.
History of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
最近宴会举办期间，没人来图书馆，我一直很孤单。
《卢恩·米德加兹的历史》。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
You can borrow it for one week. There is a fee for overdue books, but I was instructed to make you exempt from it
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
你可以借一周。逾期要罚款，不过上面吩咐我免除你的罚款。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Well, if you make much of honor, you will not be overdue.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
嗯，重视荣誉的人自然不会逾期。

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Then, enjoy the book!
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
祝你阅读愉快！

scripts.text:
[Uptight Librarian]
Take the time to look around. Take out and read any book that comes into your favor.
The book always enriches mind.
scripts.translation:
[古板的图书管理员]
慢慢找吧。挑一本你喜欢的书读读。
书本总能充实心灵。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
There are so many guests attending the banquet.
However, since we are in the library, would you keep it down?
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
来参加宴会的客人真多。不过这里毕竟是图书馆，可以小声一点吗？

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Are you attending the banquet and exchanging greeting with each family?
Then you should go see Spica Nerius, not me.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
你是来参加宴会、和各家族打招呼的吗？那该去找斯皮卡·内里乌斯，而不是我。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Although Shedhar, the current head of the family, is not here, Spica has all the actual power.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
虽然现任家主谢德哈尔不在，但斯皮卡掌握着家族的实权。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I am just participating in the Royal Assembly to fill in the place as a Nerius.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
我只是代替内里乌斯家族出席皇家议会的。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I am not interested in the throne at all.
So you should go see Spica.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
我对王位毫无兴趣。你还是去找斯皮卡吧。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Enjoy the banquet too.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
也祝你宴会愉快。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
Did you meet Spica?
She is such a cheerful girl, isn't she?
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
见过斯皮卡了吗？
她是个很开朗的女孩，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Erich]
She will be the head of the Nerius family.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
她会成为内里乌斯家族的家主。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I am treated like a prince since I was adopted against my will. However, Shedhar, the head of the family, has been nice to me.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
我虽是被迫收养的，却一直被当作王子看待。不过家主谢德哈尔待我很好。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
She told me to do whatever I wanted.
...She even let me decide whether I should attend the ritual or not,
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
她让我想做什么就做什么...甚至让我自己决定要不要参加仪式。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I think I will be forgiven whatever I do.
I seem to have gained freedom and negligence at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
我想无论做什么，她都会原谅我。
我似乎同时得到了自由，也被放任不管。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
I like the way it is now though.
I can do whatever I want to do.
scripts.translation:
[埃里希]
不过我喜欢现在这样。
我可以随心所欲。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Oh! This! That! This!
And there it is!
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
哦！这个！那个！这个！
在那里！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Oh, I don't have this book in my collection!
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
哦，我的藏书里没有这本！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
How great to be in the palace! There is everything!
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
待在皇宫真好！这里什么都有！

scripts.text:
[Alf]
Oh! This book must be the one from the legend...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
哦！这本书一定就是传说中的那本...

scripts.text:
[Alf]
I wasn't interested in attending the royal banquet...
However, I am glad to be here!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
我本来对皇家宴会没兴趣...
不过能来这里真好！

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
It is not here either....
scripts.translation:
[紧张的男子]
这里也没有...

scripts.text:
[Taunting Man]
Why do you need that book? Just go without it.
scripts.translation:
[出言挑衅的男子]
你找那本书干什么？没有就算了。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
The first impression is the most important. The first greeting has a big impact! By the way, what should I speak as a greeting?
scripts.translation:
[紧张的男子]
第一印象最重要，第一次打招呼更是关键！对了，我该怎么开场才好？

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
'Good morning, sir. I, an unworthy person, live in Prontera....' No. No. I cannot speak like to a person who is younger than me.
scripts.translation:
[紧张的男子]
“早上好，先生。我这不成器的人住在普隆德拉...”不行不行，我不能这样对比我年轻的人说话。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
Hi? Your brother told me to attend the banquet. No. No. this is not either. My patner is a princess!
scripts.translation:
[紧张的男子]
“你好？是你哥哥让我来参加宴会的。”不行，这也不对。我的舞伴可是公主啊！

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
Why is there no book such as ¡®Royal Etiquette - Meet Princess First Time' It's a royal library.
scripts.translation:
[紧张的男子]
皇家图书馆怎么会没有《皇家礼仪：初次会见公主》这种书？

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
He sent me on the excuse of being busy. Jonathan, I'll get you.
scripts.translation:
[紧张的男子]
他拿忙当借口把我打发来了。乔纳森，我不会放过你的。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Man]
It is not here, either. How can I find it. There are so many books here.
scripts.translation:
[紧张的男子]
这里也没有。我该怎么找？书实在太多了。

scripts.text:

Would you enter the Banquet Hall?
scripts.translation:
[皇家守护骑士]
您要进入宴会厅吗？

scripts.text: Enter.
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Do not enter.
scripts.translation: 不进入

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

宴会厅随时开放。还请您赏光出席。

scripts.text:
[Royal Guardian Knight]
Let me escort you inside.
scripts.translation:
[皇家守护骑士]
请允许我带您进去。

scripts.translation:

工作时禁止闲聊。

scripts.text: - Unlike her gaze glaring at the table while being cautious about the surroundings, the speed of her eating the food on the table is so remarkable that it is almost artistic. -
scripts.translation: - 她警惕地环顾四周，目光却紧盯着餐桌上的食物，进食速度快得惊人，简直像一场表演。 -

scripts.text: - There is a girl with a expressionless face looking at the table. Her outfit seems rather unusual in Prontera. She could be a guest attending the banquet. -
scripts.translation: - 一个面无表情的少女盯着餐桌。她的穿着在普隆德拉显得很特别，应该是来参加宴会的宾客。 -

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
......
...I am hungry.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...
...我饿了。

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
......
Ah....!
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...
啊...！

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
You... At Cheshrumnir...
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
你...在瑟斯隆尼勒...

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Hum hum!
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
哼哼！

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
...I am sorry Niren...
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...对不起，尼伦...

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Shh! Shh! Do not call me by the name, please. We are not officially invited to be here! Don't forget!
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
嘘！嘘！请不要叫我的名字。我们并没有正式受邀来到这里！别忘了这一点！

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
......
Eh...
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...
呃...

scripts.text: How did you come here?
scripts.translation: 你是怎么进来的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How did you come here?
Is it something dangerous? Is it about the international affairs or the international situation...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是怎么来到这里的？
是有什么危险吗？是关于国际事务还是国际局势...

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
.....
In secret.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...
偷偷进来的。

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
...The banquet... Something tasty.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...宴会...有好吃的。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
<Miss Lang>
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
《朗小姐》

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Woman with Glasses]
In the <Miss Lang Guide> which is written by Miss Lang who is the most prominent gourmet in Midgards, there is Prontera Palace.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
米德加尔特最有名的美食家朗小姐，在《朗小姐指南》里提到了普隆德拉王宫。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Good food and drink are the most enjoyable things in life. It is worth pursuing them. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
美食美酒是人生最大的享受，值得追求。你说呢？

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
....
...It tastes good.
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
...
...很好吃。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Anyways, we have managed to find this dining room where aren't many people. But we need to go back soon.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
总算找到这间没什么人的餐厅了。不过，我们得尽快回去。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
I have been telling people that we are in costumes. I guess our outfits are not very appropriate for this kind of occasion in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
我一直跟人说我们穿的是戏服。我们的打扮似乎不太适合普隆德拉这种场合。

scripts.text:
[Woman with Glasses]
Well, I guess you have looked around enough. Let's go back before anyone comes.
scripts.translation:
[戴眼镜的女子]
好了，我想你也看够了。趁没人来，我们回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Glamorous Girl]
Yes...
scripts.translation:
[迷人的女孩]
是的...

scripts.text: - However the cookie plate is held tightly by the right hand of the Pope. -
scripts.translation: - 教皇紧紧握着饼干盘，盘子就在她的右手里。 -

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Oh, who is this.
You are{0}the one who would lead to the highest peaks of dark art, right?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
哦，这位是...
{0}，你就是那位要把黑暗艺术推向巅峰的人吧？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You've been invited to this banquet too?
Hum, are you the hero of the century recommended by the guild?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
你也受邀参加宴会了？
哼，你就是公会推荐的时代英雄吗？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Ha, what a nonsense to disregard me, Dumk!
I can never agree to that.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
哈，竟敢无视我邓克，简直荒唐！
我绝对不能接受。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
By the way, where is Vicente?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
顺便问一下，维森特在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Hey, you assassin, do you know Vicente?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
嘿，你个刺客，你认识维森特吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
...Cut it out there, Dumk...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
...别在那儿胡说了，邓克...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
It's been a long time. Did you catch up with Lin and Ekinasia?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
好久不见。你追上琳和埃基纳西亚了吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
They seemed very excited in the fancy place...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
她们在那豪华的地方看起来很兴奋...

scripts.text: ...It is a pain to stand in a place where you don't belong...
scripts.translation: ...待在一个不属于自己的地方真让人难受...

scripts.text:

You are a visitor to the Prontera Palace.
Do you need a guide?
scripts.translation:
[守护骑士]
你是普隆德拉宫殿的访客。
你需要向导吗？

You may move to the northern corridor from here.
There is the entrance to Valkyrie Realm in the middle of the northern corridor.
scripts.translation:

从这里可以前往北侧走廊。
北侧走廊中央有通往瓦尔基里领域的入口。

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
The door on the left is the entrance to the royal villa.
There are the residences for the Heine, Nerius and Walther families and a room reserved for a special guest.
scripts.translation:
[守护骑士]
左边的门通往皇家别墅。
那里设有海涅、内里乌斯和瓦尔特家族的住所，以及一间贵宾室。

scripts.text:
[Guardian Knight]
You can enter the Banquet Hall through the big gate which appears when you go to the center by following the corridor on the right from here.
scripts.translation:
[守护骑士]
从这里沿右侧走廊走到中央，会看到一扇大门，从那里就能进入宴会厅。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
Are you the adventurer invited to the banquet every one is talking about?
Do you have any <Honor Marks>? Would you give them to me?
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
你就是大家都在谈论、受邀参加宴会的冒险者吗？
你有<荣誉勋章>吗？能给我一些吗？

scripts.text: Why do you need them?
scripts.translation: 你为什么要它们？

scripts.text: Give 30 Honor Marks.
scripts.translation: 给予30个荣誉勋章

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
Even if I work so hard here my entire life, I would always live in the shade.
If you are a man, you should dream big. I always say that to Arner, but he is just too priggery.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
就算我一辈子在这里拼命工作，也总是活在阴影里。
我常对阿纳尔说，男人就该有远大的梦想，可他实在太死板了。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
I don't dream of becoming rich overnight, but I do want to have some honor since I am a man.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
我不梦想一夜暴富，但既然我是个男人，我就想要一些荣誉。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
The aristocrats would never let me handle some great opportunity though. However, you may have acquired some <Honor Marks>, right?
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
贵族们绝不会让我处理什么大机会。不过，你可能已经获得了一些<荣誉勋章>，对吧？

scripts.text:

For people like us, the <Honor Marks> mean rapid promotion.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
给我^FF000030枚<荣誉勋章>^000000，我就给你一件很实用的东西。
对我们这种人来说，<荣誉勋章>就是快速晋升的阶梯。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
What I have is a wrapped box which is one of the items that Arner has.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
我手里有一个包裹好的盒子，那是阿纳尔拥有的物品之一。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
It is authentic for that it has been made to be distributed to the nobility. However, I don't know what's in there. It depends on your luck.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
这是专门制作给贵族的正品。不过我不知道里面是什么，就看你的运气了。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
After collecting all the Honor Marks, I'll take that build a castle on the shore and spend the rest of my life there with that stubborn Arner.
That stupid Arner. If it was not for me, he would stay in the palace exchanging things until he dies.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
等我收集齐荣誉勋章，就在海边建座城堡，和那个固执的阿纳尔一起度过余生。
那个笨蛋阿纳尔，要不是有我，他就会在宫里一直兑换东西，直到老死。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
I have told you I need 30 of them.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
我说过要30枚。

scripts.text:
[Sin the Logistics Manager]
Thank you. This is the thing I have promised.
scripts.translation:
[后勤主管 辛]
谢谢你。这就是我答应给你的东西。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
How terrifying.
This must be Prontera in the past?
I guess we have picked the right time to be here-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
真可怕。
这里一定是过去的普隆德拉吧？
看来我们来对了时间——

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Shall we look around more?
Or go back?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
要不要再四处看看？
还是回去？

scripts.text: It that possible?
scripts.translation: 这可能吗？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa, don't you underestimate me.
I am a Court Mage.
I studied in Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇，别小看我。
我可是宫廷魔法师。
我在埃克拉珠学习过。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I have also learned a lot of things at the Cat Paw Services!
I believe that I have the most thorough knowledge when it comes to the crack of dimension!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我也从猫爪服务学到了不少！
说到次元裂缝，我的知识可是最全面的！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
As long as it is from a place on the crack of dimension,
It is a piece of care to go back!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
只要知道次元裂缝中的位置，回去就不是什么难事！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Since we don't belong to this time, it is much easier to get out than to enter.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
既然我们不属于这个时代，离开这里比进来容易得多。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
So, what are you going to do?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那么，你打算怎么办？

scripts.text: Let's get in.
scripts.translation: 进去看看

scripts.text: Let's go back to our time.
scripts.translation: 回到我们的时代

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Do you remember the gate we got out?
It is supposed to be connected to the inside of the palace.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你还记得我们离开的那扇门吗？
它应该通向宫殿内部。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
However, we arrived here. I guess the spaces are twisted a little so that they are connected.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
可我们却来到了这里。我想是空间稍微扭曲，让两处连接在了一起。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I have already experimented this. If you enter the entrance to the palace,
It is connected to the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000 which we have just been to.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我已经验证过了。只要进入宫殿入口，
就会来到我们刚才去过的^4d4dff王室往事^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Then, shall we march in?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
那么，我们进去吧？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Whoa, shall we organize the thoughts now?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇，现在要整理一下思路吗？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
^4d4dffWhat was in the Room of Consciousness^000000 must have been...
Well, this must have something to do with ^4d4dffthe undead army attacking Prontera^000000 now.
Well, it must have been ^4d4dfftaken away by them^000000, am I right?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
^4d4dff意识之室里原本放着的东西^000000一定是...
这肯定和现在^4d4dff袭击普隆德拉的不死族大军^000000有关。
一定是^4d4dff被他们带走了^000000，没错吧？

scripts.text: Right.
scripts.translation: 没错

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Can we stop this?
Or, can we take it with us?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我们能阻止这件事吗？
或者把东西带走？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I believe our superiors will order us to do so.
Try whatever it takes to make it work.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
上级应该会命令我们这么做。
无论如何都要想办法成功。

scripts.text: I guess so.
scripts.translation: 应该是这样

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Perhaps, well it is just my imagination though.
Whatever was in the Room of Consciousness was taken, right?
However, the royal families have been performing the ritual without knowing that somehow.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
也许这只是我的猜测。
意识之室里的东西被拿走了，对吧？可王室成员似乎一直在照常举行仪式，对此毫不知情。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
They must have done something or it must have returned...
This could meet the condition to see the sealed part of the ^4d4dffPast Memories of the Royal Family^000000...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
他们一定做了什么，或者那东西已经回来了...
这或许符合条件，能让我们看到^4d4dff王室往事^000000中被封印的部分...

scripts.text: You mean, the ones who know the truth?
scripts.translation: 你是说那些知晓真相的人？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Yes, I mean that. If this is the truth which is the key to open the seal,
We are bringing an important piece of information back with us.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
没错。如果这就是解开封印的关键，
那我们就带回了一条重要情报。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
We didn't protect or take the thing...
But we know the truth now. It will break the seal of the document...
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我们既没能保护那东西，也没把它带走...
但现在我们知道了真相，这或许能解开文件的封印...

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
As the secret of the royal family is revealed, we will get the missing pieces of the puzzle.
Hahahaha, and you are the one who would be the center of all that, my darling!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
随着王室秘密揭开，缺失的线索也会补齐。
哈哈哈哈，而你就是这一切的中心，我亲爱的！

scripts.text: Don't call me that!
scripts.translation: 别这么叫我！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
What about it?
We will see each other everyday from now on, won't we?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
怎么了？
从今以后我们不是天天见面吗？

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, shall we go back then?
Our mission here is done for now!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，回去吧？
我们暂时完成这里的任务了！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let's go back!
Nothing good can be done staying in a place which is not of our time too long
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
回去吧！
待在不属于我们时代的地方太久，可没什么好处。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Well, then get ready!
Three!
Two!
One!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，准备！
三！
二！
一！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Haha! This place is exciting...
...As always.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哈哈！这里真刺激...
...一如既往。

scripts.text: Let's get out of here!
scripts.translation: 离开这里！

scripts.text: I'll look around.
scripts.translation: 我再四处看看

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Have a safe trip!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
一路平安！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Let's go it!
Forget everything and let's get out-
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
走吧！
别想那么多，离开这里——

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hey, you need to be cured first.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
嘿，你得先接受治疗。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Argh... Those undead bastards... I'll kill them all...
scripts.translation:
[伤兵]
可恶...那些不死族混蛋...我要杀光它们...

scripts.text: [Soldier]
scripts.translation: [士兵]

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
My friend has followed Scientist Doyeon. I am worried. I have heard that she really is an oddball.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我的朋友跟着科学家道渊出去了。我很担心，听说她是个怪人。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The troops of immortality... They are really strong. Please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
不死族大军...他们真的很强。小心点。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Scientist Doyeon... Would she be OK? How can she go out there to study in a situation like this?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
科学家道渊...她没事吧？这种时候怎么还跑出去做研究？

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
An eccentric scientist, Doyeon, went out there with soldiers, and there has been no message from them. I am getting worried.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
古怪的科学家道渊带着士兵出去了，之后就没消息了。我很担心。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Please. Don't get yourself killed by the enemy.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
拜托，别被敌人干掉。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Humph! Bring it on!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哼！放马过来！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hahaha, I was supposed to have a romantic dinner with my girlfriend, damn it!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哈哈哈，我本来要和女朋友共进浪漫晚餐的，该死！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Thank god... The undead are not coming this way much. What a relief.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
谢天谢地...不死族没怎么往这边来。真是松了口气。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
My family live in Prontera. I wonder if they have fled safely.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我的家人住在普隆德拉。不知道他们有没有安全撤离。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
We will defend the palace of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我们要守住普隆德拉王宫。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Damn it... Those undead...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
该死...那些不死族...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
The endless battle against the enemies...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
和敌人的战斗永无止境...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I'll... I'll make sure to defend this place.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
我...我一定会守住这里。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
What was it that had dropped from the sky? How could it bring the undead to the capital?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
刚才从天上掉下来的是什么？它怎么会把不死族带到首都来？

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
My colleague who had been laughing with me just... Aww...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
刚才还和我有说有笑的同伴...唉...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Argh.... Those undead...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
可恶...那些不死族...

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您的物品栏物品过多，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Are you an adventurer? I am sorry, but I am in the middle of something. Please leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
你是冒险者吗？抱歉，我现在忙着处理事情，请先别打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I thank you on behalf of the Prontera Guards.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
谨代表普隆德拉卫队向您致谢。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
We will make sure to end the battle with the undead as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我们会尽快结束与不死族的战斗。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldier dispatched to the area near the village office that you helped the villagers.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我听派往村公所附近的士兵说，您帮助了村民。

scripts.text: [Chief Guard Spiegel]
scripts.translation: [卫队长 施皮格尔]

scripts.text: I heard from the soldier dispatched to the area near the village office that you helped the villagers.
scripts.translation: 我听派驻在村公所附近的士兵说，您帮助了村民。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
He is a young man who has been hanging around in the village for a while. He seems to work diligently...
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
他是个在村里待了一阵子的年轻人，看起来工作很勤勉...

scripts.text: [Chief Guard Spiegel]
scripts.translation: [卫队长 施皮格尔]

scripts.text: He is a young man who has been hanging around in the village for a while. He seems to work diligently...
scripts.translation: 他是个在村里待了一阵子的年轻人，看起来工作很勤勉……

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
However, Mr. Quadro who runs Prontera Smelter seems to have lost an important document in the chaos.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
不过，经营普隆德拉冶炼厂的夸德罗先生似乎在混乱中丢失了一份重要文件。

scripts.text: [Chief Guard Spiegel]
scripts.translation: [卫队长 施皮格尔]

scripts.text: However, Mr. Quadro who runs Prontera Smelter seems to have lost an important document in the chaos.
scripts.translation: 不过，经营普隆德拉冶炼厂的夸德罗先生似乎在混乱中遗失了一份重要文件。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
He is the one in charge of the weapons used by the guards. I am worried if it would cause any trouble in his work.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
他负责管理卫兵使用的武器。我担心这会影响他的工作。

scripts.text: [Chief Guard Spiegel]
scripts.translation: [卫队长 施皮格尔]

scripts.text: He is the one in charge of the weapons used by the guards. I am worried if it would cause any trouble in his work.
scripts.translation: 他负责卫兵使用的武器，我担心这会影响他的工作。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Oh! Anyways, thank you for helping the villagers.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
哦！总之，感谢您帮助了村民们。

scripts.text: [Chief Guard Spiegel]
scripts.translation: [卫队长 施皮格尔]

scripts.text: Oh! Anyways, thank you for helping the villagers.
scripts.translation: 哦！总之，谢谢您帮助村民。

scripts.text: [Chief Guard Spiegel]
scripts.translation: [卫队长 施皮格尔]

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
目前局势艰难，我们无法提供丰厚的奖励，不过这是卫兵们为您准备的谢礼。

scripts.text: Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation: 我们现在处境艰难，无法提供特别丰厚的报酬，不过这是卫兵们为您准备的谢礼。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldiers dispatched to the Knights' building that you saved Lowen.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我听派往骑士团的士兵说，您救了洛温。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Lowen is a spirited girl who claims that she likes the Crusaders to the Royal Lord Knights.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
洛温是个活泼的女孩，她说自己从十字军时代起就喜欢骑士团的骑士。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Rosa who is the younger sister to the girl is also popular among our soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
她的妹妹罗莎在我们士兵中也很受欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I thank you on behalf of the Prontera Guards.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
谨代表普隆德拉卫兵向您致谢。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
目前局势艰难，我们无法提供丰厚的奖励，不过这是卫兵们为您准备的谢礼。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldier dispatched to the village office that a soldier on his vacation has been fled here.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我听派往村公所的士兵说，一名休假的士兵逃到了这里。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I guess there has been a soldier on vacation during such a difficult time. I had been ignorant of it before I got the report.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
这么艰难的时候竟然有士兵在休假。我直到收到报告才知道这件事。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I am faced with my inadequacies as the one in charge of the security of the capital.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
身为负责首都治安的人，我深感自己失职。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
目前局势艰难，我们无法提供丰厚的奖励，不过这是卫兵们为您准备的谢礼。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I heard from the soldier in the cathedral that you saved the couple, Eryus and Ellie.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我听大教堂的士兵说，您救了埃里乌斯和艾莉这对夫妻。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I think I have heard of their names. I have heard that they irritate the minds of lonely soldiers with their endless public display of affection.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我好像听过他们的名字。听说他们总是旁若无人地秀恩爱，让那些孤单的士兵很是心烦。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Everyone in Prontera must know about it. Anyways, thank you for doing this for the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
普隆德拉的人肯定都知道这件事。总之，感谢您为卫兵们做了这件事。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Since we are in a difficult situation, we cannot offer you anything too spectacular, but this is the rewards for you prepared by the Guards.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
目前局势艰难，我们无法提供丰厚的奖励，不过这是卫兵们为您准备的谢礼。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I'll mark the places to which the soldiers haven't been dispatched to due to circumstances on the map.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我会在地图上标出因故未能派遣士兵前往的地点。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Please help any villagers in trouble if you find them.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
如果您发现有村民陷入困境，请帮助他们。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Don't stand there in the middle of our line! Watch out!
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
别站在我们队伍中间！小心点！

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
If you are hurt step back to get yourself cured. If you are recovered, get back in the line.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
受伤了就退后接受治疗，恢复后再回到队伍中。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Huh? I haven't seen you before. You seem like a civilian. Why are you coming from there?
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
咦？我没见过你。你看起来像是平民。你为什么会从那里过来？

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
What? Have the undead entered the palace already?
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
什么？不死族已经攻入宫殿了吗？

scripts.text: No... I don't think so... I am just...
scripts.translation: 不...我想不是...我只是...

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
So you are supposed to be an adventurer invited to the banquet, right?
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
所以你是受邀参加宴会的冒险者，对吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Has there been a banquet in the palace lately? I don't remember.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
最近宫殿里有宴会吗？我不记得了。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Well... Since we are busy dealing with
the undead invading the village, as long as the palace is safe from the undead, I won't make a big deal out of it.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
嗯...我们正忙着应对入侵村庄的不死族。只要宫殿没有受到威胁，我就不追究了。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
I won't stop you from moving around the town. I'll mark the places to which the soldiers haven't been dispatched to due to circumstances on the map.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
我不会阻止你在城里走动。我会在地图上标出因故未能派遣士兵前往的地点。

scripts.text:
[Chief Guard Spiegel]
Please help any villagers in trouble if you find them.
scripts.translation:
[卫队长 施皮格尔]
如果您发现有村民陷入困境，请帮助他们。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Whoa... You are not an undead, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哇...你不是不死族吧？

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Haha... I am alive now.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哈哈...我现在还活着。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you know how scare I have been? This place was packed with the undead, and I heard screams from everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
你知道我有多害怕吗？这里挤满了不死族，到处都能听见尖叫声。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Thank god... The shelter is supposed to be near the village office over there. Why don't we continue this conversation there?
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
谢天谢地...避难所应该就在那边的村公所附近。我们去那里继续聊吧？

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
你看得见我吗？真奇怪。我不应该被看见的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Huh...? What a nerve! That guy... Save a stranger from the sea, and heùéll ask for more...
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哼...真敢开口！那家伙...从海里救了个陌生人，还想得寸进尺...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Oh! I wasn't going to eavesdrop. Please don't get me wrong.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哦！我并没有在偷听。请别误会。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Dear adventurer. I believe that uniform is worn by the Guards of Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
冒险者，那身制服应该是吉芬卫兵穿的。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Who is that soldier? He seems to enter the shelter so smoothly in a situation like this. He confuses me.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
那个士兵是谁？在这种局势下，他进入避难所的样子如此从容，让我感到困惑。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
This the village office which is the third shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
这里是村公所，也是普隆德拉的第三个避难所。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Whoa... I am saved. How fortunate. I guess I am a lucky man.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哇...我获救了。真幸运。看来我是个幸运的人。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Wait? Where did it go? I think I lost the Tool Bag while I was running.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
等等？它去哪了？我想我逃跑的时候把工具包弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
I can guess where it has been dropped...
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
我可以猜到它掉落在哪里了...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
You must be pretty tough to roam the village in a situation like this. Please do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
这种时候还能在村里四处走动，你一定很有本事。帮我个忙吧。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you know where the Prontera Smelter is?
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
你知道普隆德拉冶炼厂在哪儿吗？

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
It is quite a famous store in Prontera. Someday, I will...
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
那是普隆德拉一家很有名的店。总有一天，我也要...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Oh! Never mind. I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哦！算了。就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Whoa... I thought I have lost it. You really found it!
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哇...我还以为弄丢了。你真的找到了！

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
This is awesome. Thank you so much. You must be busy, right? I have to go take care of something now...
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
太棒了，真是谢谢你。你肯定很忙吧？我得去处理点事了...

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Oh! I know you are strong enough, but please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
哦！我知道你很强，但请务必小心。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Thank you. Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
谢谢。再见。

scripts.text:
[Village Lad]
Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[村里的小伙子]
你看得见我吗？真奇怪。我不应该被看见的。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
In front of the Prontera Smelter
There a bag which would be full if you put some items.
scripts.translation:
普隆德拉冶炼厂前
这里有个袋子，里面似乎装满了东西。

scripts.text: Pick up.
scripts.translation: 捡起

scripts.text: Leave it.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text: You have acquired a bag.
scripts.translation: 你获得了一个袋子。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
This the village office which is the third shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
这里是村公所，也是普隆德拉的第三个避难所。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Oh! Dear Royal Guard... That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
啊！皇家卫士大人……那条腰带？看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同僚所佩戴的。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Oh! Dear Rune Knight... That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
啊！卢恩骑士大人……那条腰带？看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同僚所佩戴的。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me help you ride a Griffon.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
能把它交给我，让我安抚他可怜的灵魂吗？虽然紧急情况下服务暂停，我还是帮您骑上狮鹫吧。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me help you ride a Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
能把它交给我，让我安抚他可怜的灵魂吗？虽然紧急情况下服务暂停，我还是帮您骑上龙吧。

scripts.text: Use the service.
scripts.translation: 使用服务

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
I see. Then, good bye.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
这样啊。那再见。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You need to learn how to ride a Griffon first.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
您得先学会骑乘狮鹫。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You need to learn how to ride a Dragon first.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
您得先学会骑乘龙。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You are already using a Griffon.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
您已经在骑乘狮鹫了。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You are already using a Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
您已经在骑乘龙了。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You need to let go of the bridle to ride a Griffon.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
请先松开缰绳，才能骑乘狮鹫。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
You need to let go of the bridle to ride a Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
请先松开缰绳，才能骑乘龙。

scripts.text:
[Giant Beast Manager]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[巨兽管理员]
谢谢。如果你找到其他阵亡士兵留下的物品，请带给我。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
This the village office which is the third shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲技师]
这里是村公所，也是普隆德拉的第三个避难所。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Oh, dear Mechanic! That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲技师]
哦，亲爱的机匠！那条腰带？看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同事留下的。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me help you borrow a Cart or ride a Magical Gear.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲技师]
请把它交给我，让我安抚同事的亡魂吧。虽然紧急情况期间服务暂停了，但我可以帮你租用手推车或骑乘魔导装甲。

scripts.text: Borrow a Cart.
scripts.translation: 租用手推车

scripts.text: Ride a Magical Gear
scripts.translation: 骑乘魔导装甲

scripts.text: Do not use it.
scripts.translation: 不用

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
You are already using a Cart.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲机械师]
您已经在骑乘手推车了。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲机械师]
谢谢。如果你发现其他阵亡士兵留下的物品，请带给我。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
You cannot ride another magical gear since you are already riding one.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲机械师]
您已经在骑乘魔导装甲了，无法再骑乘另一辆。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Go get a license to ride a magical gear first.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲机械师]
请先去办理骑乘魔导装甲的许可证。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲机械师]
谢谢。如果你发现其他阵亡士兵留下的物品，请带给我。

scripts.text:
[Magical Gear Mechanic]
Oh... Really. I see.
scripts.translation:
[魔导装甲技师]
哦...是吗。我知道了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Hey dear, are you OK?
scripts.translation: 嘿，亲爱的，你没事吧？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
I was running to the church with my sister, Rosa... And I lost her... Awww...
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
我正和姐姐罗莎跑去教堂...结果把她弄丢了...呜呜...

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Rosa should have held on to my hand tightly. How clumsy of her to be lost!
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
罗莎本该紧紧牵着我的手才对。她怎么这么不小心，竟然走丢了！

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Would you take me to the cathedral?
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
你能带我去大教堂吗？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
We promised to meet at the cathedral when we are lost. I believe she would be there in the church.
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
我们约好走散时在大教堂碰面。我想她应该会在那里。

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Oh? Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
咦？你看得见我吗？真奇怪，我不应该被看见才对。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Please take care of Lowen. She is like a mascot to us in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
请照顾好洛温。她对我们普隆德拉来说就像吉祥物一样。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Ellie is really fragile. I hope she is all right.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
艾莉真的很虚弱。希望她没事。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Oh, my... Ellie is in a critical condition. I hope a priest comes out to help her if there is one in there.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
哎呀...艾莉的情况很危急。希望里面有牧师能出来救她。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Thank you for your effort. We will devote our lives to protect the cathedral from the undead coming this way.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
谢谢你的帮助。我们会誓死守住大教堂，不让不死族闯进来。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
This the cathedral which is the first shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
这里是普隆德拉的第一个避难所——大教堂。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
That belt... It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead. Would you mind giving it to me?
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
那条腰带...看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同事留下的。你愿意把它交给我吗？

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
I know it is an emergency, but I'd like to comfort the soul of my colleague.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
我知道现在情况紧急，但我想让同事的亡魂安息。

scripts.text: Give it to him.
scripts.translation: 给他

scripts.text: Do not give it him.
scripts.translation: 不给他

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Oh, I see. Please bring them to me if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
哦，我明白了。改变主意的话，请把腰带带来。

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Oh, where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
哦，你把那条腰带弄丢在哪里了？

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
Thank you. I guess the dead may rest in peace now. This is the only thing that I can offer you... However...
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
谢谢。我想逝者现在可以安息了。这是我唯一能给你的谢礼...不过...

scripts.text:
[Cathedral Knight]
If you find more articles left by the soldiers, would you please bring them to me?
scripts.translation:
[大教堂骑士]
如果你找到其他阵亡士兵留下的遗物，也请带给我好吗？

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
那条腰带？看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同事留下的。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh! Dear crusader!
That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
哦！亲爱的十字军！
那条腰带？看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同事留下的。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh! Dear paladin!
That belt? It looks like a belt which belongs to my colleague who has been killed by the undead.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
哦！亲爱的圣殿十字军！
那条腰带？看起来像是我那位被不死族杀害的同事留下的。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Would you hand it over to me so that I can comfort his poor soul? Although the service is stopped due to the emergency, let me call Pecopeco for you.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
请把它交给我，让我安抚同事的亡魂吧。虽然紧急情况期间服务暂停了，但我可以为你叫来大嘴鸟。

scripts.text: Use the service.
scripts.translation: 使用服务

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh... Really. I see.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
哦...是吗。我知道了。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh! Where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
哦！你把那条腰带弄丢在哪里了？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Dear crusader
Oh! Where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
亲爱的十字军，
哦！你把那条腰带弄丢在哪里了？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Dear paladin
Oh! Where did you lose the belt you had?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
亲爱的圣殿十字军，
哦！你把那条腰带弄丢在哪里了？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh... I guess you should learn how to ride a Pecopeco first.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
哦...我想你得先学会骑大嘴鸟。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
You are already using the Pecopeco.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
你已经在骑大嘴鸟了。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
You need to let go of the bridle to ride it.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
你得先松开缰绳才能骑乘。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Thank you. If you find other articles left by the dead soldiers, please bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
谢谢。如果你发现其他阵亡士兵留下的遗物，请带给我。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Oh, I am an uncle now...
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
唉，我现在都成大叔了...

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
If you are here to borrow a PecoPeco, I have to say I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
如果您是想借大嘴鸟，我很抱歉，恐怕不行。

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Due to the emergency situation, all troops of Prontera are deployed to protect the residents of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
由于情况紧急，普隆德拉所有部队都已出动保护居民。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest since you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由于物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Whoa, thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
哇，太感谢你了！

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Rosa! Rosa!
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
萝莎！萝莎！

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Oh, Uncle Peco, did you see my sister here?
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
哦，大嘴鸟叔叔，你看到我姐姐了吗？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Cough... Uncle...
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
咳...叔叔...

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
You mean Rosa? Do you mean Rosa? I haven't seen Rosa here. Wasn't she coming with you?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
你是说萝莎？你是说萝莎吗？我没在这里见到萝莎。她不是和你一起来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Aww... Rosa, where are you now?
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
唉...萝莎，你现在在哪里呢？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
She could have gone to the Knights' building. Weren't you sisters supposed to go to the shelter there?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
她可能去了骑士团大楼。你们姐妹不是该去那里的避难所吗？

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Eh? It must have not been the cathedral then... Huh? What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
咦？所以不是大教堂...啊？我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Dear adventurer, if you are not in a hurry, would you help Lowen flee to the Knights' building?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
冒险者，如果你不赶时间，能帮洛温逃到骑士团大楼吗？

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Lowen's sister is a careful girl, unlike Lowen. She must have fled to the Knights' building.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟管理员]
洛温的姐姐很细心，不像洛温那么冒失。她一定逃去骑士团大楼了。

scripts.text: Since I am here already, let me keep helping her.
scripts.translation: 既然我已经在这里了，就继续帮帮她吧

scripts.text:
[PecoPeco Mechanic]
Thank you. Please take care of her.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟机械师]
谢谢你。请照顾好她。

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Oh? Do you see me? How strange. I am not supposed to be seen.
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
咦？你看得见我吗？真奇怪，我不应该被看见才对。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
This the knight's building which is the second shelter in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
这里是骑士团大楼，也是普隆德拉的第二个避难所。

[Knight Gray]
Are you the one who has helped Sister Erinin? What a relief that we have someone like you?
scripts.translation:
[骑士格雷]
你就是帮助艾琳修女的人吗？有你这样的人帮忙，真是太好了！

scripts.text:
[Knight Gray]
With the honor of the knight, I'll protect the villagers inside.
scripts.translation:
[骑士格雷]
我以骑士的荣誉起誓，会保护里面的村民。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Guild Admin]
Are you here to hire a mercenary?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵公会管理员]
您是来雇佣佣兵的？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Guild Admin]
I am sorry, but all mercenaries dispatched in this area have been hired by the palace.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵公会管理员]
很抱歉，这个区域的所有佣兵都已被宫殿征召。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary Guild Admin]
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵公会管理员]
很抱歉。

[罗莎·埃里宁]

scripts.text:
[Lowen]

scripts.translation:
[洛温]
嘿嘿... 谢谢你，亲爱的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]

scripts.translation:
[罗莎·埃里宁]
哦！亲爱的冒险者，谢谢你。她可真让人操心，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
She is so delicate, but she is reckless. I am worried about her.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎·埃里宁]
她很娇弱，却又鲁莽行事，我真担心她。

scripts.text:
[Rosa Erinin]
Well, we shall go hide in there so that the knights here don't need to worry about us anymore.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎·埃里宁]
好了，我们进去躲起来吧，这样这里的骑士们就不用再为我们担心了。

scripts.text:
[Lowen]
Thank you. Goodbye!
scripts.translation:
[洛温]
谢谢。再见！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
